files.name: 2026年11月20日外交部发言人郭嘉昆主持例行记者会

units.zh: 应新加坡副总理颜金勇邀请，中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理丁薛祥将于11月22日至23日访问新加坡，同颜金勇副总理共同主持中新双边合作联委会第二十二次会议、中新苏州工业园区联合协调理事会第二十七次会议、中新天津生态城联合协调理事会第十八次会议、中新（重庆）战略性互联互通示范项目联合协调理事会第十次会议。
units.en: At the invitation of Deputy Prime Minister of Singapore Gan Kim Yong, Member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council Ding Xuexiang will visit Singapore from November 22 to 23, and co-chair with Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong the 22nd meeting of the China-Singapore Joint Council for Bilateral Cooperation, the 27th meeting of the China-Singapore Suzhou Industrial Park Joint Steering Council, the 18th meeting of the China-Singapore Tianjin Eco-City Joint Steering Council, and the 10th meeting of the China-Singapore (Chongqing) Demonstration Initiative on Strategic Connectivity Joint Steering Council.

units.zh: 新华社记者：亚太经合组织（APEC）第三十三次领导人非正式会议在深圳成功举行。
units.en: Xinhua News Agency: The 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting was successfully held in Shenzhen.

units.zh: 我们注意到，会议就亚太共同体建设提出《深圳展望》，引发国际社会热议。
units.en: We notice that the Shenzhen Outlook on building an Asia-Pacific community put forward at the meeting has sparked heated discussion worldwide.

units.zh: 发言人能否进一步介绍情况？
units.en: Could you share more details on that?

units.zh: 郭嘉昆：11月19日，亚太经合组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议在深圳成功举行。
units.en: Guo Jiakun: On November 19, the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting was successfully held in Shenzhen.

units.zh: 习近平主席主持会议并发表重要讲话，就亚太共同体建设阐述中国主张，宣布中方支持亚太合作的一系列自主举措。
units.en: President Xi Jinping chaired the meeting and delivered important remarks, in which he elaborated on China’s proposals on building an Asia-Pacific community and announced China’s voluntary measures to support Asia-Pacific cooperation.

units.zh: 会议达成富有雄心、务实全面的《亚太经合组织领导人深圳展望》，这是APEC“中国年”最重要的成果，也是APEC合作新的里程碑。
units.en: The meeting adopted the 2026 APEC Leaders’ Shenzhen Outlook—an ambitious, pragmatic and comprehensive document. This is the most important outcome of APEC “China Year,” and marks a new milestone in APEC cooperation.

units.zh: 《深圳展望》聚焦经贸、联通、创新、发展四大领域和亚太自贸区、设施硬联通、规制软联通、人民心联通以及数字经济、新兴技术、能力建设、可持续增长等八大方向，为亚太共同体搭建起“四梁八柱”。
units.en: The Shenzhen Outlook focuses on four major areas “trade and economy, connectivity, innovation, and development,” and eight key aspects “Free Trade Area of the Asia-Pacific, physical connectivity, institutional connectivity, people-to-people connectivity, digital economy, emerging technologies, capacity building, and sustainable growth,” setting up the pillars for building an Asia-Pacific community.

units.zh: APEC各成员重申，亚太经合组织是区域经济合作的首要平台，将持续推进工作，朝着建成亚太共同体这一目标不断迈进。
units.en: The APEC members reaffirmed their commitment to APEC as the premier forum for regional economic cooperation, and to making continuous efforts to move toward the goal of building an Asia-Pacific community.

units.zh: APEC各成员还衷心感谢中国作为东道主，以及广东省深圳市的周到安排、深圳市民的热情好客。
units.en: They also extended their sincere appreciation to China, the host country, and the people and city of Shenzhen, Guangdong Province for their warm hospitality and thorough arrangements.

units.zh: 中方将同亚太伙伴一道，践行好深圳会议共识，向着亚太共同体目标坚定前行，为中国人民和亚太人民的福祉作出不懈努力，为世界的和平与发展作出更大贡献。
units.en: China will work with Asia-Pacific partners to implement the common understandings reached at the meeting, work steadily toward the goal of Asia-Pacific community, strive for the wellbeing of the people in China and the Asia-Pacific, and make greater contributions to world peace and development.

units.zh: 朝日新闻记者：日本首相高市早苗昨天在深圳举行的记者会上表示，日本政府在台湾问题上的基本立场与1972年《中日联合声明》一致。
units.en: Asahi Shimbun: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said at a press conference in Shenzhen yesterday that the Japanese government’s position on the Taiwan question remains consistent with the 1972 Japan-China Joint Statement.

units.zh: 她同时表示，日中四个政治文件作为两国关系基本文件的定位也没有任何改变。
units.en: She also indicated that there has been no change in the status of the four political documents between Japan and China, which serve as the foundational documents for bilateral relations.

units.zh: 中方对此有何评论？
units.en: What is China’s comment?

units.zh: 郭嘉昆：恪守中日四个政治文件是日方必须履行的政治责任和法律义务，不仅应体现在表态上，更要落实到行动上。
units.en: Guo Jiakun: Abiding by the four political documents between China and Japan is the political responsibility and legal obligation that Japan must fulfill. This should be not just reflected in remarks, but more importantly, implemented with concrete actions.

units.zh: 对日方而言，当前紧迫的是在台湾问题上尽快纠正错误言行，重要的是在历史问题上采取正确态度，根本的是在对华认知上真正做到客观理性。
units.en: For Japan, the pressing priority is to correct the erroneous words and moves on the Taiwan question immediately, adopt a correct attitude on historical issues, and form an objective and rational perception on China.

units.zh: 韩国《中央日报》记者：昨天，中俄美元首会晤在深圳成功举办。
units.en: JoongAng Ilbo: Yesterday the leaders of the U.S., China and Russia held a successful summit in Shenzhen.

units.zh: 据报道，中方表示三国要保持常态化高层交往。
units.en: It’s reported that China said the three countries should maintain regular high-level exchanges.

units.zh: 如果美方提出在下月迈阿密G20峰会期间举行第二次三国元首会晤，中方将如何回应？
units.en: How would China respond if the U.S. were to host a second trilateral summit during the G20 Miami Summit next month?

units.zh: 郭嘉昆：昨天中俄美元首会晤成功举行，中方已经发布消息稿，你可以查阅。
units.en: Guo Jiakun: The China-Russia-U.S. Summit was successfully held yesterday. China has released a readout, which you may refer to.

units.zh: 法新社记者：国际法院裁定，缅甸对其境内的罗兴亚人实施了“种族灭绝”。
units.en: AFP: The United Nations International Court of Justice has ruled that Myanmar is guilty of genocide against its Rohingya Muslim minority.

units.zh: 中方对此有何评论？
units.en: What is China’s comment on the ruling?

units.zh: 郭嘉昆：中方注意到国际法院有关判决。
units.en: Guo Jiakun: China has noted the judgment of the International Court of Justice.

units.zh: 若开邦问题有着非常复杂的历史、民族和宗教背景，需要综合施策，稳妥解决。
units.en: Given its complex historical, ethnic and religious dimensions, the Rakhine state issue needs to be resolved prudently through a holistic approach.

units.zh: 国际社会应为此共同努力，避免将这一问题复杂化。
units.en: The international community should make joint efforts to this end and avoid complicating the issue.

units.zh: 中方愿继续支持有关各方加强对话协商，为推动解决若开邦避乱民众遣返问题发挥建设性作用。
units.en: China stands ready to continue supporting relevant parties in stepping up dialogue and consultation, and to play a constructive role in resolving the issue regarding the repatriation of the displaced people from Rakhine state.

units.zh: 同时中方认为，国际司法机构是维护国际公平正义的重要工具，更要依法审慎行使职权。
units.en: China believes international judicial institutions, as important instruments for upholding international fairness and justice, should exercise their powers with full prudence in accordance with law.

units.zh: 中方对越权管辖和扩大解释等问题存在关切，认为有关做法不利于争端解决。
units.en: China has concerns regarding such issues as ultra vires jurisdiction and overreach in interpretation, which are not conducive to the settlement of disputes.

units.zh: 《环球时报》记者：中方刚刚发布了丁薛祥副总理将访问新加坡并主持中新双边合作机制会议的消息。
units.en: Global Times: The Chinese side just announced that Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang will visit Singapore and co-chair the mechanism meetings on bilateral cooperation.

units.zh: 发言人能否进一步介绍有关情况？
units.en: Could you share more information on this?

units.zh: 郭嘉昆：中国和新加坡互为友好近邻和重要合作伙伴。
units.en: Guo Jiakun: China and Singapore are friendly neighbors and important cooperation partners.

units.zh: 在两国领导人战略引领下，中新关系保持良好发展势头，各领域合作成果丰硕。
units.en: Under the strategic guidance of the leaders of both sides, China-Singapore relations have maintained a sound momentum of growth, yielding fruitful outcomes in cooperation across various fields.

units.zh: 今天上午，习近平主席同新加坡总理黄循财举行重要会晤，为下阶段中新关系发展指明方向。
units.en: President Xi Jinping just had an important meeting with Prime Minister Lawrence Wong this morning, charting the course for a new stage of development for bilateral ties.

units.zh: 中新双边合作机制会议是统筹两国合作的最高级别机制平台。
units.en: The mechanism meetings on bilateral cooperation are the apex platform coordinating collaboration between our two countries.

units.zh: 中方愿同新方共同开好此次机制会议，落实两国领导人战略共识，统筹规划下步合作，更好服务各自现代化建设，推动中新全方位高质量的前瞻性伙伴关系取得更大进展，为地区发展繁荣作出积极贡献。
units.en: China stands ready to work with Singapore to make good use of the meetings to deliver on our leaders’ strategic common understandings, formulate coordinated plans for cooperation in the next phase, unlock fresh impetus for the modernization drive in both countries, seek greater progress in our all-round high-quality future-oriented partnership, and contribute to development and prosperity in the region.

units.zh: 法新社记者：追问一下关于国际法院涉缅甸案的裁决，中国籍法官薛捍勤在各项裁决认定中，除其中一项外，其余均投了支持缅甸的票，请问这是否是中国政府的授意？
units.en: AFP: This is a follow-up on the question about the International Court of Justice’s ruling on Myanmar. The Chinese ICJ jurist Xue Hanqin voted in Myanmar’s favor on all but one count. So my question is, was Ms. Xue acting on the instructions from the Chinese government?

units.zh: 郭嘉昆：国际法院是联合国主要司法机关，法官以个人身份独立履职。
units.en: Guo Jiakun: The International Court of Justice is the principal judicial organ of the United Nations.

units.zh: 薛捍勤法官基于国际法和案件事实，根据其专业知识发表意见，符合法院正常工作程序和实践做法，也是其履职尽责的表现。
units.en: Its judges serve in their individual capacity and perform their duties independently. Judge Xue Hanqin’s expression of her views is grounded in international law and the facts of the case, and informed by her expertise. This is consistent with the court’s established procedures and practices, and reflects the proper fulfillment of her responsibilities.

units.zh: 《北京青年报》记者：今天中方公布了第三届兰花奖评选结果，共有10位国际友人获奖。
units.en: Beijing Youth Daily: A total of ten foreign nationals received the Third Orchid Awards, according to selection results released by the Chinese side today.

units.zh: 发言人对此有何评论？
units.en: Would you like to comment on this?

units.zh: 郭嘉昆：我们对获奖者表示祝贺。
units.en: Guo Jiakun: We congratulate the laureates of the 2026 Orchid Awards.

units.zh: 他们来自五湖四海，但都致力于以文化消弭偏见、以交流增进理解，用数十年如一日的努力搭建起中外友好的民间桥梁。 自2022年设立以来，兰花奖已成为践行全球文明倡议的国际性文化平台。
units.en: Hailing from all over the world, they share the same commitment to dispelling prejudice and nurturing understanding through cultural exchanges. Through decades of dedicated efforts, they have built bridges of friendship connecting the people of China and other countries. Established in 2022, the Orchid Awards have become an international cultural platform that delivers on the Global Civilization Initiative.

units.zh: 中方愿同各方一道，推动不同文明、不同文化、不同民族间实现团结合作、共同进步，携手构建人类命运共同体。
units.en: China is ready to work with all parties to foster solidarity and enhance cooperation among different civilizations, cultures and peoples to seek common progress and build a community with a shared future for humanity.

units.zh: 朝日新闻记者：中俄美元首会晤达成的《和平宣言》提到“国际刑事法院以及其他类似机构不得滥用管辖权”。
units.en: Asahi Shimbun: The China-Russia-U.S. Heads of State Declaration toward Peace said that the International Criminal Court and other similar bodies must not abuse their jurisdiction. I have two questions.

units.zh: 中方认为，什么情况下算是“滥用管辖权”？ “其他类似机构”具体指哪些机构？
units.en: First, how would China define the “abuse” of jurisdiction? Second, what exactly do “other similar bodies” refer to?

units.zh: 郭嘉昆：在国际刑事法院问题上，中方的立场一贯、明确、公开。
units.en: Guo Jiakun: On the International Criminal Court, China’s position is consistent, clear and above-board.

units.zh: 同时，中方一贯支持国际司法机构为促进国际法治发挥建设性作用，主张任何国际司法机构都不应违背国家同意原则，不应滥用管辖权，应该避免政治化和双重标准。
units.en: China supports international judicial bodies in playing a constructive role for upholding international rule of law. That said, China stands that no international judicial body should violate the principle of state consent, abuse their jurisdiction, engage in politicization, or apply double standards.

files.name: 20261111 韩正在《联合国气候变化框架公约》第三十一次缔约方大会安塔利亚领导人峰会上的发言 中英对照

units.zh: 在《联合国气候变化框架公约》第三十一次缔约方大会安塔利亚领导人峰会上的发言 （2026年11月11日，土耳其安塔利亚） 中华人民共和国副主席 韩正
units.en: Remarks by Vice President Han Zheng at the 31st Conference of the Parties to the UNFCCC Antalya Leaders' Summit Antalya, Nov. 11, 2026

units.zh: 尊敬的埃尔多安总统， 各位同事， 女士们、先生们、朋友们：
units.en: Your Excellency President Recep Tayyip Erdogan, Colleagues, Ladies and Gentlemen, Friends,

units.zh: 很高兴作为中国国家主席习近平的特别代表，出席安塔利亚领导人峰会。习近平主席指出，应对气候变化是人类共同的事业。当前，全球气候变化不利影响加速显现。面对新形势，我愿提4点建议。
units.en: It is a great pleasure to attend the Antalya Leaders' Summit as the special representative of Chinese President Xi Jinping. President Xi pointed out that climate response is a common cause for all humanity. As the adverse impacts of global climate change are emerging at a faster pace, I wish to make four proposals.

units.zh: 第一，锚定共同目标，强化集体行动。要遵循共同但有区别的责任原则，全面有效落实《联合国气候变化框架公约》及其《巴黎协定》，凝聚全球气候治理合力。发达国家应率先减排，兑现气候资金承诺。各方应全力落实国家自主贡献，力争做得更好。
units.en: First, focus on common goals and strengthen collective actions. It is important to follow the principle of common but differentiated responsibilities, fully and effectively implement the UNFCCC and its Paris Agreement, and pool synergy for global climate governance. Developed countries should take the lead in emission reduction and honor their commitment of climate finance. All parties should fully deliver on their Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) and strive to do better.

units.zh: 第二，加快绿色转型，推进低碳发展。要促进优质绿色技术和产品自由流通，推动经济和产业结构转型升级。中国今年规划了2030年非化石能源发电量占比达到50%、电能占终端能源消费比重达到35%等目标，坚定不移推进碳达峰碳中和。
units.en: Second, accelerate the green transition and promote low-carbon development. It is important to facilitate the free flow of quality green technology and products, and promote the transition and upgrading of economic and industrial structure. This year, China sets the goal of raising the share of non-fossil fuel energy in power generation to 50 percent, and that of electricity in final energy consumption to 35 percent by 2030. We will unswervingly advance toward carbon peaking and carbon neutrality.

units.zh: 第三，防范气候灾害，提升气候韧性。要坚持减缓和适应并重，加强防灾减灾、监测预警、灾害救援等领域合作，提高气候适应能力。中国愿推动气象智能预警方案“妈祖”在更多国家落地应用，助力各国防范和应对气候风险。
units.en: Third, prevent climate disasters and enhance climate resilience. It is important to be committed to both mitigation and adaptation, and strengthen cooperation on disaster prevention and reduction, monitoring and early warning, and rescue, so as to improve climate adaptability. China will enable more countries to use the AI-powered meteorological warning system, or MAZU, to enhance their climate resilience.

units.zh: 第四，坚持开放普惠，深化国际合作。要加强对发展中国家的支持和帮助，共建清洁美丽世界。中国持续推进非洲光带等应对气候变化南南合作项目，将推出“全球南方气候行动领袖计划”能力建设项目。中国也将为国际航空碳抵消和减排机制的公平有效实施作出贡献。
units.en: Fourth, uphold openness and inclusiveness and deepen international cooperation. It is important to offer more support and assistance to developing countries and jointly build a clean and beautiful world. China continues to promote South-South cooperation projects in response to climate change such as Africa Solar Belt, and will roll out the Global South Climate Action Leadership Program. China will make its contributions to the fair and effective implementation of the Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation.

units.zh: 谢谢大家。
units.en: Thank you.

files.name: 20261103李强在2026年世界互联网大会乌镇峰会开幕式上的主旨演讲 中英对照

units.zh: 在2026年世界互联网大会乌镇峰会开幕式上的主旨演讲 （2026年11月3日） 中华人民共和国国务院总理 李强
units.en: Keynote Speech by H.E. Li Qiang Premier of the State Council of The People’s Republic of China At the Opening Ceremony of The 2026 World Internet Conference Wuzhen Summit November 3, 2026

units.zh: 尊敬的各位来宾， 女士们，先生们，朋友们：
units.en: Distinguished Guests, Ladies and Gentlemen, Friends,

units.zh: 很高兴和各位新老朋友相聚在美丽的江南水乡，共同出席2026年世界互联网大会乌镇峰会。首先，我谨代表中国政府，对各位嘉宾的到来表示诚挚欢迎！对大家长期以来给予中国网信事业发展的关心支持表示衷心感谢！
units.en: It is a pleasure to gather here with all of you—friends old and new—in this beautiful water town in southern China for the opening of the 2026 World Internet Conference Wuzhen Summit. On behalf of the Chinese government, I wish to extend a warm welcome to all participants and express our heartfelt thanks to all of you who have cared about and supported China’s Internet and information development over the years.

units.zh: 世界互联网大会已经连续举办了13年。回想十多年前，4G刚刚铺开，“云”还在等待“风”来，人工智能尚未走出实验室。今天，各种新技术目不暇接，互联网已经发生翻天覆地的变化，万物互联、智能互联走进千家万户、赋能千行百业。但我们更应看到，尽管技术发展日新月异，人们普遍关心的一个重大命题却始终没有变，那就是如何让互联网更好造福人类。
units.en: This year marks the 13th edition of the World Internet Conference. More than a decade ago, 4G was just rolled out, cloud computing was waiting for its moment, and AI had yet to leave the laboratory. Today, new technologies are emerging one after another, and the Internet has undergone dramatic changes. The Internet of Things and intelligent connectivity are reaching countless households and empowering all industries. But more importantly, despite rapid technological advances, one major question of common concern remains unchanged: how can the Internet better benefit humanity?

units.zh: 习近平主席早在2015年世界互联网大会上就提出构建网络空间命运共同体理念，为解决互联网发展和治理问题提供了中国方案。多年来，中国始终坚持与国际社会密切合作，促进互联网创新发展和有效治理。如今，互联网已经深度融入人们的生产生活，这个曾经的“技术增量”已经变成了“时代常量”。随着技术持续突破、世界日益融合，这个常量又逐渐成为影响人类社会发展的“历史变量”，需要我们以面向未来、更加开阔的视角来认识和把握。借此机会，我想同大家分享三点思考。
units.en: At the 2015 World Internet Conference, President Xi Jinping put forward the vision of building a community with a shared future in cyberspace, offering a Chinese approach to Internet development and governance. Over the years, China has worked closely with the international community to promote the innovation-driven development and effective governance of the Internet. Now, the Internet is deeply integrated into people’s daily life and production. What was once a “technological increment” has become a “constant of our times.” As technology continues to make breakthroughs and the world becomes increasingly interconnected, this constant is also becoming a “historical variable” that shapes the development of human society. This requires us to understand and grasp it from a future-oriented and broader perspective. In this connection, I would like to take this opportunity to share three observations with you.

units.zh: 互联网发展正在经历智能化变革和系统性跃迁
units.en: I. Internet development is undergoing an intelligent transformation and a systemic leap.

units.zh: 当前，互联网与人工智能、云计算、区块链等技术加速融合，迈向智能互联网，对经济社会发展产生更为广泛而深刻的影响。
units.en: We meet at a time when the Internet is converging at an accelerating pace with technologies such as AI, cloud computing and blockchain, and moving toward an intelligent Internet that will have an even broader and more profound impact on economic and social development.

units.zh: 互联网不仅是一种基础设施，更是全新生活方式。历经多年发展，互联网已经无处不在、无时不有、无所不及，人们日用而不觉。我们此刻所在的千年古镇，互联网元素全方位融入，云端互联、赛博栖居、智慧生活成为日常。智能网联汽车、服务机器人、智能眼镜等越来越多的新终端成为互联网的新触角，正在塑造全新生活方式，创造美好生活无限可能。
units.en: First, the Internet is not merely infrastructure; it is shaping an entirely new way of life. After years of development, the Internet is now ubiquitous and ever-present, reaching into every corner of our lives, and being used every day and taken for granted. Here in this thousand-year-old town, Internet elements are integrated in every dimension: cloud connectivity, cyber habitation, and smart living have become commonplace. A growing array of new terminals—intelligent connected vehicles, service robots, smart glasses, and more—are becoming new touchpoints for the Internet and will shape a new way of living and unlock boundless possibilities for a better future.

units.zh: 互联网不仅是一种技术手段，更是产业变革动能。这些年，互联网通过连接线上与线下、生产与消费、城市与乡村，催动各行各业显著提高效率、发生深刻变革。在互联网加持下，技术研发周期大幅缩短，定制化柔性化生产蓬勃兴起，贸易突破时空限制、得到极大拓展。随着互联网与各类新技术融合叠加，算电数网联为一体、相互协同，将促进产业组织形态、生产方式等发生新的跃升，更大释放经济增长潜力。
units.en: Second, the Internet is not merely a technological means; it is a driving force for industrial transformation. Over the years, by bridging the online and offline, production and consumption, and urban and rural areas, the Internet has driven remarkable efficiency gains and profound changes across all sectors of the economy. Empowered by the Internet, R&D cycles have been significantly shortened, customized and flexible production is flourishing, and trade has broken free from the constraints of time and space, and has been greatly expanded. As the Internet converges and combines with new technologies, computing, electricity, data, and networks are becoming deeply integrated and mutually reinforcing. This will drive new leaps in industrial organization and production methods, unlocking new potential for economic growth.

units.zh: 互联网不仅是一种信息载体，更是智能生成力量。回首过去，无论从门户网站到搜索引擎，还是从网络社交到移动互联，互联网的角色都是知识与信息的承载者和传播者。随着越来越多大模型、智能体的接入，互联网正在向智能连接、人机协同演变，开始具备自我学习、决策、执行、进化的能力，这将进一步拓展思考边界，加速群体智慧涌现，为人类文明进步提供澎湃动力和强劲活力。
units.en: Third, the Internet is not merely an information carrier; it is a force for intelligent generation. Over the years, from web portals to search engines, from online social networking to mobile network, the Internet has always served as a vehicle for carrying and disseminating knowledge and information. With the integration of an increasing number of large models and intelligent agents, the Internet is evolving toward intelligent connectivity and human-machine collaboration, and is beginning to acquire capabilities for self-learning, decision-making, execution and autonomous evolution. This will broaden the horizon of the mind, accelerate the emergence of collective intelligence, and provide powerful energy and momentum for the progress of human civilization.

units.zh: 当今时代互联网发展需要更加突出以人为本的价值取向
units.en: II. In today’s world, Internet development needs to place greater emphasis on a people-centered value orientation.

units.zh: 互联网在人工智能等新技术的驱动下，正以超乎想象的速度演进，互联网的发展也站在了到底是技术至上还是以人为本的十字路口。不少人担心，一旦滑入技术万能的陷阱，人文精神被技术逻辑所压倒，创新就会走向失控和迷途，人可能被裹挟，文明可能被裁剪。我们认为，互联网发展的最终目的，必须是促进人的全面发展。我们倡议构建网络空间命运共同体，就是希望互联网相关技术能够增强人的能力、拓展人的选择、彰显人的价值、增进人的福祉，而不能让人成为技术的附庸，更不能让技术加剧人类发展的分化。从这一考量出发，有几个问题尤其值得关注。
units.en: Driven by AI and other new technologies, the Internet is evolving at a pace one could never have imagined, and its development now stands at a crossroads: should it go for technological supremacy or take a people-centered approach? Many worry that if we fall into the trap of believing that technology is omnipotent and allow technological logic to overwhelm the humanistic spirit, innovation will spin out of control and lose its way, individuals may be swept along, and civilization may be trimmed to fit. We believe the ultimate purpose of Internet development must be to promote people’s all-round development. Our initiative to build a community with a shared future in cyberspace is intended to ensure that Internet-related technologies enhance people’s capabilities, expand their choices, affirm human worth, and improve their well-being—rather than make people subordinate to technology, still less allow technology to exacerbate divisions in human development. With this in mind, several issues deserve particular attention.

units.zh: 一是“人与机器”的关系之辨。万物智联的条件下，互联网将人与机器深度相联，传统的人与机器之间“使用与被使用”的关系越发模糊，很多过去只有人类才能完成的活动逐渐被机器所替代。现在有不少人说，“机器越来越像人，而人却越来越像机器”。这引发了人被机器所操控的担忧，带来了人类何去何从的危机感。技术大爆发的时代，人与机器如何相处，如何确保技术始终处于人类控制之下，如何保持“人之为人”的精神和特质，成为亟待应对的新挑战。互联网和人工智能应该是人的能力延伸，是解放人的手段，而不应成为对人的全面取代。无论互联网多么强大、人工智能多么“类人”，都必须坚持人的主导性，让机器始终成为人类的可信工具，帮助人类实现更高质量的就业和自身发展。
units.en: First, the entangled relationship between humans and machines. In an era of intelligent connectivity, the Internet is connecting people and machines ever more deeply, and the traditional relationship of “using and being used” between them is becoming increasingly blurred. Activities that once only humans could perform are gradually being taken over by machines. Many now say, “Machines are becoming more and more like humans, while humans are becoming more and more like machines.” This has fueled fears that humans will be controlled by machines and created a sense of crisis about where humanity is headed. In this age of technological explosion, how do humans coexist with machines, how to ensure that technology remains under human control, and how to preserve the spirit and qualities that make us human? These have become urgent new challenges. The Internet and AI should extend human capabilities and serve as means of liberation, not as wholesale replacements for people. However powerful the Internet becomes, and however “human-like” AI may be, human agency must remain paramount. Machines must remain trustworthy tools that help people achieve higher-quality employment and develop themselves more fully.

units.zh: 二是“算法模型”的伦理之思。算法模型虽是人工智能的重要标识，但也已渗透到了互联网的方方面面。互联网运用算法模型来服务人，也潜移默化地影响人，在带来高效率的同时，也对传统的人文精神和人类伦理形成冲击。人们时常感叹，“算法比你自己更了解你”。当算法只认效率优先，普通劳动者就可能被困在系统之中。当大数据杀熟侵害权益，公平诚信的价值原则就可能遭受破坏。当算法偏见放大分歧，社会对立就可能加剧。当信息茧房固化认知，多样知识和文化交流就可能受到阻碍。人类发展实践表明，工具理性和价值理性不可偏废，技术不应只追求效率至上，更应承载人文精神、坚持向上向善。要用全人类共同价值筑牢新技术发展底座，使新技术更好服务人的意志、满足人的需求、遵循人类社会的道德准则。
units.en: Second, the ethical implications of algorithms and models. Algorithms and models are the signature of AI, yet they have seeped into every corner of the Internet. The Internet employs them to serve us and also to quietly shape us. They bring efficiency, but also unsettle traditional humanistic spirit and human ethics. People often lament, “The algorithm knows you better than you know yourself.” When algorithms put efficiency above all else, ordinary workers may get trapped in the system. When big-data price discrimination tramples on rights and interests, the principles of fairness and honesty may be undermined. When algorithmic bias widens differences, social division may intensify. When information cocoons harden our views, knowledge diversity and cultural exchange may get impeded. As human development has shown, instrumental rationality and value rationality must go hand in hand; technology should not chase efficiency alone; more importantly, it must carry a humanistic core and stay positive. We must underpin new technologies with the common values of humanity so that they can better serve human will, meet human needs, and observe the moral code of human society.

units.zh: 三是“数实融合”的安全之虞。互联网连接万事万物、联通现实与虚拟，为人类社会提供了前所未有的便利和机遇，同时也带来前所未有的安全风险。新的安全风险一旦爆发，其范围更广、方式更加隐蔽，现实冲击也愈加难以预测。网络攻击、数据窃取影响社会稳定运行，模型“幻觉”、数据“投毒”干扰社会客观认知，深度伪造、虚假信息冲击社会信任。在数实融合不断加速的今天，智能电网、智能家居、智能工厂等遍布生产生活各类场景，迫切需要更加可控的技术创新、更加严密的安全防范、更加充分的协同合作，更好统筹发展和安全，共同维护人类社会的和平安宁。
units.en: Third, the security risks of digital-physical integration. The Internet links everything and connects the real and virtual worlds. While bringing unprecedented convenience and opportunities to the human society, it also causes unprecedented security risks. New security risks, once materialized, would have wider impacts in more covert ways, with real-world consequences ever harder to predict. Cyberattacks and data theft undermine social stability; model hallucinations and data poisoning distort public perception of reality; deepfakes and disinformation corrode public trust. As digital-physical integration speeds up, smart grids, smart homes, and smart factories have become part of our daily work and life. It is therefore imperative for us to have more controllable technology innovation, more robust security safeguards, and more comprehensive cooperation, so as to better balance development with security and jointly maintain peace and security of the human society.

units.zh: 四是“数智鸿沟”的公平之治。技术进步带来新的发展红利，但也可能形成新的不平等和发展鸿沟，缺乏网络覆盖的地区可能成为“数字孤岛”，数字素养不足的人群可能陷入“数字困境”。尤其是人工智能等新技术的发展能级更高、迭代速度更快，马太效应也更明显。现在，全球还有20多亿人没有接入互联网。各国在人工智能大模型、高质量数据集、高性能算力、高速率通信网络等方面差距很大，如果不采取有效措施，南北发展失衡、社会贫富分化可能进一步加剧，最终可能演变成为时代裂痕。如何让技术进步的成果真正为全社会成员共享，确保新技术成为造福世界的公共产品，是关系全人类共同福祉的时代课题。
units.en: Fourth, the quest for fairness in addressing the digital and AI divide. The advance of technology brings new development dividends, but it can also breed new inequalities and development gaps. Areas without Internet access may turn into isolated “digital islands”; people short on digital literacy may fall into “digital predicaments.” Most notably, with higher capability and faster iteration, the development of AI and other new technologies would magnify the Matthew Effect. Today, more than two billion people worldwide are still offline. In large AI models, high-quality datasets, high-performance computing power, and high-speed communication networks, a huge gap exists between countries. Without effective measures, the North-South development imbalance and the wealth divide could grow wider and ultimately evolve into a rift of our times. How can we ensure that the fruits of technological progress reach everyone in society and that new technologies become public goods benefiting the whole world? That is the defining question of our times, one that bears on the well-being of all humanity.

units.zh: 携手构建网络空间命运共同体
units.en: III. We need to jointly build a community with a shared future in cyberspace.

units.zh: 当世界连成一体，当机器开始思考，人类的前途命运从未如此紧密地联系在一起。面对新与旧转换、危与机并存、变与不变同在的时代大势，没有任何国家能够独善其身。国际社会需要凝聚共识、相向而行，携手构建内涵更加丰富的网络空间命运共同体。
units.en: When our world becomes an interconnected whole and the machine begins to have a mind of its own, humanity’s future is more closely intertwined than ever before. Living in an era where the old gives way to the new, risks coexist with opportunities, and changes unfold alongside constancy, no country can prosper on its own. Members of the international community must forge stronger consensus and move in the same direction to jointly build a community with a shared future in cyberspace that is more substantive in content.

units.zh: 坚持科技赋能，开拓新的发展空间。互联网和人工智能快速发展带来重大机遇，我们应当加大科技创新力度，鼓励开源开放，加强联合攻关，支持新技术新产品规模化应用。中国将继续坚持开门搞创新，促进技术转移和知识分享，与各国一道打造开放包容、充满活力的全球数字创新生态，共同推动互联网创新发展，为全球经济增长注入新动能。
units.en: First, we should harness the power of technology to open new grounds for development. The rapid advance of the Internet and AI brings significant opportunities. We should bolster scientific and technological innovation, encourage open source and openness, strengthen collaborative research and support large-scale application of new technologies and products. China will continue to pursue open innovation, promote technology transfer and knowledge sharing, and work with all to build an open, inclusive and dynamic global ecosystem for digital innovation, push for innovative development of the Internet and cultivate new drivers for global growth.

units.zh: 坚持可信可控，筑牢数字安全屏障。技术创新越是加速，安全缰绳越要握紧。我们应当坚持共同、综合、合作、可持续的安全观，全面加强数字领域安全务实合作，防止技术失控滥用。同时，要反对泛化国家安全概念，反对构筑“数字铁幕”。中国将始终尊重各国网络安全合理关切，与各国同舟共济应对安全挑战，共同筑牢数字安全屏障。
units.en: Second, we should ensure credibility and controllability to strengthen the shields of digital security. The faster technology innovates, the more we need to keep a tight rein on security. We should stay committed to promoting common, comprehensive, cooperative and sustainable security, and step up practical cooperation to ensure security across the digital domain and prevent the loss of control and abuse of technology. Meanwhile, we need to oppose overstretching the concept of national security and erecting digital iron curtains. China will respect the legitimate cybersecurity concerns of all countries and work with all in the world to confront security challenges and strengthen the safeguards for digital security.

units.zh: 坚持普惠均衡，推动数字红利共享。弥合数智鸿沟，事关全球公平发展和长远发展。我们应当充分关注各国特别是全球南方国家诉求，更大力度推动普惠发展，防止产生新的不公。中国将积极落实全球发展倡议，支持全球南方国家建设数字基础设施、培养数字技能人才、提升数字技术能力，让数智化红利更好惠及全球。
units.en: Third, we should pursue universally beneficial and balanced development to promote the sharing of digital dividends. Bridging the digital and AI divide is vital for the equitable and long-term development of the world. We should pay full attention to the demands of various countries, particularly those from the Global South, and redouble our efforts to promote universally beneficial development and prevent new forms of injustice. China will actively implement the Global Development Initiative, and support the Global South countries in building digital infrastructure, cultivating digital talents and enhancing digital capacity, so that digital and AI dividends could better benefit the world.

units.zh: 坚持开放对话，完善多边治理体系。各国网络空间治理理念和路径不尽相同，在一些问题上存在分歧是正常的，应当加强协同合作，不能人为加剧摩擦。我们应当践行真正的多边主义，寻找最大公约数，推动全球互联网治理朝着更加公正合理的方向前进。中国将坚持共商共建共享，积极搭建对话协商平台，为完善网络空间治理贡献更多中国智慧。
units.en: Fourth, we should advance open dialogue to improve the multilateral governance system. Given the different approaches and pathways adopted by countries to conduct cyberspace governance, it is only natural for them to disagree on certain issues. The important thing is to strengthen coordination and cooperation rather than deliberately escalate friction. We should practice true multilateralism, maximize common interests and promote more just and equitable global Internet governance. China will actively build dialogue platforms based on the principle of extensive consultation and joint contribution for shared benefit, and contribute more Chinese wisdom to improving cyberspace governance.

units.zh: 女士们、先生们、朋友们，
units.en: Ladies and Gentlemen, Friends,

units.zh: 互联网发展的速度、带来的变化是惊人的，乌镇就是这一巨变的生动缩影。这座粉墙黛瓦、小桥流水的千年古镇，现在已成为引领互联网发展潮流的世界舞台。在这里，历史积淀与时代变革相互激荡，人文精神与科技力量交相辉映，思想共识与实践行动有机统一。在这里，我们触摸到前沿技术产业的跳动脉搏，领略到数智赋能迸发的强大力量，感受到交流合作结出的累累硕果。一样的古镇，不一样的乌镇。我们期待乌镇的互联网之光更加熠熠生辉。置身奔涌向前的数智浪潮，中国愿同国际社会一道，推动数智技术更好服务全球发展、增进人类福祉。
units.en: The leapfrog development of the Internet and the changes that come with it are truly mind-blowing, and Wuzhen is living proof of such great transformation. This millennium-old water town, which was known for its whitewashed walls, dark-tiled roofs and serene waterside setting, has developed into a global pacesetter of Internet development. Here in Wuzhen, historical traditions meet contemporary transformations, humanistic values inspire advanced science and technology, and shared visions translate into concerted actions. Here in Wuzhen, we feel the beating pulse of cutting-edge industries, witness the immense power of digital and intelligent technologies, and harvest the bumper fruits of global cooperation. It is the same Wuzhen, but a brand new town. We hope the light of Internet will shine ever brighter in Wuzhen. Riding the digital and intelligent tide, China will work with the international community to ensure that digital and intelligent technologies better serve global development and the well-being of all humanity.

units.zh: 预祝本届世界互联网大会乌镇峰会圆满成功！谢谢大家！
units.en: I wish the 2026 World Internet Conference Wuzhen Summit a full success. Thank you!

files.name: 20261029中国共产党第二十届中央委员会第五次全体会议公报 中英对照

units.zh: 中国共产党第二十届中央委员会第五次全体会议公报
units.en: Communique of the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

units.zh: （2026年10月29日中国共产党第二十届中央委员会第五次全体会议通过）
units.en: Adopted at the fifth plenary session of the 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on October 29, 2026

units.zh: 中国共产党第二十届中央委员会第五次全体会议，于2026年10月26日至29日在北京举行。
units.en: The 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China convened its fifth plenary session in Beijing from October 26 to 29, 2026.

units.zh: 出席这次全会的有，中央委员162人，候补中央委员117人。中央纪律检查委员会委员和有关方面负责同志列席会议。党的二十大代表中部分基层同志和专家学者也列席会议。
units.en: A total of 162 members and 117 alternate members of the Central Committee attended the session. Members of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and leading officials from relevant departments were present at the meeting in a non-voting capacity. Some of our primary-level colleagues and a number of experts and scholars, serving as delegates to the 20th National Party Congress, also attended the meeting in a non-voting capacity.

units.zh: 全会由中央政治局主持。中央委员会总书记习近平发表重要讲话。
units.en: The Political Bureau of the Central Committee presided over the meeting. Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the Central Committee, delivered an important address.

units.zh: 全会听取和讨论了习近平受中央政治局委托所作的工作报告，审议通过了《中共中央关于持之以恒推进全面从严治党若干重大问题的决定》。习近平就《决定（讨论稿）》向全会作了说明。
units.en: The Central Committee heard and discussed a report on the work of the Political Bureau, presented by Xi Jinping on behalf of the Political Bureau. They also deliberated and adopted the Resolution of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Certain Major Issues concerning Persevering with Full and Rigorous Party Self-Governance. Xi Jinping delivered explanatory remarks on the draft Resolution.

units.zh: 全会充分肯定党的二十届四中全会以来中央政治局的工作。一致认为，中央政治局认真落实党的二十大和二十届历次全会精神，坚持稳中求进工作总基调，完整准确全面贯彻新发展理念，统筹推进“五位一体”总体布局，协调推进“四个全面”战略布局，统筹国内国际两个大局，统筹发展和安全，扎实推动经济高质量发展，推进社会主义民主法治建设，做好宣传思想文化工作，抓好民生保障和生态文明建设，维护国家安全和社会稳定，纵深推进全面从严治党，加强国防和军队现代化建设，做好港澳工作和对台工作，推进中国特色大国外交，“十四五”圆满收官，“十五五”开局良好，党和国家事业取得新进展新成效。开展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，隆重庆祝中国共产党成立105周年，进一步凝聚起全党全国各族人民团结奋进的强大力量。
units.en: At the session, the Central Committee fully affirmed the work of the Political Bureau since the fourth plenary session of the 20th Central Committee. It was unanimously agreed that the Political Bureau has secured progress in the following respects: earnestly implementing the guiding principles from the Party's 20th National Congress and the plenary sessions of the 20th Central Committee; adhering to the general principle of pursuing progress while ensuring stability; fully and faithfully applying the new development philosophy on all fronts; implementing the Five-Sphere Integrated Plan and the Four-Pronged Comprehensive Strategy in a coordinated way; balancing domestic and international imperatives; ensuring both development and security; delivering tangible results in high-quality economic development; advancing socialist democracy and the rule of law; improving public communication and cultural work; ensuring the people's wellbeing and promoting ecological conservation; safeguarding national security and social stability; further strengthening full and rigorous Party self-governance; modernizing national defense and the armed forces; carrying out work related to Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan; and pursuing major-country diplomacy with Chinese characteristics. Thanks to these efforts, the 14th Five-Year Plan has been brought to a successful conclusion and the 15th Five-Year Plan period is off to a good start with new progress and results achieved in the cause of the Party and the country. It was also noted that, this year, we launched a study campaign on establishing and practicing the correct view of performance and celebrated the 105th anniversary of the Communist Party of China. These occasions have further harnessed the mighty force that stems from the entire Party and the whole nation forging ahead in unity.

units.zh: 全会回顾党100多年来的奋斗历程，指出中国共产党能够从胜利走向胜利，就在于胸怀共产主义远大理想，立志于中华民族千秋伟业，坚持为中国人民谋幸福、为中华民族谋复兴，在各个历史时期都高度重视管党治党，勇于坚持真理、修正错误，在依靠自身力量和人民支持解决自身问题中不断强大，成为党和人民事业的坚强领导核心。在革命、建设、改革中先后把党的建设作为伟大工程、新的伟大工程，党的十八大以来深入推进新时代党的建设新的伟大工程，找到“让人民来监督政府”和“自我革命”两个跳出治乱兴衰历史周期率的答案，这是中国共产党的独特创造，永载马克思主义政党建设史册。
units.en: Looking back on the Party's journey since its founding, the Central Committee pointed out at the session that the key to the success of the Communist Party of China in winning one victory after another lies in its pursuit of the high ideal of communism, its dedication to achieving lasting greatness for the Chinese nation, and its commitment to seeking happiness for the Chinese people and rejuvenation for the Chinese nation. During each historical period, the Party has attached great importance to its self-governance, had the courage to uphold truth and correct errors, and grown ever stronger by relying on its own efforts and the support of the people to resolve its own problems, ultimately emerging as the strong leadership core in the cause of the Party and the people. The Party advanced Party building as a great project and then a great new project in the periods of revolution, development, and reform, and it has made further progress in this regard in the new era since its 18th National Congress. During this course, the Party has found two answers to the question of how to escape the historical cycle of rise and fall: the people's oversight over government and the Party's self-reform. These are the unique discoveries of the Communist Party of China, and will forever stand out in the history of Marxist parties.

units.zh: 全会高度评价新时代全面从严治党取得的伟大成就。一致认为，以习近平同志为核心的党中央以巨大的政治勇气和强烈的责任担当，直面一度出现党的领导弱化虚化淡化、管党治党不严不实不力、党内一些问题触目惊心的严峻现实，坚定不移全面从严治党，刀刃向内、重典治乱，持续解决突出问题，从根本上扭转了管党治党宽松软状况，刹住了一些长期没有刹住的歪风，纠治了一些多年未除的顽瘴痼疾，消除了党、国家、军队内部存在的严重隐患，党在革命性锻造中更加坚强有力。新时代全面从严治党开辟了百年大党自我革命新境界，推动党和国家事业取得历史性成就、发生历史性变革，党和人民赢得强党强国的历史主动。
units.en: Participants at the session gave a highly positive assessment of the great achievements our Party has made in exercising full and rigorous self-governance in the new era. It was unanimously agreed that the Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core demonstrated tremendous political courage and a strong sense of responsibility in confronting the grave situation marked by weak, hollow, and watered-down Party leadership, lax, superficial, and ineffective self-supervision and self-governance, as well as some startling problems within the Party. Staying firmly committed to full and rigorous Party self-governance, the Central Committee introduced the most stringent measures and dedicated continuous efforts to tackle all these prominent issues. As a result, the problem of lax and weak self-supervision and self-governance has been addressed at the root, unhealthy tendencies that had long gone unchecked have been curbed, deep-seated problems that had plagued the Party for years have been remedied, and serious dangers hidden within the Party, the state, and the military have been removed. The Party has thus grown stronger through revolutionary tempering. The endeavors to advance full and rigorous governance over the Party in the new era have broken new ground in the self-reform of our century-old Party and brought about historic achievements and transformations in the cause of the Party and the country. The Party and the people have thus seized the historic initiative in building a great party and a great country.

units.zh: 全会指出，在新时代管党治党、兴党强党伟大实践中，以习近平同志为核心的党中央围绕建设什么样的长期执政的马克思主义政党、怎样建设长期执政的马克思主义政党的重大时代课题，提出一系列新理念新思想新战略，形成习近平党建思想。这一思想丰富和发展了马克思主义建党学说，是坚持把马克思主义基本原理同中国具体实际相结合、同中华优秀传统文化相结合推进党的理论创新的重大成果，是党和人民实践经验和集体智慧的结晶，是习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想的重要组成部分，为深入推进新时代党的建设新的伟大工程提供了根本遵循和行动指南。
units.en: It was pointed out that as the Party endeavors to supervise, govern, develop, and strengthen itself in the new era, the Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core has put forward a series of new ideas, new thinking, and new strategies in response to the major questions of our times -- what kind of long-term governing Marxist party we should build and how we should build it, thereby giving birth to Xi Jinping Thought on Party Building. This thought has enriched and developed Marxist theory on party building, and it represents a major achievement in advancing the Party's theoretical innovation through the integration of the basic tenets of Marxism with China's specific realities and its fine traditional culture. It stands as a crystallization of the practical experience and collective wisdom of the Party and the people. As an important component of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, it provides fundamental guidance and a road map for further advancing the great new project of Party building in the new era.

units.zh: 全会强调，全面从严治党具备许多有利条件，同时面临许多新情况新问题。随着世情国情党情发生深刻变化，党团结带领人民维护国家主权、安全、发展利益任务更加艰巨，党团结带领人民推动改革发展、维护社会和谐稳定任务更加艰巨，党保持先进性和纯洁性任务更加艰巨。这些对党在新形势下的执政能力、领导水平、队伍素质、拒腐防变带来重大挑战，党面临的“四大考验”和“四种危险”是长期的、复杂的、严峻的。
units.en: It was stressed that many favorable conditions are now in place for advancing full and rigorous Party self-governance, while we are also facing many new circumstances and new issues in this endeavor. Profound changes in global, national, and Party conditions have made the Party's tasks of uniting and leading the people in safeguarding China's sovereignty, security, and development interests, of uniting and leading the people in promoting reform and development and maintaining social harmony and stability, and of maintaining its advanced nature and integrity even more arduous. All this poses formidable challenges to the Party's governance and leadership capacity, the quality of its membership, and its resistance against corruption and moral decline under the new circumstances. Moreover, the "four tests" and "four dangers" confronting our Party are still protracted, complicated, and serious.

units.zh: 全党必须从巩固党的长期执政地位、实现中华民族伟大复兴的战略高度，深刻认识持之以恒推进全面从严治党的重大意义，坚定信心，保持定力，以更高标准、更实举措把新时代全面从严治党宝贵经验坚持好、运用好，把党的建设面临的突出问题整治好、解决好，把管党治党形成的良好政治局面巩固好、发展好。
units.en: On this account, all of us in the Party must gain a deep understanding of the great significance of persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance from the strategic perspective of consolidating the Party's long-term governing position and realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. We must build firm confidence, maintain resolve, and adopt higher standards and more concrete measures to carry forward the valuable experience of full and rigorous Party self-governance in the new era, handle and resolve the prominent problems in Party building, and consolidate and develop the sound political situation formed through Party self-supervision and self-governance.

units.zh: 全会指出，持之以恒推进全面从严治党，必须坚持马克思列宁主义、毛泽东思想、邓小平理论、“三个代表”重要思想、科学发展观，全面贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想，深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想，围绕实现党的使命任务，落实新时代党的建设总要求，以党章为根本，坚持党的先锋队性质，坚持党的全面领导和党中央集中统一领导，着眼于提高党的长期执政能力、保持党的先进性和纯洁性、保持党同人民群众的血肉联系，坚持严的基调不动摇，健全全面从严治党体系，以党的政治建设为统领，全面推进党的各方面建设，充分激发全党积极性主动性创造性，不断实现党的自我净化、自我完善、自我革新、自我提高，持续增强党的政治领导力、思想引领力、群众组织力、社会号召力，确保党始终成为走在时代前列、人民衷心拥护、经得起各种风浪考验、朝气蓬勃的马克思主义执政党，始终成为中国特色社会主义事业的坚强领导核心。
units.en: It was stated that in persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance, we must uphold Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought, Deng Xiaoping Theory, the Theory of Three Represents, and the Scientific Outlook on Development, fully implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, and thoroughly study and apply Xi Jinping Thought on Party Building. Dedicated to fulfilling the Party's missions and tasks, we must act in line with the overall requirements for Party building in the new era, take the Party Constitution as our fundamental guide, maintain the Party's vanguard nature, and uphold the overall leadership of the Party and the centralized, unified leadership of the Party Central Committee. We must focus on enhancing the Party's capacity for long-term governance, preserving its advanced nature and integrity, and maintaining its close bond with the people. We must unwaveringly apply strict principles, improve the system of exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance, and take strengthening the Party politically as the overarching principle to advance Party building on all fronts. We must stimulate greater motivation, initiative, and creativity within the whole Party, continue working to purify, improve, renew, and excel ourselves, and constantly strengthen the Party's capacity for providing political leadership, giving theoretical guidance, organizing the people, and inspiring society. In doing so, we will see that the Party always remains a vibrant Marxist governing party that stays at the forefront of the times, enjoys the wholehearted support of the people, and is able to withstand all tests, and that it always remains the strong leadership core of the cause of socialism with Chinese characteristics.

units.zh: 全会强调，持之以恒推进全面从严治党遵循的原则是：坚持服务使命任务，坚持以党的政治建设为统领，坚持全面从严，坚持问题导向，坚持守正创新，坚持以上率下，坚持依规治党。
units.en: At the session, the guiding principles for persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance were highlighted as follows: serving the Party's missions and tasks; taking strengthening the Party politically as the overarching principle; exercising rigorous governance across the board; adopting a problem-oriented approach; upholding fundamental principles and breaking new ground; adhering to a top-down approach; and running the Party according to regulations.

units.zh: 全会对持之以恒推进全面从严治党作出系统部署，强调增强共产党人的党性，严格贯彻执行民主集中制，锻造堪当民族复兴重任的高素质干部队伍，建设上下贯通、执行有力的严密组织体系，驰而不息正风肃纪，坚定不移一体推进不敢腐不能腐不想腐，坚持制度治党、依规治党，完善党和国家监督体系，压紧压实管党治党责任。
units.en: Systematic plans for persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance were also made at the session with the emphasis on strengthening the Party spirit of Communists; strictly practicing democratic centralism; cultivating high-caliber officials capable of shouldering the mission of national rejuvenation; building a well-knit organizational system characterized by cross-level alignment and effective implementation; improving conduct and tightening discipline on an ongoing basis; taking firm and coordinated action against corruption; running the Party with systems and regulations; refining Party and state oversight systems; and ensuring all responsibilities of Party self-supervision and self-governance are fulfilled in earnest.

units.zh: 全会提出，增强党性是全面从严治党的根本性任务。必须推动全体党员、干部坚持党的性质和宗旨，增强党的意识、党员意识、先锋队意识，把加强党性修养作为终身课题，在坚定理想信念、铸牢对党忠诚、厚植为民情怀、坚持实事求是、纯正道德品质、保持清正廉洁等方面下功夫，做到忠诚干净担当，始终保持共产党人政治本色。要强化对党忠诚教育，坚持用党的创新理论凝心铸魂，用党的优良传统和中华优秀传统文化涵养党性，在实践中锤炼党性，加强党性鉴别。
units.en: It was pointed out that strengthening the Party spirit represents a fundamental task of our efforts to ensure full and rigorous Party self-governance. We must, therefore, encourage all Party members and officials to uphold the Party's nature and purpose, raise Party consciousness, have a better understanding of their identity as Party members and the Party's vanguard nature, and maintain a lifelong commitment to cultivating stronger Party spirit. We must also encourage them to devote efforts to strengthening ideals and convictions, forging strong loyalty to the Party, fostering deep affection for the people, always seeking truth from facts, building moral character, and preserving honesty and integrity. These efforts will help them to be loyal, upright, and responsible and always preserve the true political character of Communists. In this regard, measures will be taken to strengthen education on loyalty to the Party, build cohesion and inner strength with the Party's latest theories, nurture the Party spirit with the Party's good traditions and fine traditional Chinese culture, temper the Party spirit in practice, and enhance Party spirit appraisal.

units.zh: 全会提出，民主集中制是党的根本组织原则和领导制度，贯彻执行民主集中制是全面从严治党的内在要求。必须完善和落实民主集中制各项制度，充分发扬党内民主，有效实行正确的集中，更好发挥民主集中制的政治优势、组织优势、制度优势、工作优势。要坚持和加强党中央集中统一领导，提高党内民主质量，严格执行领导班子决策议事规则，规范“一把手”履职用权。
units.en: It was noted that democratic centralism is the Party's fundamental organizational principle and leadership system, and its implementation is therefore an inherent requirement for exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance. We must improve and implement the institutions of democratic centralism, giving full play to intraparty democracy while effectively practicing correct centralism. This will allow us to better draw on the political, organizational, institutional, and working strengths of democratic centralism. In practice, measures will be taken to uphold and strengthen the Party Central Committee's centralized, unified leadership, improve the efficacy of intraparty democracy, strictly implement deliberation rules and decision-making procedures for leadership teams, and regulate leadership team heads' performance of duties and exercise of power.

units.zh: 全会提出，全面从严治党关键在从严治吏。必须贯彻新时代党的组织路线，严格干部教育培养、选拔任用、管理监督，建设一支政治过硬、本领高强、作风优良、纪律严明的高素质干部队伍。要坚持正确用人导向，精准科学选人用人，推动干部树立和践行正确政绩观，增强干部干事创业本领，提高培养选拔优秀年轻干部质量，加强干部管理监督，全方位培养、引进、用好人才。
units.en: It was stated that strict management of officials is the key to full and rigorous Party self-governance. We must implement the Party's organizational line for the new era and apply stringent standards to the education, cultivation, selection, appointment, management, and oversight of officials. On this basis, we will build up the ranks of high-caliber officials with firm political commitment, outstanding professional competence, excellent work conduct, and strict discipline. Following sound guidelines in appointing officials, we should take targeted, well-designed measures to select and appoint officials, inspire officials to foster and act on the correct view of performance, enhance officials' competence in fulfilling their duties and breaking new ground, improve the training and selection of outstanding young officials, and strengthen management and oversight of officials, with a view to promoting the training, recruitment, and utilization of talented people across the board.

units.zh: 全会提出，党的各级组织是全面从严治党的主体。必须体系化推进各层级各领域党组织建设，强化党组织政治功能和组织功能，确保贯彻落实党的路线方针政策和党中央决策部署上下协同、精准高效。要发挥中央和国家机关党组织表率作用，强化地方党委功能，统筹推进各领域基层党组织建设，突出抓好新兴领域党的建设，加强党员队伍建设，完善党的各级组织贯通机制。
units.en: It was stated that Party organizations at all levels play the principal role in exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance. It is therefore essential to systematically advance the development of Party organizations at all levels and in all sectors to strengthen their political and organizational functions. This will help ensure that the Party's lines, principles, and policies, as well as the Party Central Committee's decisions and plans are implemented through well-coordinated, targeted, and effective efforts. More specifically, we should give play to the exemplary role of Party organizations of central Party and state organs, bolster the functions of local Party committees, take coordinated steps to improve primary-level Party organizations across all sectors, promote Party building in emerging sectors, build a strong contingent of Party members, and refine mechanisms to ensure alignment across different levels of Party organizations.

units.zh: 全会提出，正风肃纪是全面从严治党的有力举措。必须坚持党性党风党纪一起抓、正风肃纪反腐相贯通，深化运用从抓作风入手推进全面从严治党经验，不断改进作风，用严明的纪律管党治党，以良好形象凝心聚力。要走好新时代党的群众路线，锲而不舍落实中央八项规定精神，推进作风建设常态化长效化，强化从严执纪，综合发挥纪律教育约束、保障激励作用。
units.en: It was pointed out that improving conduct and tightening discipline are effective measures to advance full and rigorous Party self-governance. We must work in concert to enhance Party spirit, improve Party conduct, and tighten Party discipline, and integrate conduct improvement and discipline enforcement with anti-corruption measures. Drawing on the experience gained in advancing full and rigorous Party self-governance through conduct improvement efforts, we will ensure steady improvements in our conduct, supervise and govern the Party with strict discipline, and pool support and strength with a positive image. In practice, we will follow the Party's mass line in the new era, steadfastly implement the central Party leadership's eight-point decision on improving work conduct, put in consistent and sustained efforts to improve conduct, ensure more rigorous discipline enforcement, and make full use of discipline as a guide, restraint, guarantee, and incentive.

units.zh: 全会提出，一体推进不敢腐不能腐不想腐是全面从严治党的重要方略和反腐败斗争的基本方针。必须牢记党除了工人阶级和最广大人民群众的利益没有自己特殊的利益、党同腐败水火不容，坚定走好中国特色反腐败之路，加强党中央对反腐败工作的集中统一领导，更加注重标本兼治、系统施治，坚持从严惩、精准治、有效防、一体抓，将反腐败斗争进行到底。要保持惩治腐败高压态势，加强对权力运行的制约和监督，夯实崇廉拒腐思想根基，增强一体推进不敢腐不能腐不想腐综合效能。
units.en: It was noted that taking integrated steps to ensure that officials do not have the audacity, opportunity, or desire to commit corruption is both an important strategy for full and rigorous Party self-governance and a fundamental guideline for our fight against corruption. The Party tolerates no corruption, as it has no special interests of its own besides the interests of the working class and the greatest possible majority of the people. Keeping this firmly in mind, we must steadfastly follow a distinctive Chinese path of anti-corruption and strengthen the Party Central Committee's centralized, unified leadership over anti-corruption work. We must take systematic steps to address both symptoms and root causes of corruption and adopt a holistic approach that combines severe punishment, targeted remedy, and effective prevention, carrying this fight through to the end. While maintaining a tough stance against corruption, we should also strengthen checks on and oversight over the exercise of power, fortify the cultural-ethical foundations for championing integrity and disdaining corruption, and enhance coordinated efforts to prevent corruption by rooting out audacity, opportunity, and desire.

units.zh: 全会提出，加强党内法规制度建设是全面从严治党的长远之策、根本之策。必须坚持把党章作为全党的根本行为规范，深化党的建设制度改革，推动依法治国和依规治党有机统一，为持之以恒推进全面从严治党提供有力制度保障。要完善党内法规制度体系，增强制度执行力，大力破除潜规则。
units.en: It was noted that strengthening Party regulations and institutions represents a long-term, fundamental strategy for ensuring full and rigorous Party self-governance. We must uphold the Party Constitution as the fundamental code of conduct for all Party members, deepen institutional reforms related to Party building, and integrate law-based governance of the country and regulation-based self-governance of the Party, thus providing strong institutional support for persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance. For this purpose, stronger measures will be taken to improve the framework of Party regulations and institutions, ensure the enforcement of institutions, and eliminate hidden rules.

units.zh: 全会提出，持之以恒推进全面从严治党，必须进一步完善党和国家监督体系。要做实党委（党组）全面监督，完善纪检监察工作双重领导体制，推动党内监督同各方面监督深度融合、高效联动，发挥巡视综合监督利剑作用。
units.en: It was stated that persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance entails further improvement to Party and state oversight systems. With this in mind, we should ensure that Party committees (leading Party members groups) exercise general oversight, improve the dual leadership system for discipline inspection and supervision, pursue greater integration and efficient collaboration between intraparty oversight and other avenues of oversight, and give play to the role of inspections as a powerful tool of comprehensive oversight.

units.zh: 全会强调，持之以恒推进全面从严治党是全党的共同政治责任。必须扭住管党治党责任制“牛鼻子”，健全各负其责、统一协调的责任体系，优化责任落实考评机制，对管党治党不力、出现严重问题的严肃追责问责。
units.en: It was stressed that persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance is the common political responsibility of all Party members. Attaching crucial importance to the responsibility system for Party self-supervision and self-governance, we will establish a robust, unified system where all sides perform their respective responsibilities in close collaboration. Furthermore, relevant performance assessment mechanisms will be improved, so that those who have failed to effectively carry out Party self-supervision and self-governance and caused serious problems in this regard are strictly held to account.

units.zh: 全会指出，深入学习贯彻全会精神是当前和今后一个时期全党的重大政治任务。要深入学习领会全会精神，加强组织领导，持续在解决突出问题上下功夫，推动《决定》各项部署落到实处。
units.en: It was pointed out that studying and implementing the guiding principles from this plenary session represent a major political task for the entire Party both at present and in the period to come. With this in mind, we should fully grasp the guiding principles from the session, strengthen organization and leadership, and make tenacious efforts to solve prominent problems, seeing that all arrangements of the Resolution are implemented to the letter.

units.zh: 全会强调，要做好岁末年初各项工作。坚持稳中求进工作总基调，完整准确全面贯彻新发展理念，加快构建新发展格局，用好用足宏观政策，深入挖掘内需潜力，进一步深化改革开放，推动经济持续向新向优向好发展，确保完成今年经济社会发展主要目标任务，实现“十五五”良好开局。统筹发展和安全，加强普惠性、基础性、兜底性民生建设，做好安全生产、防灾减灾救灾、食品药品安全和社会稳定工作。巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果，结合换届抓好新任职领导班子成员特别是“一把手”的政绩观培训，教育引导他们自觉坚持立党为公、为民造福、科学决策、真抓实干，努力为人民出政绩、以实干出政绩。
units.en: It was stressed that all aspects of our work agenda should be steadily advanced at the turn of the year. To fulfill this year's main goals and tasks for economic and social development and secure a good start for the 15th Five-Year Plan period, we will adhere to the general principle of pursuing progress while ensuring stability; fully and faithfully apply the new development philosophy on all fronts; move faster to foster a new pattern of development; make full and proper use of macro policies; tap deeper into the potential of domestic demand; further deepen reform and opening up; and pursue sustained and high-quality economic growth driven by innovation. In an effort to ensure security while pursuing development, we will press ahead with initiatives to see that public services are inclusive, meet essential needs, and provide a cushion for the people most in need, and deliver better results in our work related to workplace safety, disaster prevention, mitigation, and relief, food and drug safety, as well as social stability. As part of our endeavors to consolidate and expand the progress made in the study campaign on establishing and practicing the correct view of performance, we will, in the midst of a new round of elections at all levels, step up training for new members of leadership teams, particularly their heads, on the view of performance to inspire and guide them to deliver for the people through hard work in line with the requirements of serving the public good, benefiting the people, making sound decisions, and taking solid, down-to-earth actions.

units.zh: 全会决定，中国共产党第二十一次全国代表大会于2027年下半年在北京召开。全会认为，党的二十一大是我们党在基本实现社会主义现代化的关键时期、向第二个百年奋斗目标进军新征程上召开的一次十分重要的代表大会，是党和国家政治生活中的一件大事。全党要团结带领全国各族人民万众一心、勠力进取，为基本实现社会主义现代化而共同奋斗，不断开创以中国式现代化全面推进强国建设、民族复兴伟业新局面，以实际行动迎接党的二十一大胜利召开。
units.en: The Central Committee decided at the session that the Party will convene its 21st National Congress in Beijing in the second half of 2027 and stated that this congress, which is to be held at a critical stage for basically realizing socialist modernization and on the new journey toward the Second Centenary Goal, will be a highly important meeting and an event of great political significance for both the Party and the country. The entire Party must unite and lead the Chinese people in forging ahead with one heart and one mind to achieve the goal of basically realizing socialist modernization and continue to break new ground in building a great country and advancing national rejuvenation on all fronts through Chinese modernization. With concrete actions, we will set the stage for the successful convening of this congress.

units.zh: 全会增选张升民为中央政治局委员。
units.en: At the session, Zhang Shengmin was elected member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee.

units.zh: 全会按照党章规定，决定递补中央委员会候补委员卢东亮、包钢、邢善萍、曲莹璞、吕军、朱天舒、朱国贤、刘珺、刘捷、刘强为中央委员会委员。
units.en: It was decided that, in accordance with the Party Constitution, empty seats on the Central Committee were filled by alternate members Lu Dongliang, Bao Gang, Xing Shanping, Qu Yingpu, Lv Jun, Zhu Tianshu, Zhu Guoxian, Liu Jun, Liu Jie and Liu Qiang.

units.zh: 全会审议并通过了中共中央纪律检查委员会关于马兴瑞、蓝天立、刘建超、王莉霞、金壮龙、雷凡培、易会满、王祥喜、孙绍骋、李云泽、费东斌、吴胜华、余剑锋、袁洁、张忠阳、温刚、金东寒、方红卫严重违纪违法问题的审查报告，审议并通过了中共中央军事委员会关于张又侠、刘振立、王仁华、刘青松、黄铭、李桥铭、李伟、张红兵、汪海江、张林、王鹏、刘发庆、杨诚、钟绍军、赵晓哲、方永祥严重违纪违法问题的审查报告，确认中央政治局之前作出的给予马兴瑞、张又侠、刘振立、蓝天立、刘建超、王莉霞、金壮龙、雷凡培、易会满、王祥喜、孙绍骋、王仁华、刘青松、黄铭、李桥铭、李伟、张红兵、汪海江、张林、王鹏、刘发庆、杨诚、钟绍军、赵晓哲、费东斌、吴胜华、余剑锋、袁洁、张忠阳、温刚、金东寒、方红卫、方永祥开除党籍处分，给予李云泽撤销党内职务处分。
units.en: At the session, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection's reports on the grave violations of discipline and the law involving Ma Xingrui, Lan Tianli, Liu Jianchao, Wang Lixia, Jin Zhuanglong, Lei Fanpei, Yi Huiman, Wang Xiangxi, Sun Shaocheng, Li Yunze, Fei Dongbin, Wu Shenghua, Yu Jianfeng, Yuan Jie, Zhang Zhongyang, Wen Gang, Jin Donghan and Fang Hongwei were deliberated and adopted. The Central Military Commission's reports on the grave violations of discipline and the law involving Zhang Youxia, Liu Zhenli, Wang Renhua, Liu Qingsong, Huang Ming, Li Qiaoming, Li Wei, Zhang Hongbing, Wang Haijiang, Zhang Lin, Wang Peng, Liu Faqing, Yang Cheng, Zhong Shaojun, Zhao Xiaozhe and Fang Yongxiang were also deliberated and adopted. The Political Bureau's previous decisions to expel Ma Xingrui, Zhang Youxia, Liu Zhenli, Lan Tianli, Liu Jianchao, Wang Lixia, Jin Zhuanglong, Lei Fanpei, Yi Huiman, Wang Xiangxi, Sun Shaocheng, Wang Renhua, Liu Qingsong, Huang Ming, Li Qiaoming, Li Wei, Zhang Hongbing, Wang Haijiang, Zhang Lin, Wang Peng, Liu Faqing, Yang Cheng, Zhong Shaojun, Zhao Xiaozhe, Fei Dongbin, Wu Shenghua, Yu Jianfeng, Yuan Jie, Zhang Zhongyang, Wen Gang, Jin Donghan, Fang Hongwei and Fang Yongxiang from the Party and to remove Li Yunze from his position within the Party were confirmed.

units.zh: 全会号召，全党更加紧密地团结在以习近平同志为核心的党中央周围，全面贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想，励精图治、奋发图强，持之以恒推进全面从严治党，不断开创新时代管党治党、兴党强党新局面，团结带领全国各族人民为全面建成社会主义现代化强国、以中国式现代化全面推进中华民族伟大复兴而不懈奋斗。
units.en: At the session, all Party members were called upon to rally more closely around the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core and fully implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era; forge ahead with dedication and enterprise, persevere with full and rigorous Party self-governance, and continually break new ground in supervising, governing, developing, and strengthening the Party; and unite and lead the Chinese people of all ethnic groups in a tireless effort to build China into a great modern socialist country in all respects and advance national rejuvenation on all fronts through Chinese modernization.

files.name: 20261029中共中央关于持之以恒推进全面从严治党若干重大问题的决定 中英对照

units.zh: 中共中央关于持之以恒推进全面从严治党若干重大问题的决定
units.en: Resolution of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Certain Major Issues concerning Persevering with Full and Rigorous Party Self-Governance

units.zh: （2026年10月29日中国共产党第二十届中央委员会第五次全体会议通过）
units.en: (Adopted at the fifth plenary session of the 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on October 29, 2026)

units.zh: 中国共产党第二十届中央委员会第五次全体会议总结新时代全面从严治党伟大成就和宝贵经验，分析当前和今后一个时期管党治党、兴党强党面临的形势和任务，就持之以恒推进全面从严治党若干重大问题作出如下决定。
units.en: At its fifth plenary session, the 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC) reviewed the great achievements made and valuable experience gained in exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance in the new era, and analyzed the circumstances and tasks at present and in the near future regarding how to supervise, govern, develop, and strengthen the Party. On this basis, the following resolution has been adopted.

units.zh: 一、持之以恒推进全面从严治党的重要性紧迫性和总体要求
units.en: I. Importance, Urgency, and Overall Requirements of Persevering with Full and Rigorous Self-Governance

units.zh: （一）中国共产党为人民而生、因人民而兴，成立于中华民族危亡之际，发展壮大于为实现中华民族伟大复兴而奋斗的历史进程，团结带领全国各族人民创造了新民主主义革命、社会主义革命和建设、改革开放和社会主义现代化建设、新时代中国特色社会主义的伟大成就，书写了中华民族几千年历史上最恢宏的史诗，向世界展示了坚定自信、坚强有力的马克思主义政党形象。
units.en: 1. The Communist Party of China was created for the people and has thrived because of the people. Founded at a time when the survival of the nation was at stake, the Party has grown stronger as it strives for the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. It has united and led the Chinese people of all ethnic groups in achieving great successes in the new-democratic revolution, in socialist revolution and development, in reform, opening up, and socialist modernization, and in the new era of socialism with Chinese characteristics. The Party has written the most magnificent chapter in the millennia-long history of the Chinese nation, presenting itself to the world as a confident, robust Marxist party.

units.zh: 中国共产党能够从胜利走向胜利，就在于胸怀共产主义远大理想，立志于中华民族千秋伟业，坚持为中国人民谋幸福、为中华民族谋复兴，在各个历史时期都高度重视管党治党，勇于坚持真理、修正错误，在依靠自身力量和人民支持解决自身问题中不断强大，成为党和人民事业的坚强领导核心。
units.en: The reason why the Party has achieved one victory after another is that it has cherished the high ideal of communism, dedicated itself to achieving lasting greatness for the Chinese nation, and remained committed to seeking happiness for the Chinese people and rejuvenation for the Chinese nation. It is also because during each historical period, the Party has attached great importance to its self-supervision and self-governance, had the courage to uphold truth and correct errors, and grown ever stronger by relying on its own efforts and the support of the people to resolve its own problems, thus becoming the strong leadership core in the cause of the Party and the people.

units.zh: 在革命、建设、改革中先后把党的建设作为伟大工程、新的伟大工程，党的十八大以来深入推进新时代党的建设新的伟大工程，找到“让人民来监督政府”和“自我革命”两个跳出治乱兴衰历史周期率的答案，这是中国共产党的独特创造，永载马克思主义政党建设史册。
units.en: The Party advanced Party building as a great project and then a great new project in the periods of revolution, development, and reform, and it has made further progress in this regard in the new era since its 18th National Congress. During this course, the Party has found two answers to the question of how to escape the historical cycle of rise and fall: the people’s oversight over government and the Party’s self-reform. These are the unique discoveries of the Communist Party of China, and they will forever stand out in the history of Marxist parties.

units.zh: （二）党的十八大之后，以习近平同志为核心的党中央以巨大的政治勇气和强烈的责任担当，直面一度出现党的领导弱化虚化淡化、管党治党不严不实不力、党内一些问题触目惊心的严峻现实，坚定不移全面从严治党，刀刃向内、重典治乱，持续解决突出问题，从根本上扭转了管党治党宽松软状况，刹住了一些长期没有刹住的歪风，纠治了一些多年未除的顽瘴痼疾，消除了党、国家、军队内部存在的严重隐患，党在革命性锻造中更加坚强有力。
units.en: 2. Following the Party’s 18th National Congress, the Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core demonstrated tremendous political courage and a strong sense of responsibility in confronting the grave situation marked by weak, hollow, and watered-down Party leadership, lax, superficial, and ineffective self-supervision and self-governance, as well as a number of egregious problems within the Party. Staying firmly committed to full and rigorous Party self-governance, the Central Committee introduced stringent measures and made continuous efforts to tackle these prominent issues. As a result, the problem of lax and weak self-supervision and self-governance has been addressed at its root, unhealthy tendencies that had long gone unchecked have been curbed, deep-seated problems that had plagued the Party for years have been remedied, and serious dangers hidden within the Party, the state, and the military have been removed. The Party has thus grown stronger through revolutionary tempering.

units.zh: 党的全面领导和党中央集中统一领导显著加强，党的团结统一更加巩固，党心军心民心高度凝聚；马克思主义中国化时代化实现新的飞跃，党的理论武装持续深化，全党马克思主义水平进一步提高；新时代党的组织路线贯彻有力，党的各级组织功能和党员、干部队伍素质整体提升，党的组织优势充分彰显；
units.en: Thanks to these efforts, we have significantly strengthened the Party’s overall leadership and the centralized, unified leadership of the Central Committee, reinforced the solidarity and unity of the Party, and secured great cohesion within the Party and the military and among the people. We have achieved a new breakthrough in adapting Marxism to the Chinese context and the needs of our times and continued to arm Party members with the Party’s theories, enhancing the whole Party’s understanding of Marxism. With the Party’s organizational line for the new era effectively implemented, the functions of Party organizations at all levels have been bolstered on the whole, the overall quality of Party members and officials has been improved, and the Party’s organizational strength has come to the fore.

units.zh: 中央八项规定铁律生威，纠“四风”树新风步步深入，党风政风和社会风气焕然一新；党的纪律建设扎实推进，纪律规矩更加严明，教育约束、保障激励作用日益强化；反腐败斗争力度前所未有，成效有目共睹，成功走出一条中国特色反腐败之路；党内法规制度体系更为完善，制度权威性和执行力切实增强，管党治党科学化制度化规范化水平明显提高；党的各级组织管党治党意识不断增强，责任落实见行见效，形成上下联动、齐抓共管合力。
units.en: As the central Party leadership’s eight-point decision on improving work conduct began to show its teeth as ironclad discipline, we intensified efforts to rectify pointless formalities, bureaucratism, hedonism, and extravagance (the four malpractices) while promoting sound practices. As a result, Party, government, and social conduct have all taken on an entirely new look. Steady progress has been made in strengthening Party discipline, leading to more rigorous rules and reinforcing the role of discipline as a guide, restraint, guarantee, and incentive. We have combated corruption with unprecedented intensity and produced universally recognized results, successfully blazing a distinctive Chinese path of anti-corruption. The framework of Party regulations and institutions has been further improved, with their authority and enforcement substantially enhanced, resulting in better-conceived, more institutionalized, and more procedure-based supervision and governance over the Party. With a growing awareness of self-supervision and self-governance, Party organizations at all levels have taken concrete and effective measures to fulfill their responsibilities, forming synergy through cross-level coordination and joint efforts on all sides.

units.zh: 新时代全面从严治党开辟了百年大党自我革命新境界，推动党和国家事业取得历史性成就、发生历史性变革，党和人民赢得强党强国的历史主动。
units.en: The endeavors to advance full and rigorous governance over the Party in the new era have broken new ground in the self-reform of our century-old Party and brought about historic achievements and transformations in the cause of the Party and the country. The Party and the people have thus seized the historic initiative in building a great party and a great country.

units.zh: 新时代管党治党、兴党强党取得伟大成就，中国特色社会主义事业开创崭新局面，根本在于以习近平同志为核心的党中央领航掌舵，在于习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想科学指引。
units.en: In the new era, we have made great achievements in supervising, governing, developing, and strengthening the Party and opened up new horizons for the cause of socialism with Chinese characteristics. We owe all of this to the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core, which has been at the helm charting the course, and to Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, which has provided sound guidance to our cause.

units.zh: 确立习近平同志党中央的核心、全党的核心地位，确立习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想的指导地位，是党在新时代取得的重大政治成果，对新时代党和国家事业发展、对推进中华民族伟大复兴历史进程具有决定性意义。
units.en: We have established Comrade Xi Jinping’s core position on the Party Central Committee and in the Party as a whole and the guiding role of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era. This represents a major political achievement the Party has made in the new era, and it is of decisive significance for the cause of the Party and the country in this new era and for advancing the historic process of national rejuvenation.

units.zh: 在新时代管党治党、兴党强党伟大实践中，以习近平同志为核心的党中央围绕建设什么样的长期执政的马克思主义政党、怎样建设长期执政的马克思主义政党的重大时代课题，提出一系列新理念新思想新战略，形成习近平党建思想。这一思想丰富和发展了马克思主义建党学说，是坚持把马克思主义基本原理同中国具体实际相结合、同中华优秀传统文化相结合推进党的理论创新的重大成果，是党和人民实践经验和集体智慧的结晶，是习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想的重要组成部分，为深入推进新时代党的建设新的伟大工程提供了根本遵循和行动指南。
units.en: As the Party endeavors to supervise, govern, develop, and strengthen itself in the new era, the Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core has put forward a series of new ideas, new thinking, and new strategies in response to the major questions of our times—what kind of long-term governing Marxist party we should build and how we should build it. This has culminated in Xi Jinping Thought on Party Building. This thought is a further enrichment and development based on Marxist theory on party founding, and it represents a major achievement in advancing the Party’s theoretical innovation through the integration of the basic tenets of Marxism with China’s specific realities and fine traditional culture. It stands as a crystallization of the practical experience and collective wisdom of the Party and the people. As an important component of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, it provides fundamental principles and a guide to action for further advancing the great new project of Party building in the new era.

units.zh: （三）全面从严治党永远在路上。
units.en: 3. Advancing full and rigorous self-governance as an unceasing endeavor

units.zh: 经过长期努力特别是新时代顽强奋斗，我国经济实力、科技实力、国防实力、综合国力和国际影响力显著提升，国家治理体系和治理能力现代化水平明显提高，全国各族人民更加自信、自立、自强，社会主义现代化强国建设拥有更为坚实的物质基础、更为完善的制度保证、更为主动的精神力量，管党治党、兴党强党凝聚起强大正能量，全面从严治党具备许多有利条件。同时，要清醒看到，随着世情国情党情发生深刻变化，全面从严治党也面临许多新情况新问题。
units.en: Through long-term efforts, especially our tenacious work in the new era, China’s economic strength, scientific and technological capabilities, national defense capabilities, composite national strength, and international influence have all increased significantly, and the country’s system and capacity for governance have been remarkably modernized. The Chinese people of all ethnic groups have become more confident, self-reliant, and capable of self-improvement; our endeavors to build a great modern socialist country now enjoy more solid material foundations, more robust institutional safeguards, and a source of inspiration for taking greater initiative; and tremendous positive energy has been gathered through the Party’s efforts to supervise, govern, develop, and strengthen itself. All this indicates that many favorable conditions are now in place for advancing full and rigorous Party self-governance. At the same time, we must be keenly aware that, as global, national, and Party conditions undergo profound changes, we are facing many new developments and new issues in this endeavor.

units.zh: 从国际看，世界百年未有之大变局加速演进，新一轮科技革命和产业变革加速突破，全球南方群体性崛起，国际力量对比深刻调整，单边主义、保护主义加剧，霸权主义和强权政治威胁上升，地缘冲突和局部战争持续不断，世界经济增长动能不足，全球性挑战接踵而来，世界进入新的动荡变革期，外部环境不确定难预料因素增多。党团结带领人民维护国家主权、安全、发展利益任务更加艰巨。
units.en: Internationally, momentous changes of a magnitude not seen in a century are unfolding across the world at a faster pace. Breakthroughs are accelerating in the new round of technological revolution and industrial transformation, while a profound shift is taking place in the international balance of power amid the collective rise of the Global South. Unilateralism and protectionism are mounting, hegemonism and power politics pose greater threats, geopolitical conflicts and local wars show no signs of end, and global economic growth lacks momentum. As global challenges arise one after another and the world enters a new period of turbulence and transformation, uncertainties and unforeseeable factors are increasing in our country’s external environment. All this has made the Party’s task of uniting and leading the people in safeguarding China’s sovereignty, security, and development interests even more formidable.

units.zh: 从国内看，我国发展进入基本实现社会主义现代化夯实基础、全面发力的关键时期，发展不平衡不充分问题仍然突出，人口结构、社会群体、利益格局等持续变化，数字化、网络化、智能化快速发展，社会生产生活方式和组织形式更加多样，各种思想和价值观念交织碰撞，进一步全面深化改革、推动高质量发展、加强社会建设和治理、统筹发展和安全、激发和增强社会活力等遇到不少新课题。党团结带领人民推动改革发展、维护社会和谐稳定任务更加艰巨。
units.en: Domestically, our country’s development has entered a critical period as we work to reinforce the foundations and push ahead on all fronts toward basically realizing socialist modernization. Development imbalances and inadequacies remain prominent, and demographic structure, social groups, and the pattern of interests are undergoing continuous shifts. With the rapid advances in digital, networking, and intelligent technologies, modes of production, ways of life, and forms of organization have become more diversified across society, while various ideas and values interact and collide with one another. Many new challenges have emerged in further deepening reform comprehensively, promoting high-quality development, strengthening social development and governance, ensuring both development and security, and stimulating and boosting the vitality of our society. All this has made the Party’s task of uniting and leading the people in promoting reform and development and in maintaining social harmony and stability even more formidable.

units.zh: 从党内看，党的队伍发生结构性变化，改革开放后出生的党员、干部比例越来越大，对教育管理提出新的要求。党的队伍主流是好的，但思想不纯、组织不纯、作风不纯问题尚未根本解决。部分党员、干部素质和能力不适应时代发展要求。少数党员、干部包括高级干部党性不强，理想信念动摇甚至缺失，群众感情淡薄，政绩观出现偏差，形式主义、官僚主义、享乐主义和奢靡之风严重，斗争精神不足，不担当不作为，不守纪律规矩，甚至以权谋私、腐化堕落。
units.en: Within the Party, membership is undergoing structural changes, with a steady increase in the proportion of members and officials born after the launch of reform and opening up in 1978. This has raised new requirements for education and management. The vast majority of Party members are exemplary, but the problems of defects in thinking, organization, and conduct have yet to be solved root and branch. The caliber and competence of some members and officials have not kept up with the evolving times.
