A small number of members and officials, including high-ranking officials, are performing poorly in upholding the Party spirit, wavering in or even losing their ideals and convictions; some are indifferent to the people and hold incorrect views of performance, indulging in a culture of pointless formalities, bureaucratism, hedonism, and extravagance; and some lack a fighting spirit, shirk their responsibilities or duties, and refuse to abide by discipline and rules, even going so far as to abuse power for personal gain, engage in corruption, and sink into immorality.

units.zh: 一些基层党组织政治功能和组织功能不强甚至软弱涣散，一些领域特别是新兴领域党的组织覆盖和工作覆盖不够全面、有效。一些党组织和领导干部管党治党认识不到位、责任不落实、工作不得力、制度执行不严格，不能及时发现和有效解决突出问题，甚至任由歪风邪气滋生蔓延。党保持先进性和纯洁性任务更加艰巨。
units.en: At the same time, some primary-level Party organizations have failed to effectively perform their political and organizational functions, sometimes even becoming weak and lax. In some sectors, especially emerging sectors, the coverage of Party organizations is not comprehensive enough and their work not effective enough. Some Party organizations and leading officials failed to adequately understand the importance of Party self-supervision and self-governance, fulfill responsibilities, carry out their work effectively, or enforce rules and regulations strictly. They cannot identify prominent problems as they arise or address them through effective measures, and some even leave unhealthy tendencies to grow and spread. All this has made the Party’s task of maintaining its advanced nature and integrity even more formidable.

units.zh: 这些新情况新问题，对党在新形势下的执政能力、领导水平、队伍素质、拒腐防变带来重大挑战，党面临的执政考验、改革开放考验、市场经济考验、外部环境考验和精神懈怠危险、能力不足危险、脱离群众危险、消极腐败危险是长期的、复杂的、严峻的，解决大党独有难题需要付出更加艰巨的努力。越是长期执政，越是承平日久，越是环境复杂，越要增强忧患意识、做到居安思危，把党建设好、建设强。
units.en: These new developments and issues have posed great challenges to the Party’s governance and leadership capacity, the quality of its membership, and its resistance against corruption and moral decline under the new circumstances. The Party is confronted with the protracted, complicated, and daunting task of dealing with the tests in governance, reform and opening up, the market economy, and the external environment, as well as the dangers of a lack of drive, incompetence, disengagement from the people, and inaction and corruption. Tackling these unique challenges that a large party like ours faces, therefore, calls for more arduous efforts. The long-term governance by the Party, the enduring peace China enjoys, and the complicated situations we face make it all the more important for us to be ever ready to protect against potential dangers in time of peace and make our Party more competent and stronger.

units.zh: 全党必须从巩固党的长期执政地位、实现中华民族伟大复兴的战略高度，深刻认识持之以恒推进全面从严治党的重大意义，坚定信心，保持定力，以更高标准、更实举措把新时代全面从严治党宝贵经验坚持好、运用好，把党的建设面临的突出问题整治好、解决好，把管党治党形成的良好政治局面巩固好、发展好。
units.en: All of us in the Party must gain a deep understanding of the great significance of persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance from the strategic perspective of consolidating the Party’s long-term governing position and realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. We must build firm confidence, maintain resolve, and adopt higher standards and more concrete measures to carry forward the valuable experience of full and rigorous Party self-governance in the new era, handle and resolve the prominent problems in Party building, and consolidate and develop the sound political situation formed through Party self-supervision and self-governance.

units.zh: （四）持之以恒推进全面从严治党的指导思想是：
units.en: 4. Guiding philosophy for persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance

units.zh: 坚持马克思列宁主义、毛泽东思想、邓小平理论、“三个代表”重要思想、科学发展观，全面贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想，深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想，
units.en: We must uphold Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought, Deng Xiaoping Theory, the Theory of Three Represents, and the Scientific Outlook on Development, fully implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, and thoroughly study and apply Xi Jinping Thought on Party Building.

units.zh: 围绕实现党的使命任务，落实新时代党的建设总要求，以党章为根本，坚持党的先锋队性质，坚持党的全面领导和党中央集中统一领导，
units.en: Dedicated to fulfilling the Party’s missions and tasks, we must act in line with the overall requirements for Party building in the new era, take the Party Constitution as our fundamental guide, maintain the Party’s vanguard nature, and uphold the overall leadership of the Party and the centralized, unified leadership of the Central Committee.

units.zh: 着眼于提高党的长期执政能力、保持党的先进性和纯洁性、保持党同人民群众的血肉联系，坚持严的基调不动摇，健全全面从严治党体系，以党的政治建设为统领，全面推进党的各方面建设，
units.en: We must focus on enhancing the Party’s capacity for long-term governance, preserving its advanced nature and integrity, and maintaining its close bond with the people. We will unwaveringly apply strict principles, improve the system of exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance, and take strengthening the Party politically as the overarching principle to advance Party building on all fronts.

units.zh: 充分激发全党积极性主动性创造性，不断实现党的自我净化、自我完善、自我革新、自我提高，持续增强党的政治领导力、思想引领力、群众组织力、社会号召力，
units.en: We must stimulate greater motivation, initiative, and creativity within the whole Party, continue working to purify, improve, renew, and excel ourselves, and constantly strengthen the Party’s capacity for providing political leadership, giving theoretical guidance, organizing the people, and inspiring society.

units.zh: 确保党始终成为走在时代前列、人民衷心拥护、经得起各种风浪考验、朝气蓬勃的马克思主义执政党，始终成为中国特色社会主义事业的坚强领导核心。
units.en: We will see that the Party always remains a vibrant Marxist governing party that stays at the forefront of the times, enjoys the wholehearted support of the people, and is able to withstand all tests, and that it always remains the strong leadership core in the cause of socialism with Chinese characteristics.

units.zh: （五）持之以恒推进全面从严治党遵循以下原则。
units.en: 5. Guiding principles for persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance

units.zh: ——坚持服务使命任务。不忘初心、牢记使命，从坚持和发展中国特色社会主义全局谋划和推进，使党的建设同党和国家事业紧密结合，确保始终围绕中心、服务大局。
units.en: —Serve the Party’s missions and tasks. Staying true to the Party’s original aspiration and founding mission, we should plan out and advance Party building efforts within the overall context of upholding and developing socialism with Chinese characteristics, so that such efforts are fully aligned with the cause of the Party and the country and always focus on the central task and serve the overall interests.

units.zh: ——坚持以党的政治建设为统领。坚持和加强党中央集中统一领导，推动党的各方面建设把准政治方向、落实政治要求，提高党的各级组织和党员、干部政治能力，确保全党同党中央保持高度一致，巩固党的团结统一。
units.en: —Take strengthening the Party politically as the overarching principle. We must uphold and strengthen the centralized, unified leadership of the Party Central Committee, ensure that every aspect of Party building advances in the right political direction and meets political requirements, and enhance the political competence of Party organizations at all levels as well as Party members and officials. All this will help us ensure that the whole Party is closely aligned with the Central Committee and enjoys greater solidarity and unity.

units.zh: ——坚持全面从严。强化系统观念，把严的基调、严的措施、严的氛围体现到党的建设各方面全过程，做到真管真严、敢管敢严、长管长严。
units.en: —Exercise rigorous governance across the board. We should enhance systems thinking and ensure strict principles, measures, and atmosphere in every aspect and all stages of Party building, putting in genuine, bold, and constant efforts to supervise the Party rigorously.

units.zh: ——坚持问题导向。把解决党内突出问题作为着力点，不回避矛盾，不讳疾忌医，在纠偏治乱、激浊扬清中提高工作水平。
units.en: —Adopt a problem-oriented approach. We should focus on addressing prominent problems within the Party, never evading or concealing issues, and improve our work by correcting deviations, addressing irregularities, and promoting healthy practices.

units.zh: ——坚持守正创新。坚持党的基本理论、基本路线、基本方略，遵循马克思主义执政党建设规律，运用党的建设历史经验，根据形势任务发展变化不断提出新举措新办法。
units.en: —Uphold fundamental principles and break new ground. We must adhere to the Party’s basic theory, basic line, and basic policy, follow the laws underlying the development of a Marxist governing party, and draw on the historical experience of Party building. In doing so, we will continue to put forward new measures and new methods in light of evolving circumstances and tasks.

units.zh: ——坚持以上率下。从党中央做起，从领导机关和领导干部严起，一级做给一级看、一级带着一级干，以“关键少数”示范带动“绝大多数”。
units.en: —Adhere to a top-down approach. Starting from the Central Committee, leading organs and officials should be strict with themselves, with each level setting an example for and leading the efforts of the next level below, so that leading officials, the “key few,” play an exemplary and inspiring role for the “vast majority” of Party members.

units.zh: ——坚持依规治党。把制度建设贯穿其中，注重用制度管权管事管人，严格执行党章党规党纪，以系统完备、科学规范、运行有效的党内法规制度体系增强工作效能。
units.en: —Run the Party through regulations. We should incorporate institutional building into all aspects of Party self-governance and place great emphasis on using institutions to keep power, affairs, and personnel in check. We will strictly enforce the Party Constitution, regulations, and discipline and make our work more efficient through a complete framework of Party regulations and institutions that is well-conceived, procedure-based, and effectively functioning.

units.zh: 这些原则是新时代全面从严治党经验的科学总结，必须长期坚持并不断丰富发展。
units.en: All of these principles are based on a systematic review of our experience in exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance in the new era, and they must be upheld over the long term and continually enriched and developed.

units.zh: 二、增强共产党人的党性
units.en: II. Strengthening the Party Spirit of Communists

units.zh: 增强党性是全面从严治党的根本性任务。必须推动全体党员、干部坚持党的性质和宗旨，增强党的意识、党员意识、先锋队意识，把加强党性修养作为终身课题，在坚定理想信念、铸牢对党忠诚、厚植为民情怀、坚持实事求是、纯正道德品质、保持清正廉洁等方面下功夫，做到忠诚干净担当，始终保持共产党人政治本色。
units.en: Strengthening the Party spirit represents a fundamental task in our efforts to ensure full and rigorous Party self-governance. We must, therefore, encourage all Party members and officials to uphold the Party’s nature and purpose, to raise their Party consciousness and have a better understanding of their identity as Party members and the Party’s vanguard nature, and to maintain a lifelong commitment to cultivating stronger Party spirit. We must also encourage them to remain committed to strengthening ideals and convictions, forging strong loyalty to the Party, fostering a deep affection for the people, always seeking truth from facts, building moral character, and preserving honesty and integrity. These efforts will help them to be loyal, upright, and responsible and always maintain the true political character of communists.

units.zh: （一）强化对党忠诚教育。
units.en: 1. Strengthening education on loyalty to the Party

units.zh: 坚持把对党忠诚摆在党性修养的突出位置。教育引导党员、干部
units.en: We must prioritize loyalty to the Party in cultivating the Party spirit. Education and guidance should be provided for Party members and officials so that they will:

units.zh: 深刻领悟“两个确立”的决定性意义，增强政治意识、大局意识、核心意识、看齐意识，坚定道路自信、理论自信、制度自信、文化自信，坚决维护习近平同志党中央的核心、全党的核心地位，坚决维护党中央权威和集中统一领导，始终在思想上政治上行动上同以习近平同志为核心的党中央保持高度一致。
units.en: · acquire a deep understanding of the decisive significance of establishing Comrade Xi Jinping’s core position on the Party Central Committee and in the Party as a whole and of establishing the guiding role of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era; become more conscious of the need to maintain political integrity, think in big-picture terms, follow the leadership core, and keep in alignment with the central Party leadership; remain confident in the path, theory, system, and culture of socialism with Chinese characteristics; uphold Comrade Xi Jinping’s core position on the Party Central Committee and in the Party as a whole and uphold the Central Committee’s authority and its centralized, unified leadership; and always closely follow the Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core in thinking, stance, and action;

units.zh: 教育引导党员、干部坚定对马克思主义的信仰、对共产主义的信念、对中国特色社会主义的信心，做到虔诚而执着、至信而深厚。
units.en: · reinforce their faith in Marxism, their conviction in communism, and their confidence in socialism with Chinese characteristics to ensure deep and steadfast devotion;

units.zh: 教育引导党员、干部提高政治判断力、政治领悟力、政治执行力，自觉把思想统一到党中央对形势任务的分析判断上来，不折不扣贯彻落实党中央决策部署，坚决同一切否定党的领导和中国特色社会主义制度的言行、一切违背党的理论和路线方针政策的言行、一切危害国家统一和民族团结的言行作斗争。
units.en: · enhance their capacity for political judgment, understanding, and implementation; consciously align their thinking with the Central Committee’s analysis and judgment of circumstances and tasks; fully and faithfully execute its decisions and plans; and resolutely fight against any statements or actions that repudiate leadership of the Party or the system of socialism with Chinese characteristics, that go against the Party’s theories, lines, principles, and policies, and that undermine national unity or ethnic solidarity;

units.zh: 教育引导党员、干部在党爱党、在党言党、在党忧党、在党为党，相信组织、依靠组织、服从组织，自觉接受组织管理监督，说老实话、办老实事、做老实人，做到襟怀坦荡、光明磊落、言行一致。
units.en: · love, stand for, protect, and work for the Party; trust, rely on, and defer to the Party organization and willingly accept its supervision and oversight; speak the truth, do honest work, and be genuine; and have a broad mind and an open heart and match their deeds to words;

units.zh: 教育引导党员、干部坚持人民至上、事业第一，为党和人民积极工作，做到爱岗敬业、甘于奉献。
units.en: · put the people and our cause first, work hard for the Party and the people, and remain dedicated to work and ready to make sacrifices.

units.zh: 严明党的政治纪律和政治规矩，净化党内政治生态。决不允许搞任人唯亲、排斥异己，搞团团伙伙、拉帮结派，搞匿名诬告、制造谣言，搞收买人心、拉动选票，搞封官许愿、弹冠相庆，搞自行其是、阳奉阴违，搞尾大不掉、妄议中央等“七个有之”。
units.en: We will strictly enforce the Party’s political discipline and political rules and clean up the political environment within the Party. We will never allow anyone to commit the following seven types of misconduct: engaging in cronyism and ostracizing those outside of their circle; forming self-serving cliques; anonymously lodging false accusations or fabricating rumors; seeking to buy popular support and rig elections in their own favor; promising official posts and lavishing praise on each other for their promotions; doing things their own way and feigning compliance with policies while acting counter to them; and getting too big for their boots and making presumptuous comments on the decisions of the Central Committee.

units.zh: 坚决反对思想上的自由主义、政治上的投机主义、组织上的宗派主义、工作上的本位主义、履责上的好人主义。准确识别、坚决清除两面人。
units.en: We will resolutely oppose disregard of rules in thinking, opportunism in politics, factionalism in organization, departmentalism in work, and unprincipled nice-guyism in accountability. We will accurately identify and resolutely remove double dealers from the ranks of our Party.

units.zh: （二）坚持用党的创新理论凝心铸魂。
units.en: 2. Building cohesion and inner strength with the Party’s new theories

units.zh: 加强马克思主义学习型政党建设，把学习、领悟、运用党的创新理论作为加强党性修养的根本途径，推动全党用习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想统一思想、统一意志、统一行动。
units.en: We will intensify efforts to build the Party into a Marxist party of learning, take the study, comprehension, and application of the Party’s new theories as the fundamental approach to cultivating stronger Party spirit, and help all Party members use Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era to achieve unity in thinking, will, and action.

units.zh: 深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想。丰富理论学习教育方式，突出党的创新理论在党员、干部教育培训中的主课地位，引导党员、干部读原著、学原文、悟原理，把握贯穿其中的立场观点方法，领会蕴含其中的境界情怀，在改造客观世界的同时改造主观世界，筑牢理想根基，锤炼政治品格，解决好世界观、人生观、价值观这个总开关问题。
units.en: We will thoroughly study and apply Xi Jinping Thought on Party Building. We will diversify the means of theoretical study and education and highlight the Party’s new theories as the major course in the education and training of Party members and officials. We will guide them in reading the original works, studying the original texts, and comprehending the principles to grasp the stances, viewpoints, and methods and appreciate the sagacity and nobility therein. While seeking to transform the objective world, they must also work to remold their subjective world, consolidating the foundation of their ideals, tempering their political character, and resolving the fundamental question of what kind of worldview, outlook on life, and values they should embrace.

units.zh: 弘扬马克思主义学风，推动党员、干部联系本地区本部门本单位实际和个人思想工作实际，自觉深化理论学习，运用党的创新理论分析和解决实际问题，做到学思用贯通、知信行统一。党的高级干部要按照马克思主义政治家标准要求自己，终身笃信、熟练掌握、善于运用党的创新理论。
units.en: We will promote a Marxist style of learning and encourage Party members and officials to consciously deepen theoretical study by integrating theory with the practices of their respective regions, departments, or organizations and with their own thinking and actual work. We will also encourage them to utilize the Party’s new theories to analyze and resolve practical problems, putting into practice what they have learned and acting on their beliefs. High-ranking Party officials should conduct themselves according to the standards required of Marxist statesmen, hold firm belief in the Party’s new theories in their lifetime, and be able to master and apply them with dexterity.

units.zh: 坚持和完善“第一议题”制度。提高党委（党组）理论学习中心组学习和基层党组织理论学习质量。创新实施马克思主义理论研究和建设工程，深化党的创新理论体系化学理化研究阐释。加强党史党建学科建设。
units.en: We will uphold and improve the top-of-the-agenda system. We will work to improve the quality of theoretical study within the theoretical study groups of Party committees (leading Party members groups) and within primary-level Party organizations. We will develop new approaches to implementing the project to study and develop Marxist theory and enhance systematic and academic research and interpretation of the Party’s new theories. We will also redouble efforts to develop the disciplines of Party history and Party building.

units.zh: （三）用党的优良传统和中华优秀传统文化涵养党性。
units.en: 3. Nurturing the Party spirit with the Party’s good traditions and fine traditional Chinese culture

units.zh: 深化党史、新中国史、改革开放史、社会主义发展史教育，弘扬以伟大建党精神为源头的中国共产党人精神谱系，引导党员、干部深刻感悟党的百年奋斗重大成就和历史经验，发扬党的优良作风，传承红色基因，赓续共产党人精神血脉，坚守共产党人价值观。
units.en: We will intensify education on the history of the Party, the People’s Republic of China, reform and opening up, and the development of socialism, and carry forward the long line of inspiring principles for Chinese communists that originated with the great founding spirit of the Party. We will guide Party members and officials to gain a deeper understanding of the Party’s major achievements and historical experience over the past century, promoting its exemplary conduct, passing on the traditions of revolution, keeping the spirit of communists alive, and preserving communist values.

units.zh: 挖掘用好中华优秀传统文化中讲忠信、尚气节、知廉耻、存戒惧、重自省等道德观念，深化政德教育，引导党员、干部明大德、守公德、严私德，培养家国情怀，涵养浩然正气，经得起权力、金钱、美色的考验。
units.en: We will tap into the moral principles embedded in fine traditional Chinese culture, such as valuing loyalty and honesty, honoring moral integrity, cultivating a sense of honor and shame, remaining restrained and cautious, and emphasizing self-examination, and use these principles to strengthen education on political ethics. We will guide Party members and officials to make a genuine commitment to the greater good, public morality, and personal integrity; to foster a deep dedication to both the family and the country; and to build a strong sense of righteousness to resist the temptations of power, money, and sex.

units.zh: 引导党员、干部带头读书学习。加强和改进新形势下思想政治工作，增强针对性实效性。加强党性宣传教育。发挥党校（行政学院）、干部学院在党性教育中的重要作用，完善课程体系。
units.en: We will encourage Party members and officials to take the lead in cultivating a habit of reading and learning. We will strengthen and improve theoretical and political work under the new circumstances to make it more targeted and effective. We will step up publicity and education on the Party spirit. We will leverage the instrumental role of Party schools (academies of governance) and executive leadership academies in providing Party spirit education and improve their curriculums.

units.zh: （四）在实践中锤炼党性。
units.en: 4. Tempering the Party spirit in practice

units.zh: 推动党员、干部在贯彻落实党中央决策部署、完成急难险重任务、应对重大风浪考验中锤炼党性，在处理是和非、公和私、得和失等关系中磨砺党性。
units.en: We will encourage Party members and officials to temper their Party spirit in the course of implementing the Party Central Committee’s decisions and plans, tackling urgent, difficult, dangerous, or demanding tasks, and responding to major challenges; and to hone their Party spirit in the handling of relationships between right and wrong, public and private interests, and gain and loss.

units.zh: 发挥党内政治生活锤炼党性的“大熔炉”作用，落实党内政治生活准则，用好批评和自我批评武器，增强党内政治生活的政治性、时代性、原则性、战斗性。丰富党的组织生活内容和形式，提高民主生活会和组织生活会、党支部党员大会、党支部委员会会议、党小组会、党课、主题党日等质量。严格执行党员领导干部过双重组织生活规定。
units.en: We will make the most of intraparty political life as a great melting pot in helping temper the Party spirit of our members. We will work to ensure that the code of conduct for intraparty political life is put into action, that the tools of criticism and self-criticism are effectively utilized, and that intraparty activities become more politically oriented, up-to-date, principled, and effective. We will enrich the content and forms of regular Party organization activities and enhance the quality of meetings of Party members in leadership positions, regular meetings of the Party organization, Party branch general meetings, Party branch committee meetings, Party group meetings, Party lectures, and themed Party activities. We will ensure that Party members in leadership positions participate in both their own leadership team meetings and the regular activities of the Party organization.

units.zh: 勇于揭露和纠正缺点错误，敢于同一切不良现象作斗争，反对明哲保身、当“老好人”。坚持党性原则基础上的团结，防止不讲原则的一团和气。发挥先进典型榜样作用，引导党员、干部见贤思齐、创先争优。
units.en: Party members and officials should have the courage to reveal and correct shortcomings and mistakes and fight against all unhealthy practices. We are opposed to any attempts to simply play safe or avoid offending anyone. We will uphold unity based on the commitment to the Party spirit and guard against keeping on good terms with everyone at the expense of principle. We will give full play to the exemplary role of role models, inspiring Party members and officials to learn from them and strive for excellence.

units.zh: 推动党员、干部加强党性分析，对照党章党规党纪和入党誓词经常剖析反思，不断扫灰尘、去杂质、除病毒、强免疫。坚持集中教育和经常教育相结合，着力解决党性方面存在的突出问题。
units.en: Furthermore, we will encourage Party members and officials to do better in analyzing their Party spirit, carrying out regular self-examination and reflection on their compliance with the Party Constitution, regulations, and discipline as well as the oath of admission to the Party, in order to clean up their act, purify their mind, remove negative influence, and build up immunity. We will continue to carry out both intensive and regular education, with a focus on addressing prominent problems in upholding the Party spirit.

units.zh: （五）加强党性鉴别。
units.en: 5. Enhancing Party spirit appraisal

units.zh: 把党性作为干部考察和党员民主评议的重要内容，重点了解和评议党员、干部的境界格局和忠诚度廉洁度。
units.en: We will make the Party spirit an important criterion in the examination of officials and the democratic assessment of Party members, focusing on sizing up and assessing their realm of mind as well as loyalty and integrity.

units.zh: 健全组织部门与纪检监察机关和巡视巡察、审计、信访等部门沟通机制，对领导班子成员、拟提拔干部、年轻干部等进行党性综合分析研判。
units.en: We will improve the mechanisms for organization departments to communicate with discipline inspection and supervision organs, inspection-tour agencies, audit offices, and departments handling public complaints and proposals, so as to facilitate comprehensive analysis and assessment of the members of leadership teams, candidates for promotion, and young officials regarding the Party spirit.

units.zh: 注重从应对挑战、抵御风险、克服困难、解决矛盾的表现识别党性，从日常工作、个人言行、社会交往、家教家风研判党性，通过听上级评价、同级互评、下级反映、群众口碑等了解党性。在干部选拔任用和评优评先中用好党性鉴别结果。
units.en: In assessing the Party spirit of our members and officials, particular attention should be paid to their performance in coping with challenges, managing risks, overcoming difficulties, and resolving problems; to their daily work, words and deeds, social interactions, family education, and family values; and to the evaluations from their superiors and peers, the feedback from their subordinates, and the comments from ordinary people. Party spirit appraisal results will be put to effective use in selecting and promoting officials and assessing performance for exemplary work.

units.zh: 三、严格贯彻执行民主集中制
units.en: III. Strictly Practicing Democratic Centralism

units.zh: 民主集中制是党的根本组织原则和领导制度，贯彻执行民主集中制是全面从严治党的内在要求。必须完善和落实民主集中制各项制度，充分发扬党内民主，有效实行正确的集中，更好发挥民主集中制的政治优势、组织优势、制度优势、工作优势。
units.en: Democratic centralism is the Party’s fundamental organizational principle and leadership system. Its implementation is therefore an inherent requirement for exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance. We must improve and implement the institutions of democratic centralism, giving full play to intraparty democracy while effectively practicing correct centralism. This will allow us to better draw on the political, organizational, institutional, and working strengths of democratic centralism.

units.zh: （一）坚持和加强党中央集中统一领导。
units.en: 1. Upholding and strengthening the Party Central Committee’s centralized, unified leadership

units.zh: 坚持党员个人服从党的组织、少数服从多数、下级组织服从上级组织、全党各个组织和全体党员服从党的全国代表大会和中央委员会的原则。
units.en: We must follow the principle that individual Party members defer to Party organizations, the minority defers to the majority, lower-level organizations defer to higher-level organizations, and all organizations and members of the Party defer to the National Congress and the Central Committee of the Party.

units.zh: 完善党中央集中统一领导的体制机制，确保全党令行禁止。完善党中央重大决策部署落实机制，加强跟踪督办和质效评估。严格执行向党中央请示报告制度。
units.en: We will improve the institutions and mechanisms for upholding the Party Central Committee’s centralized, unified leadership to ensure Party-wide compliance with its orders and prohibitions. We will refine the mechanisms for implementing the Central Committee’s major decisions and plans and strengthen follow-up supervision as well as quality and effectiveness evaluation. We will work to see strict compliance with the system of requesting instructions from and submitting reports to the Party Central Committee.

units.zh: 推进政治监督具体化、精准化、常态化，把党中央重大决策部署落实情况作为监督重点，及时发现和解决落实不力、变形走样问题，防止和纠治“低级红”、“高级黑”。
units.en: Further progress will be achieved in making political oversight concrete, targeted, and regular, with the focus of oversight on the implementation of the Central Committee’s major decisions and plans. During this process, we should promptly identify and address any ineffective or distorted implementation, while guarding against and rectifying over-the-top praise and veiled disparagement.

units.zh: （二）提高党内民主质量。
units.en: 2. Improving the efficacy of intraparty democracy

units.zh: 坚持和完善党内民主制度，尊重党员主体地位，保障党员民主权利。落实党的各级代表大会代表发挥作用制度。提高党的委员会、党委常委会、党组会议质量。
units.en: We must uphold and improve the systems for exercising intraparty democracy, respect the principal position of Party members, and safeguard their democratic rights. We will see that the systems for Party congress delegates across all levels to play their role are implemented and that meetings of Party committees, their standing committees, and leading Party members groups become more productive.

units.zh: 按照党章党规确定的民主原则和程序开展党的工作，领导干部不得把分管工作、分管领域和地方当作“私人领地”，个人不得凌驾于组织之上。
units.en: The Party’s work must be carried out in accordance with the democratic principles and procedures set forth in the Party Constitution and regulations, and no leading officials may treat the work, sectors, and regions under their charge as their own private territory or place themselves above the Party organization.

units.zh: 畅通党员参与讨论党内事务途径，拓展党员表达意见渠道。健全党内情况通报制度、情况反映制度。坚持党内民主平等的同志关系，营造党内民主讨论的良好氛围，鼓励和支持讲真话、讲实话、讲心里话，不得压制、排挤、打击发表不同意见的同志。
units.en: We will keep channels open for Party members to participate in the discussion of Party affairs while providing them with more avenues to express their opinions. Systems for information briefing and report submitting within the Party will be improved as well. Inside the Party, we will maintain a comradely relationship with each other based on democracy and equality, foster an atmosphere favorable for democratic discussion, and encourage and support everyone to tell the truth and speak their minds. No comrades should be suppressed, ostracized, or retaliated against for holding differing views.

units.zh: （三）严格执行领导班子决策议事规则。
units.en: 3. Strictly implementing deliberation rules and decision-making procedures for leadership teams

units.zh: 坚持集体领导和个人分工负责相结合，坚持科学决策、民主决策、依法决策，凡属重大问题必须按照集体领导、民主集中、个别酝酿、会议决定的原则，由集体讨论作出决定。
units.en: We must ensure combination of collective leadership with respective responsibility of individuals and guarantee sound, democratic, and law-based decision-making. Decisions on all major issues must be made through group discussion in accordance with the principles of collective leadership, democratic centralism, pre-meeting contemplation, and meeting-based decision-making.

units.zh: 完善党委（党组）议事规则和决策程序，加强重大决策的调查研究、科学论证、风险评估，重要议题出现较大意见分歧时不得强行作出决策。加强重大决策合规合法性审查，健全重大决策、重要人事任免、重大项目安排、大额资金使用事项监督机制。
units.en: To this end, we will refine the deliberation rules and decision-making procedures for Party committees (leading Party members groups). In regard to major decisions, we will strengthen prior investigations and studies, rationality evaluation, and risk assessment, and no decision shall be forced when major differences of opinion arise on key issues. We will step up the compliance and legality review for major decisions, while refining the mechanisms for overseeing major decisions, important appointments and dismissals, key project plans, and use of large funds.

units.zh: 领导干部要服从组织决定和组织分工，按照党中央精神和集体决策在职责范围内履职尽责，研究工作时充分发表意见，决策形成后一抓到底。
units.en: Leading officials must comply with the Party organization’s decisions and its arrangements on the division of work, fulfilling their responsibilities within the scope of their duties in accordance with guidelines of the Party Central Committee and decisions that have been made collectively. They should fully express their opinions while discussing matters and see things through once the decision is made.

units.zh: 坚决反对和防止独断专行或各自为政，坚决反对和防止议而不决、决而不行、行而不实，坚决反对和防止以党委（党组）集体决策名义集体违规或逃避责任。上级党组织作出同下级党组织有关的重要决定，一般应当事前征求下级党组织意见。健全领导干部重大决策终身负责制。
units.en: We must firmly oppose and guard against arbitrary decision-making or anyone going their own way; discussion with no decisions, decisions with no action, and action with no results; and collective rule breaking or responsibility shirking in the name of collective decision-making by Party committees (leading Party members groups). When making important decisions affecting lower-level Party organizations, higher-level Party organizations should in general solicit the opinions of lower-level Party organizations beforehand. We will also improve the lifelong accountability system for major decisions made by leading officials.

units.zh: （四）规范“一把手”履职用权。
units.en: 4. Regulating leadership team heads’ performance of duties and exercise of power

units.zh: 落实加强对“一把手”和领导班子监督的制度规定。选拔任用“一把手”注重考察贯彻执行民主集中制素养和能力。健全领导班子权力运行制约机制，规范“一把手”职责权限，执行“一把手”末位表态制。
units.en: We will work to see that institutions and regulations for strengthening oversight of leadership teams and their heads are effectively implemented. In selecting and appointing a leadership team head, emphasis should be placed on assessing candidates’ readiness and ability to practice democratic centralism. We will improve the mechanisms for applying checks on the exercise of power by leadership teams, clearly define the duties and powers of their heads, and put into full practice the system whereby the head is the last to express opinions.

units.zh: 书记专题会议不得代替党委常委会会议作出决策。党委（党组）书记必须发扬民主，认真听取不同意见，正确对待少数人意见，不搞“一言堂”、“家长制”，该由集体研究的不得擅自表态，不得用个人意见代替班子集体决定，不得擅自改变集体决定，不得层层要求维护“一把手”个人权威。
units.en: In making decisions, special meetings of Party committee secretaries may not substitute for the meetings of Party committees’ standing committees. Party committee (leading Party members group) secretaries must practice democracy, paying heed to differing opinions and treating minority views with a proper attitude. They must resist dictatorial and paternalistic styles of work. When a matter is to be deliberated collectively, leadership team heads may not overstep their authority to push their individual views; they may not replace collective decisions of the leadership team with their own opinions, arbitrarily alter collective decisions, or demand that those at subordinate levels uphold their personal authority.

units.zh: 落实“一把手”述职专题报告管理监督下级“一把手”情况制度。落实党委（党组）对下级党组织“一把手”开展监督谈话制度。
units.en: We will implement the system for leadership team heads to report on their performance in managing and supervising lower-level organizations’ leadership team heads, as well as the system for Party committees (leading Party members groups) to hold talks with lower-level Party organizations’ leadership team heads to conduct oversight.

units.zh: 完善同级监督制度机制，领导班子成员要履行维护民主集中制的政治责任、加强相互监督，发现“一把手”存在问题应当坦诚提出，发现重要问题应当向上级党组织报告。
units.en: We will also improve the institutions and mechanisms for peer oversight. Members of leadership teams should fulfill their political responsibility for upholding democratic centralism and strengthen mutual oversight. Upon discovery of problems involving the leadership team head, they should raise them frankly to the head and, if the problems are serious, report to the higher-level Party organization.

units.zh: 四、锻造堪当民族复兴重任的高素质干部队伍
units.en: IV. Cultivating High-Caliber Officials Capable of Shouldering the Mission of National Rejuvenation

units.zh: 全面从严治党关键在从严治吏。必须贯彻新时代党的组织路线，严格干部教育培养、选拔任用、管理监督，建设一支政治过硬、本领高强、作风优良、纪律严明的高素质干部队伍。
units.en: Strict management of officials is the key to full and rigorous governance over the Party. We must implement the Party’s organizational line for the new era and apply stringent standards to the education, cultivation, selection, appointment, management, and oversight of officials. With this, we will build a contingent of high-caliber officials with firm political commitment, outstanding professional competence, excellent work conduct, and strict discipline.

units.zh: （一）坚持正确用人导向。
units.en: 1. Following sound guidelines in appointing officials

units.zh: 坚持党管干部原则，坚持德才兼备、以德为先，坚持五湖四海、任人唯贤，坚持事业为上、公道正派。
units.en: We must adhere to the principle of the Party supervising officials; select officials on the basis of both integrity and ability, with greater weight given to integrity, and on the basis of merit regardless of background; and ensure that those who put the Party’s cause first and are impartial and upright get promoted.

units.zh: 落实新时代好干部标准，大力选拔任用对党忠诚、表里如一、担当尽责、实绩突出、清正廉洁的干部，坚决不用那些畏难避事、庸懒无为、作风飘浮的人，坚决清除那些对党不忠、阳奉阴违、以权谋私的人。
units.en: Applying the criteria for competent officials in the new era, we will work all out to select and appoint those who are loyal to the Party, consistent in their thinking and action, highly responsible, outstanding in their performance, honest, and upright. Under no circumstances should we select those who fear difficulties and evade responsibilities, are lazy on the job, or work superficially. Additionally, we must resolutely remove from our ranks those who lack loyalty to the Party, feign compliance, or abuse power for personal gain.

units.zh: （二）精准科学选人用人。
units.en: 2. Taking targeted, well-designed measures to select and appoint officials

units.zh: 严格执行干部选拔任用原则和程序，坚持组织选人、公正用人、以事择人，发挥党组织领导和把关作用。
units.en: We must act in full compliance with the principles and procedures for selecting and appointing officials. We will follow the principles that candidates are selected by the organization department, that officials are appointed fairly, and that selections are made in light of practical needs, with the Party organization playing its role in exercising leadership and final oversight.

units.zh: 提高干部考察质量，加强平时考核，做深做实干部政治素质考察，注重从一贯表现评价干部，从重大关头、关键时刻考察干部，从面对斗争考验、矛盾困难、歪风邪气、利益诱惑、进退留转的表现识别干部，从知重负重、扛事干事等情况观察干部。强化延伸考察，注重到原工作地方或单位考察干部，注重了解干部生活圈、社交圈，用好巡视巡察、审计、督查等成果。
units.en: We will work to improve the assessment of officials, strengthening regular evaluations and thoroughly appraising their political competence. In assessing officials, we should pay attention to their everyday behavior, place great emphasis on their performance at important junctures or critical moments, observe how they conduct themselves in the face of challenges, conflicts, difficulties, unhealthy tendencies, the temptation of benefits, and major changes to their position, and examine their willingness and ability to perform their duties and shoulder heavy responsibilities. We should assess officials on a broader scope—visiting the regions or organizations where they used to work, learning about their close contacts and social connections, and making good use of the results of inspection tours, audit, and oversight.

units.zh: 严格按照岗位职责要求选用干部，增强适配度。坚持个体强整体优、结构服从功能，选优配强各级领导班子特别是“一把手”。
units.en: We should select and appoint officials in strict accordance with position requirements, so that the right officials are placed in the right posts. In line with the principle of ensuring overall competence of both individuals and the team with its composition based on its functions, we should work to see that strong and capable leadership teams, especially their heads, are put in place at all levels.

units.zh: 坚持老中青梯次配备、统筹用好各年龄段干部，培养用好女干部、少数民族干部和党外干部，不唯年龄、学历、资历，防止只重视班子结构而忽视个体素质、只重视学历资历而忽视实际能力，防止硬性配备、降格以求。注重从基层发现和选拔优秀干部。
units.en: While working to see that officials span all age groups—senior, middle-aged, and young—and that coordinated efforts are made to bring the roles of all officials into full play, we should also pay attention to cultivating and appointing female officials, ethnic minority officials, and non-CPC officials. Meanwhile, we should refrain from taking age, education, or seniority as the only criteria for selecting officials, and avoid over-emphasizing the composition of the team to the neglect of its individual members’ competence, or valuing officials’ educational background and work experience while ignoring their practical ability. We should also guard against appointing officials in breach of rules or lowering standards for the sake of filling vacancies. Efforts should also be made to discover and select outstanding officials from the primary level.

units.zh: 健全干部任职回避、定期轮岗和交流制度。完善和落实领导干部任期制，严格执行保持任期稳定有关政策，防止同一岗位频繁调整干部、同一干部频繁调整岗位。
units.en: We will refine the system of recusal and the practice of regular rotations and exchanges regarding official positions. We will improve and implement the tenure system for leading officials, and strictly implement the policies for maintaining stability over a term of office to prevent both frequent turnover in a post and frequent transfers of a single official.

units.zh: 加强对领导班子和领导干部的分析研判，推进领导干部能上能下常态化，加大调整不胜任现职干部力度。
units.en: We will strengthen the analysis and assessment of leadership teams and leading officials, make ongoing efforts to ensure that leading officials can be demoted as well as promoted, and do more to replace those who are no longer fit for their posts.

units.zh: 坚持干部档案凡提必审，个人有关事项报告凡提必核，纪检监察机关意见凡提必听，反映违规违纪问题线索具体、有可查性的信访举报凡提必查。落实廉政意见由党委（党组）书记和纪委书记（派驻纪检监察组组长）共同签字确认的规定。完善和落实干部任前事项报告、选拔任用全程纪实、“一报告两评议”制度。
units.en: It is essential that before their promotion, candidates’ personal files are reviewed, their reports on personal information verified, opinions on them from discipline inspection and supervision organs solicited, and any specific, traceable reports as to their possible violations of Party regulations and discipline investigated. We will work to see full implementation of the regulation requiring both Party committee (leading Party members group) secretaries and discipline inspection commission secretaries (dispatched discipline inspection and supervision team leaders) to sign the appraisal regarding the candidates’ integrity in work. We will improve and implement the systems for candidates to report on personal information prior to their appointment, for recording the whole process of selecting and appointing officials, and for making annual reports and democratic appraisals regarding officials’ selection and appointment.

units.zh: 深化选人用人专项检查，健全干部“带病提拔”责任追究机制。坚决整治用人上的不正之风，严禁私相授受、任人唯亲，坚决破除“小圈子”，严肃查处跑官要官、买官卖官、拉票贿选等行为。
units.en: We will strengthen special inspections on the selection and appointment of officials and improve the mechanisms for holding to account those responsible for promoting officials with a record of poor conduct. We will take resolute action against misconduct in the appointment of officials, strictly prohibiting backroom deals and cronyism, firmly eliminating self-serving cliques, and rigorously investigating and punishing behavior such as jockeying for promotions, buying or selling official posts, and rigging elections through bribery.

units.zh: （三）推动干部树立和践行正确政绩观。
units.en: 3. Inspiring officials to foster and act on the correct view of performance

units.zh: 深化政绩观教育，引导干部坚持立党为公、为民造福、科学决策、真抓实干，创造经得起实践、人民、历史检验的实绩。
units.en: Efforts will be intensified to help officials foster the correct view of performance, guiding them in upholding the Party’s commitment to serving the public good, advancing the people’s wellbeing, ensuring sound decision-making, and delivering through solid work. In this way, they will be able to make concrete achievements that stand up in practice, in the eyes of the people, and over the course of time.

units.zh: 完整准确全面贯彻新发展理念，改进推动高质量发展政绩考核，坚持考人和考事、运用已有考核成果和任前考察相结合，深入了解分析抓改革促发展和惠民生保安全、推动当前工作和处理历史遗留问题、出显绩和重潜绩等情况。
units.en: To fully and faithfully apply the new development philosophy on all fronts, we will improve the assessment of officials’ performance in promoting high-quality development, taking into account both personal conduct and work performance, and both existing assessment results and pre-appointment evaluations. In this process, we will thoroughly examine and analyze their performance in both pursuing reform and development and ensuring the people’s wellbeing and security, both advancing present work and addressing longstanding issues, and both producing tangible results and laying intangible groundwork.

units.zh: 动态调整政绩观偏差主要问题清单，健全有效防范和纠治政绩观偏差工作机制。深入整治新官不理旧账、急功近利、弄虚作假、盲目蛮干、违背群众意愿不切实际决策、搞“形象工程”和“政绩工程”、政策规划“翻烧饼”、违规新增地方政府隐性债务、只讲发展不讲安全等问题。深化不作为、乱作为问题整治。健全领导班子主要负责人变动交接制度。
units.en: We will adjust as necessary lists of main issues arising from misguided views of performance and develop effective mechanisms to guard against and rectify such misguided views. We will continue to address problems such as new officials ignoring obligations undertaken by predecessors, seeking quick success and instant benefit, conducting fraudulent activities, engaging in rash and reckless behavior, making unrealistic decisions in disregard of public will, undertaking vanity and showcase projects, flip-flopping on policies and plans, incurring new hidden local government debt in violation of regulations, and overlooking security in the pursuit of development. Efforts will also be stepped up to address problems of officials failing to fulfill their duties or acting arbitrarily. The handover system for the heads of leadership teams will be improved.

units.zh: （四）增强干部干事创业本领。
units.en: 4. Enhancing officials’ competence in fulfilling their duties and breaking new ground

units.zh: 加强干部思想淬炼、政治历练、实践锻炼、专业训练，增强推动高质量发展本领、服务群众本领、防范化解风险本领、运用法治思维和法治方式开展工作本领，加强斗争精神和斗争本领养成。
units.en: We will provide officials with more opportunities to refine their thinking, gain political experience, hone their skills in practice, and receive professional training, so that they become more capable of advancing high-quality development, serving the people, guarding against and defusing risks, and applying law-based thinking and approaches in their work, while building stronger fighting spirit and ability.

units.zh: 推动干部尤其是领导干部深入调查研究，结合实际谋划思路、解决问题、改进工作。推动干部加快知识更新，提高专业素养，补齐能力短板，成为本职工作的行家里手。推动干部在实践中总结经验、把握规律，增强工作的原则性、系统性、预见性、创造性。
units.en: We will encourage officials, especially leading officials, to carry out in-depth research to help them develop plans, solve problems, and improve their work in light of actual conditions. We will support them in updating their knowledge quickly, enhancing their professional competence, and shoring up weaknesses in ability to become highly proficient in fulfilling their duties. We will also encourage them to sum up practical experience and grasp the underlying patterns, thereby making their work more principled, systematic, forward-looking, and creative.

units.zh: （五）提高培养选拔优秀年轻干部质量。
units.en: 5. Improving the training and selection of outstanding young officials

units.zh: 健全培养选拔优秀年轻干部常态化工作机制。加强政治培养和政治历练，引导年轻干部筑牢信仰之基、补足精神之钙、把稳思想之舵。把基层一线作为培养年轻干部的基础阵地，推动年轻干部到艰苦地区、复杂环境、吃劲岗位墩苗锻炼，砥砺品质、改进作风、增长才干。
units.en: We will improve the regular working mechanisms for training and selecting promising young officials. We will strengthen their political training and tempering to help them reinforce their convictions and replenish the mental nourishment they need to stay on the right path. With primary-level positions serving as a basic training platform, young officials will be encouraged to work in areas with harsh conditions or complex circumstances and take up demanding posts in order to build character, improve conduct, and hone their skills.

units.zh: 坚持培养和管理并重，引导年轻干部走健康成长之路，服从组织安排，乐于实干苦干，不心浮气躁、好高骛远，不搞自我设计、走捷径。跟踪了解年轻干部学习理论、参加党内政治生活、担当作为、承压抗压、遵规守纪等情况，加强成长指导。防止和纠正“拔苗助长”等做法。
units.en: Giving equal weight to training and management, we will guide the healthy growth of young officials to see they defer to the arrangements of their organizations, dedicate themselves to hard work, and refrain from pursuing impetuous, unrealistic ambitions or taking self-contrived career shortcuts. More guidance will be provided for their growth by following their performance in engaging in theoretical study, participating in intraparty political activities, taking on responsibilities, working under pressure, and observing rules and discipline. Practices such as forcing premature advancement must be prevented and corrected.

units.zh: （六）加强干部管理监督。
units.en: 6. Strengthening management and oversight of officials

units.zh: 坚持从高级干部抓起，加强干部全方位管理和经常性监督，把严的要求贯穿干部成长全周期、教育管理监督全过程，防止重选轻管。
units.en: Starting with high-ranking officials, we will tighten all-around management and regular oversight of officials, imposing strict requirements throughout their career and across the whole process of their education, management, and oversight to avoid over-emphasizing selection to the neglect of management.

units.zh: 坚持从高级干部抓起，加强干部全方位管理和经常性监督，把严的要求贯穿干部成长全周期、教育管理监督全过程，防止重选轻管。完善领导干部个人有关事项报告制度，对家庭财产和支出明显超出正常收入的进行查核验证。加强领导干部配偶、子女及其配偶经商办企业常态化管理。深化“近亲繁殖”问题专项整治。
units.en: The system requiring leading officials to report personal information will be refined. Those with family property and spending far exceeding their normal incomes will be examined, and relevant verifications will be carried out. Regular management will be tightened for the commercial and entrepreneurial activities of leading officials’ spouses, children, and their children’s spouses. Dedicated efforts will be intensified to address nepotism.

units.zh: 加强对人事招录工作的管理监督。规范干部兼职、挂职、离职从业行为，防止和整治“逃逸式辞职”。加强退休干部管理监督。
units.en: We will strengthen management and oversight of personnel recruitment. We will regulate practices involving officials who take up part-time work, are assigned to temporary posts, or start new jobs after leaving public office, while guarding against and addressing cases of resignation or early retirement aimed at escaping punishment for violating Party discipline or state laws. Management and oversight of retired officials will also be tightened.

units.zh: 党的各级组织和领导干部必须敢抓敢管、严管严治，不得对干部的错误言行听之任之、遮丑护短。制定干部管理监督工作条例。
units.en: Party organizations and leading officials at all levels must have the courage and resolve to carry out strict supervision; they must not knowingly let officials’ erroneous remarks and actions go unaddressed, or even cover up for them. Regulations on the management and oversight of officials will be formulated.

units.zh: 坚持严管厚爱结合、激励约束并重，健全干部担当作为激励和保护机制，为担当者担当、为负责者负责、为干事者撑腰。落实谈心谈话制度，及时了解干部思想动态、工作状态、身心健康状况、家庭情况等，有针对性加强教育引导。加强和改进公务员工作，发挥职务与职级并行等制度激励效应，健全表彰奖励机制。落实关心关爱基层干部各项政策。
units.en: We should be strict with and also care for our officials, and place equal emphasis on providing incentives and imposing constraints. We will improve the mechanisms for encouraging and protecting responsible and enterprising officials, giving support to those who assume responsibilities and do solid work. The system for having candid talks with officials will be fully implemented to gain an up-to-date understanding of their thoughts, work progress, physical and mental health, and family conditions, which will allow us to provide more targeted education and guidance for them. We will strengthen and improve our work related to civil servants, fully utilizing institutional incentives such as salary and benefits based on both positions and ranks and refining the mechanisms for commendation and reward. We will work to see full implementation of policies designed to provide support and care for those working on the ground. 坚持党管人才原则，加强对人才的政治引领和政治吸纳，深化人才发展体制机制改革，一体推进教育科技人才发展，全方位培养、引进、用好人才，强化人才支持和服务保障，激励广大人才爱党报国、敬业奉献、服务人民，把各方面优秀人才集聚到党和人民事业中来。Upholding the principle of the Party managing talent, we will provide better political guidance for them and create more opportunities for their political participation. We will deepen institutional reforms to facilitate talent development, advance integrated development of education, science and technology, and talent, and promote the training, recruitment, and utilization of talented people across the board. We will ramp up support and services for talent and encourage them to love the Party, dedicate themselves to the country, contribute to its cause, and serve the people, bringing together the brightest minds from all fields to advance the cause of the Party and the people.

units.zh: 落实党委联系服务专家制度，健全领导干部直接联系服务专家工作机制。引导人才队伍中的党员在科研攻关、培养后学、团结协作、学术诚信、科技伦理等方面发挥模范作用，反对学术造假、抄袭剽窃等学术不端行为，抵制急功近利、浮躁浮夸等不良风气。整治人才“帽子”问题，破除论资排辈、圈子文化、学阀作风。
units.en: The system for Party committees to engage with and serve experts will be put into full practice, and working mechanisms will be refined to enable leading officials to stay in contact with experts and provide services they need. We will encourage talent with Party membership to lead by example in pursuing breakthroughs in research, cultivating younger generations, promoting unity and teamwork, upholding academic integrity, and adhering to scientific and technological ethics. We will oppose academic misconduct, such as fraudulence and plagiarism, and discourage unhealthy tendencies toward seeking quick success and instant benefit or getting frivolous and pretentious in academic work. We will also address problems associated with honorary titles for talent and eliminate the practices of over-emphasizing seniority, forming self-serving factions, and acting as scholar-tyrants.

units.zh: 五、建设上下贯通、执行有力的严密组织体系
units.en: V. Building a Well-Knit Organizational System Characterized by Cross-Level Alignment and Effective Implementation

units.zh: 党的各级组织是全面从严治党的主体。必须体系化推进各层级各领域党组织建设，强化党组织政治功能和组织功能，确保贯彻落实党的路线方针政策和党中央决策部署上下协同、精准高效。
units.en: Party organizations at all levels play the principal role in exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance. It is therefore essential to systematically advance the development of Party organizations at all levels and in all sectors to strengthen their political and organizational functions. This will help ensure that the Party’s lines, principles, and policies and the Central Committee’s decisions and plans are implemented through well-coordinated, targeted, and effective efforts.

units.zh: （一）发挥中央和国家机关党组织表率作用。
units.en: 1. Giving play to the exemplary role of Party organizations of central Party and state organs

units.zh: 深化政治机关建设，推动中央和国家机关各级党组织和党员、干部走好第一方阵，在深入学习贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想上作表率、在始终同以习近平同志为核心的党中央保持高度一致上作表率、在坚决贯彻落实党中央各项决策部署上作表率，把中央和国家机关建设成为讲政治、守纪律、负责任、有效率的模范机关。
units.en: To strengthen the role of central Party and state organs as political institutions, we will guide their Party organizations at all levels as well as their Party members and officials to stay at the forefront of this endeavor and set a good example in thoroughly studying and applying Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, in closely following the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core, and in resolutely implementing all of the Party Central Committee’s decisions and plans. In doing so, these organs will build themselves into models of political integrity, discipline, responsibility, and efficiency.

units.zh: 坚持抓机关带系统、管行业管党建，健全机关、直属企事业单位、派出机构党建工作同步推进机制，深化政治功能强、支部班子强、党员队伍强、作用发挥强党支部建设。
units.en: We will promote Party building initiatives in central Party and state organs to drive progress across all institutions of the same category, while combining their supervision over respective sectors with Party building efforts. As part of this, we will improve the mechanisms for simultaneously advancing Party building in these organs, in the enterprises and public institutions directly under them, and in their dispatched offices. We will continue to develop Party branches with a strong political function, a strong leadership team, a strong contingent of members, and a strong role to play.

units.zh: 推动党建和业务深度融合，持续破解“两张皮”。力戒“机关病”和“衙门作风”，防止“灯下黑”。
units.en: We will promote deeper integration of Party building initiatives with professional work, devoting continuous efforts to addressing the issue of disconnection between the two. We must do everything possible to avoid bureaucratic styles of work and other maladies of government conduct, and guard against “darkness under the lamp”—the danger of being blind to one’s own problems.

units.zh: （二）强化地方党委功能。
units.en: 2. Bolstering the functions of local Party committees

units.zh: 坚持地方党委在本地区发挥总揽全局、协调各方的领导作用，履行把方向、管大局、作决策、保落实职责，把地方党委建设成为坚决听从党中央指挥、执行有力、管理严格、班子团结、风气纯正的坚强组织。
units.en: Local Party committees must, in their respective localities, assume the role of exercising overall leadership and coordinating the efforts of all sides, and fulfill their duties of charting the course, keeping the bigger picture in mind, making decisions, and ensuring implementation. They should turn themselves into staunch organizations that resolutely follow the command of the Central Committee and are able to ensure effective implementation, strict management, leadership team cohesion, and an atmosphere of integrity.

units.zh: 鼓励和支持地方党委结合实际贯彻落实党中央精神，创造性开展工作。推动地方党委常委会建强班子、严管队伍，经常开展政治体检，提高发现和解决自身问题能力。修订地方党委工作条例。规范地方党委议事协调机构。
units.en: We will encourage and provide support for local Party committees to apply the guiding principles of the Central Committee in light of actual conditions and carry out their work creatively. We will work to ensure that the standing committees of local Party committees build strong leadership teams, enforce strict discipline over Party members, conduct political “health checks” on a regular basis, and enhance their ability to identify and resolve their own problems. The regulations on the work of local Party committees will be revised, and the deliberative and coordinating bodies of these committees will be standardized.

units.zh: （三）统筹推进各领域基层党组织建设。
units.en: 3. Taking coordinated steps to improve primary-level Party organizations across all sectors

units.zh: 强化大抓基层鲜明导向，坚持补短板、填空白和提质量、强功能并举，把基层党组织建设成为有效实现党的领导的坚强战斗堡垒。
units.en: With a clear focus on reinforcing Party organizations at the primary level, we will place equal emphasis on addressing weaknesses and filling gaps on the one hand and improving quality and bolstering functions on the other. These measures will help primary-level Party organizations play a key role in ensuring effective exercise of the Party’s leadership.

units.zh: 深入推进抓党建促乡村全面振兴，加强乡镇党委和村党组织建设，提高村干部教育管理水平，优化驻村第一书记和工作队选派管理。做实“空心村”党建工作。
units.en: We will continue to promote all-around rural revitalization through Party building initiatives, which include strengthening town and township Party committees and village Party organizations, improving the training and management of village officials, and optimizing the dispatch and management of first secretaries and work teams stationed in villages. Solid efforts will be made to strengthen Party building in hollowed-out villages.

units.zh: 加强城市街道、社区党建工作，建好建强居民小区党组织，探索社区党组织领导下的居委会、业委会、物业服务企业协调运行新模式。加强“超大社区”党组织建设。推进开发区（园区）党的建设。
units.en: We will improve Party building in urban sub-districts and communities by establishing robust Party organizations in residential communities and exploring new models for enhancing coordination between residents’ committees, homeowners’ committees, and property service enterprises under the leadership of community Party organizations. Party organizations in super-large communities will also be strengthened. We will advance Party building in development zones and industrial parks as well as at the primary level in border areas.

units.zh: 加强边境地区基层党建工作。深化党建引领基层治理和基层政权建设，坚持和发展新时代“枫桥经验”，健全党组织领导的自治、法治、德治相结合的城乡基层治理体系。整合优化网格治理服务，发挥党群服务中心作用，拓宽基层组织和群众依法有序参与基层治理渠道。
units.en: We will better guide efforts to conduct community-level governance and strengthen primary-level governments through Party building, continue to apply and develop the Fengqiao model in the new era, and refine the Party organization-led urban and rural community governance system that combines self-governance, the rule of law, and the rule of virtue. Other measures include the integration and improvement of grid-based governance and services, the effective utilization of public service centers of the Party, and the creation of more channels for law-based, well-ordered participation of primary-level organizations and ordinary people in the governance of their communities.

units.zh: 全面提高机关党建质量，抓好所属单位、行业党建工作。完善事业单位党的领导体制机制，推进学校、医院、科研院所等党建工作。加强国有企业、国有金融企业党的领导，强化党委（党组）前置研究讨论重大经营管理事项实质性把关，完善公司治理，提升党建工作质效。
units.en: Party building will be improved across the board in Party and state institutions as well as in their affiliated organizations and industries. We will refine the systems and mechanisms for Party leadership in public institutions, and advance Party building in schools, hospitals, and research institutes. We will strengthen Party leadership in state-owned enterprises and state-owned financial enterprises, and bolster the role of Party committees (leading Party members groups) in conducting substantive review of major operational and management matters through ex-ante study and discussion, with a view to improving corporate governance and enhancing the quality and effectiveness of their Party building efforts.

units.zh: 坚持集中和常态相结合，整顿软弱涣散基层党组织。加强基层党组织负责人培养选拔和教育培训。推动资源服务管理下沉、政策向基层倾斜，改善基层工作条件。坚持党建带群建，发挥群团组织桥梁纽带作用。
units.en: In order to straighten out weak and lax Party organizations at the primary level, we will carry out both intensive and regular initiatives. Greater efforts will be made to cultivate, select, educate, and train heads of primary-level Party organizations. We will channel more resources, services, as well as management and policy support to the primary level and improve working conditions there. We will ensure that Party building endeavors guide the development of people’s organizations, seeing that these organizations fully play their role as a bridge connecting the Party and the people.

units.zh: （四）突出抓好新兴领域党的建设。
units.en: 4. Promoting Party building in emerging sectors

units.zh: 分类完善新兴领域党建管理体制和责任体系，压实行业管理和业务监管部门、业务主管单位及属地等责任，增强党在新兴领域号召力凝聚力影响力。
units.en: Management and responsibility systems for Party building in emerging sectors will be improved by category to ensure that industry regulatory and business supervisory departments, business administrative authorities, and local governments fulfill their respective responsibilities. In doing so, we will enhance the Party’s capacity to inspire, rally, and influence in these sectors.

units.zh: 深化拓展新经济组织、新社会组织、新就业群体党的组织覆盖和工作覆盖，选优配强党组织书记，改进党建工作指导员选派，促进党建工作同生产经营、创新创业、社会服务、基层治理等有机结合。
units.en: In new types of economic and social organizations and among groups in new forms of employment, the coverage of Party organizations and Party work will be further expanded. Capable secretaries will be put in place in Party organizations, and competent personnel will be sent to provide guidance on Party building. These efforts will contribute to the effective combination of Party building initiatives with production and operations, innovation and entrepreneurship, social services, and community-level governance.

units.zh: 巩固提升非公有制企业党建工作，分类推进混合所有制企业党建工作，加强平台企业、科技创新型企业等党建工作，建立互联网企业党组织提级管理动态调整机制，推动落实党建责任。
units.en: Party building efforts will be consolidated and enhanced in non-public businesses, advanced on a per-category basis in mixed-ownership enterprises, and bolstered in platform companies and innovative high-tech firms. A dynamic adjustment mechanism for higher-level management of Party organizations in internet companies will be established. All this will help ensure the fulfillment of Party building responsibilities.

units.zh: 分类指导新社会组织党建工作，完善行业协会、学会、商会管理制度和运行机制，全面落实党建工作要求写入章程，强化党建引领行业自律。
units.en: Categorized guidance on Party building will be provided to new types of social organizations. To strengthen industry self-discipline through Party building initiatives, the management systems and operational mechanisms for trade associations, academic societies, and chambers of commerce will be refined and Party building requirements will be incorporated in their charters across the board.

units.zh: 做好民办学校、民营医院等党建工作。加强新就业群体党建工作，强化思想政治引领，做好服务管理，保障合法权益，引导新就业群体听党话、跟党走。
units.en: Due attention will be given to Party building in private schools and hospitals. We will improve Party building among groups in new forms of employment, strengthening theoretical and political guidance, providing better services and management, and safeguarding their legitimate rights and interests. With this, we will inspire people in these groups to heed the Party’s call and follow its lead.

units.zh: （五）加强党员队伍建设。
units.en: 5. Building a strong contingent of Party members

units.zh: 坚持把政治标准放在首位，严格程序、严格把关、严肃纪律，提高发展党员质量，防止动机不纯的人入党。注重从青年和产业工人、农民、知识分子中发展党员，做好在新兴领域中发展党员工作，优化党员队伍结构。
units.en: In admitting new Party members, evaluation of candidates’ political integrity takes priority. It is essential to closely follow standard procedures, apply stringent criteria, and observe a strict code of discipline, so as to ensure that only those who are qualified join the Party while people with impure motives are not admitted. We will emphasize recruiting new members from young people, industrial workers, farmers, and intellectuals, pay particular attention to admitting qualified members from emerging sectors, and work to improve the composition of Party membership.

units.zh: 强化党员教育管理，开展党员常态化培训特别是基本培训。落实党支部直接教育管理监督党员职责。加强党员网络行为管理。常态化开展流动党员登记、接收工作，健全流出地和流入地党组织协作共管、线上线下结合的制度。
units.en: We will better educate and manage Party members and provide them with regular training, especially basic training. We will see to it that Party branches fulfill their responsibilities in directly educating, managing, and overseeing their members. We will better regulate the online behavior of Party members. The registration and acceptance of Party members among the floating population will be conducted on a regular basis, with relevant systems being refined to coordinate the management of such members by their previous and current Party organizations through both online and offline means.

units.zh: 推行设岗定责、承诺践诺、成立突击队、亮身份当先锋等做法，完善和落实党员网下和网上、在岗和离岗、平时和应急作用发挥机制。完善党内激励关怀帮扶机制。严肃稳妥处置不合格党员。
units.en: Among Party members, we will promote good practices such as assigning clear duties to those with no specific positions, making and delivering on promises, setting up taskforces to deal with emergencies, and standing out and playing a pioneering role when needed. We will also improve and put into effect the mechanisms for Party members to play their roles whether online or offline, on duty or off duty, and in normal or emergency circumstances. Mechanisms for providing incentives, care, and assistance for Party members will be refined. We will rigorously yet prudently handle Party members who do not measure up to standards.

units.zh: （六）完善党的各级组织贯通机制。
units.en: 6. Refining mechanisms to ensure alignment across different levels of Party organizations

units.zh: 健全上级部署传达落实、基层情况向上反映、矛盾问题协同解决的工作机制。
units.en: It is essential to develop a sound working mechanism to ensure that plans made by higher-level Party organizations are handed down and put into action, situations on the ground are reported to higher-level Party organizations, and conflicts and problems are resolved through coordinated efforts.

units.zh: 完善属地管理和垂直管理的党建工作体系，推动条块结合、各负其责、紧密衔接。加大上级组织对下级组织党建工作指导力度，总结推广经验。做实党委（党组）书记抓基层党建工作述职评议考核。
units.en: We will improve the system for Party building work that combines local management with vertical management, so that all departments and localities work in concert, fulfill their respective responsibilities, and maintain close alignment. Higher-level Party organizations will provide more guidance on Party building to lower-level Party organizations, and successful practices will be summarized and promoted. We will work to ensure that secretaries of Party committees (leading Party members groups) report on their performance in advancing primary-level Party building and are subject to assessment thereof.

units.zh: 加强党务工作者队伍建设，配齐配强力量，提供必要保障。坚持抓好本级、带动下级，层层抓落实，推动党的各级组织全面进步、全面过硬，防止责任悬空和上推下卸。
units.en: We will build up the ranks of Party affairs workers, staff Party organizations with adequate and competent personnel, and provide necessary support. We will work to see that Party organizations fulfill their own duties while inspiring lower-level organizations to follow suit, so as to ensure concrete implementation efforts at every level. Through these efforts, we will promote the all-around progress of Party organizations at all levels and strengthen their competence across the board, while avoiding vacuums of responsibility or shifting of blame.

units.zh: 六、驰而不息正风肃纪
units.en: VI. Improving Conduct and Tightening Discipline on an Ongoing Basis

units.zh: 正风肃纪是全面从严治党的有力举措。必须坚持党性党风党纪一起抓、正风肃纪反腐相贯通，深化运用从抓作风入手推进全面从严治党经验，不断改进作风，用严明的纪律管党治党，以良好形象凝心聚力。
units.en: Improving conduct and tightening discipline are effective measures to advance full and rigorous Party self-governance. We must work in concert to enhance the Party spirit, build good Party conduct, and enforce strict Party discipline, integrating efforts to improve conduct and enforce discipline with anti-corruption measures. We will fully leverage the experience gained in advancing full and rigorous self-governance by targeting conduct issues to further improve conduct, supervise and govern the Party with strict discipline, and build cohesion and strength with a positive image.

units.zh: （一）走好新时代党的群众路线。
units.en: 1. Following the Party’s mass line in the new era

units.zh: 深化马克思主义群众观点和党的群众路线教育，引导党员、干部强化宗旨意识、公仆意识，站稳人民立场，增进同群众的感情，防止高高在上、脱离群众。引导党员、干部把握新时代党的群众工作特点和规律，经常深入群众，虚心听取意见，认真解决急难愁盼问题，善于依靠群众力量做好工作、化解矛盾，在服务群众中教育引导群众、带领群众前进，防止和克服命令主义、“尾巴主义”。
units.en: We will continue to raise awareness of the Marxist viewpoint on the people and the Party’s mass line and guide Party members and officials in attaining a stronger sense of the Party’s fundamental purpose and sense of service to the people, so that they stand firmly with the people and strengthen their bond with them instead of standing aloof and becoming detached from them. We will also guide Party members and officials in grasping the features of and the laws governing the work of engaging with the people in the new era and see that they reach out to the people regularly, listen to their opinions with an open mind, and work earnestly to address the pressing difficulties and problems that concern them most. They should enhance their capacity to fulfill duties and resolve problems by rallying the people, educate, guide, and lead the people forward while serving them, and at the same time, prevent and overcome overbearing commandism and passive tailism.

units.zh: 落实涉及民生重大决策征求群众意见制度。落实领导干部宣传党的路线方针政策下基层、调查研究下基层、信访接待下基层、现场办公下基层制度，落实党员、干部直接联系服务群众制度。
units.en: The system of soliciting public opinion on major decisions related to people’s wellbeing will be fully implemented. We will promote the practices of leading officials going into communities to communicate the Party’s lines, principles, and policies, carry out research and studies, address people’s complaints, and handle matters on-site. The system for Party members and officials to engage with and serve the people directly will also be implemented.

units.zh: 推动党员、干部带头参与志愿服务，开展结对帮扶。持续抓好民生领域信访问题化解。走好网上群众路线，增强党组织通过互联网组织群众、宣传群众、凝聚群众、服务群众的能力，提高党员、干部做网上群众工作的本领。
units.en: We will encourage Party members and officials to lead the way in participating in volunteer services and provide paired assistance. Sustained efforts will be made to handle complaints and proposals concerning public wellbeing. To strengthen online engagement with the public, Party organizations should enhance their capacity to organize, communicate with, rally, and serve the people through the internet, and Party members and officials should also hone their skills for online public outreach.

units.zh: （二）锲而不舍落实中央八项规定精神。
units.en: 2. Steadfastly implementing the guiding principles from the central Party leadership’s eight-point decision on improving work conduct

units.zh: 把中央八项规定作为必须长期坚持的铁规矩、硬杠杠，巩固拓展深入贯彻中央八项规定精神学习教育成果，完善和落实中央八项规定实施细则，深化整治形式主义、官僚主义顽疾，坚决防止享乐主义和奢靡之风反弹回潮，坚决破除特权思想和特权行为。
units.en: The central Party leadership’s eight-point decision on improving work conduct is a hard-and-fast rule that must be followed in the long run. We will consolidate and build on what we have achieved in the study campaign for fully implementing the guiding principles from the eight-point decision, while also refining and enforcing the detailed rules for implementing the decision. We will continue to rectify pointless formalities and bureaucratism, resolutely guard against recurrences of hedonism and extravagance, and act with firm resolve to root out privilege-seeking mindsets and behavior.

units.zh: 精简会议、文件、报送材料，落实“短实新”要求，改进会风文风。未经组织批准，党政领导干部不得公开出版个人著作。严格执行领导干部出访规定，不得安排照顾性出访。
units.en: We will continue to streamline meetings, documents, and written materials and make them shorter, more substantive, and full of new ideas, so as to improve our meeting culture and writing styles. Party and government leading officials will not be allowed to publish their books without the approval of their organization. The regulations on official overseas visits of leading officials must be strictly observed, and no such visits shall be arranged as a benefit.

units.zh: 推进整治形式主义为基层减负，统筹规范督查检查考核，规范创建示范、达标和评比表彰活动，清理规范节庆展会论坛活动，整治“指尖上的形式主义”，落实乡镇（街道）履行职责事项清单，健全村（社区）工作事项准入制度。
units.en: In our efforts to further rectify pointless formalities to reduce burden on those working on the ground, we will take the following measures: ensuring that supervision, inspection, and evaluation activities are better coordinated and regulated; regulating demonstration initiatives, standards inspections, evaluations, and commendations; overhauling and regulating festival celebrations, expositions, exhibitions, and forums; rectifying pointless formalities on digital platforms; implementing the lists of duties for town, township, and urban sub-district governments; and refining the system for matters delegated to villages and urban communities.

units.zh: 持续整治违规吃喝、违规收送礼品礼金、侵害群众利益等突出问题。厉行节约、反对浪费，坚持党政机关过紧日子，从紧控制“三公”经费，严格控制新建楼堂馆所。
units.en: We will continue to address prominent problems such as banqueting and giving or receiving gifts and money in violation of regulations and other forms of misconduct that harms the people’s interests. We must practice thrift and oppose waste, require Party and government organs to tighten their belts, strictly control spending on official overseas visits, official vehicles, and official hospitality, and impose rigorous restrictions on the construction of new office buildings.

units.zh: 紧盯不正之风新动向新表现，防范和纠治隐形变异问题。
units.en: We will also keep a close watch on the new developments and new manifestations of unhealthy tendencies and guard against and address them whether hidden or in disguise.

units.zh: （三）推进作风建设常态化长效化。
units.en: 3. Devoting consistent and sustained efforts to improving conduct

units.zh: 把作风建设融入日常、抓在经常，防止消极应付和疲劳厌战，纠正作风问题“小节论”、“特殊论”。
units.en: We will make conduct building part of our daily work, guard against perfunctory behavior or loss of drive, and correct the misguided views of downplaying misconduct as a minor personal issue or justifying it on the pretext of exception.

units.zh: 完善经常性发现和解决作风问题机制，加强对“四风”突出问题分析研判和靶向整治。
units.en: We will refine the mechanisms for constantly identifying and resolving problems of misconduct, with more efforts devoted to analyzing, assessing, and taking targeted measures against prominent problems involving the four malpractices.

units.zh: 把握地区性、行业性、阶段性特点，整治普遍发生、反复出现的作风问题。紧盯重要节点，加强监督检查，对顶风违纪行为从严查处，对典型案件通报曝光。
units.en: We will work to address prevalent and recurrent misconduct specific to certain regions, sectors, and stages of development. Focusing on key junctures, we will enhance oversight and inspection, strictly investigate and punish those defiantly violating discipline, and expose typical cases.

units.zh: 落实行业主管部门管行风责任，加强行风动态分析和有效监管，抓好师德师风、医德医风、艺德艺风建设，加大国有企业、国有金融企业和垂直管理单位地方分支机构等的“四风”问题治理力度。规范涉企执法司法行为。
units.en: Competent authorities should assume their responsibilities for supervising work conduct in their respective sectors, strengthening dynamic analysis and effective regulation. Particular attention will be paid to cultivating professional integrity and good conduct among teachers, medical workers, and artists, and more efforts will be put into addressing the four malpractices within state-owned enterprises, state-owned financial enterprises, and local branches of organizations under vertical management. Enterprise-related law enforcement and judicial administration will also be better regulated.

units.zh: 深化风腐同查同治，深挖“四风”背后的团团伙伙、请托办事、利益输送等问题，查清腐败案件中的作风问题。
units.en: We will continue to investigate and address both misconduct and corruption. While digging deep into problems behind the four malpractices, such as forming self-serving cliques, exploiting social connections for personal gain, and illicit transfer of benefits, we will thoroughly investigate misconduct involved in corruption cases.

units.zh: 坚持纠“四风”树新风并举，以优良党风政风引领社会风气向上向善。
units.en: In addressing the four malpractices, we will put equal emphasis on promoting healthy practices and ensure that fine Party and government conduct guides the whole of society in pursuing excellence and goodness.

units.zh: （四）强化从严执纪。
units.en: 4. Making discipline enforcement more rigorous 把严的要求贯穿党规制定、党纪教育、执纪监督全过程。坚持有纪必依、执纪必严、违纪必究，对违纪问题发现一起查处一起，决不姑息迁就。We will impose rigorous requirements throughout the formulation of Party regulations, education on Party discipline, discipline enforcement, and oversight. Following the principle that Party discipline must be observed and strictly enforced and all violators must be held accountable, we will investigate every case discovered and show zero tolerance for discipline violations.

units.zh: 严格执行党的政治纪律和政治规矩，带动组织纪律、廉洁纪律、群众纪律、工作纪律、生活纪律全面从严。聚焦重点领域、薄弱环节、模糊地带，完善纪律规范。
units.en: We will strictly enforce the Party’s political discipline and rules and use them to prompt stricter observance of organizational discipline and discipline regarding integrity, the public, work, and life. We will refine disciplinary regulations, with priority given to key fields, weak links, and gray areas.

units.zh: 坚持纪严于法、纪在法前，执纪执法贯通、有效衔接司法。坚持抓早抓小、防微杜渐，对苗头性、倾向性问题及时提醒纠正，防止小毛病演化成大问题。
units.en: Upholding the principle that Party discipline is stricter than the law and precedes the law, we will work to ensure close integration of discipline and law enforcement and their effective coordination with the judicial system. We must discover problems early and correct them when they are nascent, and early signs and unfavorable tendencies must be promptly reminded of and rectified to prevent them from growing into serious problems.

units.zh: 加强对纪律执行情况的监督检查，推动党的各级组织严格执行和维护纪律，对执纪不严、放任不管的严肃追究责任。
units.en: We will strengthen oversight and inspection over discipline enforcement to push Party organizations at all levels to strictly enforce and maintain discipline. Cases of lax discipline enforcement or even willful ignorance of violations must be sternly dealt with.

units.zh: （五）综合发挥纪律教育约束、保障激励作用。
units.en: 5. Making full use of discipline as a guide, restraint, guarantee, and incentive

units.zh: 建立健全常态化长效化纪律教育机制，把党章党规党纪作为党员、干部培训的必修课，引导党员、干部学纪明纪守纪，养成在受监督和约束的环境中工作生活的习惯。
units.en: We will establish sound mechanisms for carrying out regular, long-term discipline education, incorporating the Party Constitution, Party regulations, and Party discipline into education and training programs for every Party member and official. We will guide them in studying, understanding, and observing discipline and readily subjecting themselves to oversight and constraints in both work and life.

units.zh: 加强全周期纪律教育，抓住入党入职、职务变动、家庭变化、离职退休等各个重要节点加强纪律提醒。
units.en: We will enhance discipline education throughout Party members’ career life, giving them extra reminders at each important moment, including joining the Party, taking office, experiencing position changes or changes in family circumstances, leaving office, and entering retirement.

units.zh: 根据不同职务职级和不同行业党员、干部履职要求，明确应知应会纪律法规。抓好新提拔干部、关键岗位干部、年轻干部等重点对象的纪律培训。
units.en: We will clarify the specific disciplinary rules, laws, and regulations that Party members and officials should command based on the duty requirements for different positions, ranks, and sectors. We will provide proper disciplinary training for key groups such as newly promoted officials, officials in key positions, and young officials.

units.zh: 坚持惩前毖后、治病救人，深化运用监督执纪“四种形态”，注重用好“第一种形态”，层层设防，最大限度教育挽救党员、干部。
units.en: In keeping with the principle of learning from mistakes to prevent recurrence and treating the illness to save the patient, we will make better use of the four forms of oversight over discipline compliance, with priority given to the first form. These multiple layers of preventive measures will enable us to educate and save our Party members and officials to the greatest extent possible.

units.zh: 坚持实事求是、依规依纪依法，把思想政治工作贯穿始终，增强执纪问责规范性准确性，实现政治效果、纪法效果、社会效果有机统一。
units.en: Acting on the basis of the facts and in accordance with Party regulations, discipline, and the law, we will incorporate theoretical and political work into the whole process of enforcing discipline and ensuring accountability. This will make our efforts more procedure-based and precise, thus delivering results of political, disciplinary, legal, and social significance.

units.zh: 坚持严肃纪律和关心爱护相统一，推动党员、干部在遵规守纪中改革创新、干事创业。严肃查处诬告陷害行为，及时开展澄清正名工作。做好受处理处分党员、干部的跟踪回访和教育管理工作。
units.en: We will both enforce strict discipline and care for Party members and officials, and encourage them to pursue reform and innovation and strive for success within the boundaries of regulations and discipline. We will take stern action to investigate and punish false accusations and frame-ups, and clear names for those affected in a timely manner. We will also carry out follow-up visits, education, and management of Party members and officials who have undergone disciplinary actions or penalties.

units.zh: 七、坚定不移一体推进不敢腐不能腐不想腐
units.en: VII. Taking Firm and Integrated Action against Corruption

units.zh: 一体推进不敢腐不能腐不想腐是全面从严治党的重要方略和反腐败斗争的基本方针。必须牢记党除了工人阶级和最广大人民群众的利益没有自己特殊的利益、党同腐败水火不容，坚定走好中国特色反腐败之路，加强党中央对反腐败工作的集中统一领导，更加注重标本兼治、系统施治，坚持从严惩、精准治、有效防、一体抓，将反腐败斗争进行到底。
