units.en: Taking integrated steps to ensure that officials do not have the audacity, opportunity, or desire to commit corruption is both an important policy for full and rigorous Party self-governance and a fundamental principle for our fight against corruption. The Party tolerates no corruption, as it has no special interests of its own besides the interests of the working class and the greatest possible majority of the people. Keeping this firmly in mind, we must steadfastly follow a distinctive Chinese path of anti-corruption and strengthen the Party Central Committee’s centralized, unified leadership over anti-corruption work. We must place greater emphasis on addressing both symptoms and root causes and taking systematic action against corruption. With a holistic approach that combines severe punishment, targeted remedies, and effective prevention, we will carry the fight against corruption through to the end.

units.zh: （一）保持惩治腐败高压态势。
units.en: 1. Maintaining a tough stance against corruption

units.zh: 深刻认识反腐败斗争形势仍然严峻复杂、铲除腐败滋生土壤和条件任务仍然艰巨繁重，坚持有腐必反、有贪必肃、除恶务尽，坚决“打虎”、“拍蝇”、“猎狐”，始终保持战略定力和战斗韧性，一刻不停歇、半步不退让，更加有力遏制增量、更加有效清除存量，决不让腐败分子有藏身之地，决不允许有“铁帽子王”、“丹书铁券”。
units.en: We must be fully aware that our fight against corruption remains grave and complex and that we still face formidable tasks in eradicating the breeding grounds and conditions for corruption. Therefore, we must ensure that every instance of corruption is investigated and punished and that this evil is uprooted in its entirety. We will take firm action to “take out tigers,” “swat flies,” and “hunt down foxes,” punishing corrupt officials of all types. We will maintain our strategic resolve and fighting tenacity in this regard, not letting up even for a moment and not yielding even an inch. We will take more forceful action to curb new cases, while adopting more effective measures to root out existing ones, and we will never allow corrupt officials to find a safe haven or have the privilege to escape punishment.

units.zh: 突出重点领域、重点问题、重点对象，深化权力集中、资金密集、资源富集领域腐败问题整治，重点查处政治问题和经济问题交织、政商勾连、资本向政治领域渗透等问题，注重查处各种风险背后的腐败问题，着力查处“关键少数”特别是“一把手”腐败、年轻干部腐败，严肃查处领导干部家族式腐败、身边人腐败，坚决清除不收敛不收手、肆意妄为的腐败分子。
units.en: Focusing on key sectors, major issues, and main targets, we will intensify efforts to fight corruption in sectors with a high concentration of power, funds, or resources. In particular, we will investigate and deal with cases involving both political and economic issues, collusion between government officials and businesspeople, and capital penetrating into the political domain, as well as corruption cases that have entailed various risks. We will crack down hard on corruption of the “key few,” especially officials in top posts, and young officials, and take stern action against corruption committed by leading officials’ families and staff. We will also resolutely remove all corrupt officials who behave unscrupulously without restraint.

units.zh: 深挖细查预期收益、约定代持、“白手套”、政商“旋转门”等新型腐败和隐性腐败，坚决打击利用互联网、虚拟货币、跨境资金、区块链等实施的腐败行为。
units.en: We will redouble efforts to investigate new and disguised forms of corruption such as receiving returns later for abusing one’s power for the beneficiaries, reaping benefits from assets under the name of bribe givers or a third party, the “white glove” or agents concealing corruption activities in ostensibly legal forms, and the “revolving door” phenomenon of bureaucrat-merchant collusion after officials’ retirement. We will also resolutely combat corruption committed via the internet, virtual currency, cross-border capital, and blockchain.

units.zh: 常态化整治群众身边不正之风和腐败问题，围绕就业、养老、社保、住房、教育、医疗、“三农”等领域问题深化治理，严肃查处贪污侵占、截留挪用、虚报冒领、吃拿卡要等问题，严惩“蝇贪蚁腐”，持续推进扫黑除恶“打伞破网”。
units.en: We will make consistent efforts to address misconduct and corruption directly affecting the people. Focusing on issues related to employment, elderly care, social security, housing, education, healthcare, agriculture, rural areas, and rural residents, we will rigorously investigate and prosecute those who engage in embezzlement, misappropriation, retention, diversion, and fraudulent claims of public funds, and extortion and exploitation of the people; strictly punish low-ranking corrupt officials like “flies” and “termites”; and continue to combat and root out criminal gangs and their protective umbrellas and patronage networks.

units.zh: 深化反腐败国际合作，加强追逃防逃追赃，加大跨境腐败案件查办力度。
units.en: We will promote international anti-corruption cooperation, step up efforts to pursue fugitives, prevent escape, and retrieve stolen assets, and intensify the investigation and handling of cross-border corruption cases.

units.zh: 深化受贿行贿一起查，依规依纪依法查处行贿行为，加强对重点行贿人的联合惩戒，防范和打击“围猎”行为。
units.en: We will punish both bribe takers and givers, investigate and deal with bribe offering in accordance with Party regulations and discipline and the law, take joint punitive actions against key bribe givers, and guard against and crack down on attempts to tempt officials into corruption.

units.zh: 加强廉洁风险隐患动态监测，建立腐败预警惩治联动机制。推动发生重大腐败案件的地方、部门和单位彻底肃清流毒、修复政治生态。
units.en: We will strengthen ongoing monitoring of corruption-related risks and hidden dangers and establish mechanisms for coordinating early warning of and punishment for corruption. We will work to see that localities, departments, and organizations where major corruption cases occur completely eradicate the negative impacts of these cases and restore their political ecosystems.

units.zh: （二）加强对权力运行的制约和监督。
units.en: 2. Strengthening checks on and oversight over the exercise of power

units.zh: 坚持秉公用权、依法用权、廉洁用权、为民用权，防止和纠治擅权妄为、滥用权力、玩忽职守等行为。
units.en: We will ensure that power is exercised impartially, in accordance with the law, with integrity, and for the people, while preventing and addressing arbitrary decision-making, abuse of power, and dereliction of duties.

units.zh: 健全授权用权制权相统一、清晰透明可追溯的制度机制，加强对权力配置、运行的规范和监督，及时发现问题、纠正偏差，更加科学有效地把权力关进制度笼子。
units.en: We will refine relevant systems and mechanisms in order to enhance alignment between the delegation, exercise, and constraint of power and ensure clearly defined powers and responsibilities, transparent procedures, and traceable records. On this basis, we will tighten regulation and oversight over the allocation and exercise of power and promptly identify problems and correct deviations, thereby confining the exercise of power to an institutional cage in a better-conceived and more effective way.

units.zh: 抓住政策制定、议事决策、审批监管、执法司法等关键环节，规范职责权限、行权边界、工作程序，规范自由裁量权，防止权力设租寻租。
units.en: Focusing on pivotal links such as policy formulation, deliberation, decision-making, review and approval, regulation, law enforcement, and the administration of justice, we will ensure that relevant duties and authorities, boundaries of the exercise of power, and working procedures are clearly defined and that discretionary powers are exercised in a procedure-based manner, so as to eliminate any possibilities for rent-setting and rent-seeking.

units.zh: 加快重点领域、新领域权力运行规范和制约机制建设。建立重点行业权力清单、基层小微权力清单。落实领导干部干预司法活动、插手具体案件处理的记录通报制度。
units.en: We will work faster to develop mechanisms for regulating and placing checks on the exercise of power in key sectors and new areas. Lists of powers in key sectors and lists of micro and small powers at the primary level will be introduced, and the systems for recording and reporting leading officials who attempt to intervene in judicial activities or influence the handling of specific cases will be fully implemented.

units.zh: （三）夯实崇廉拒腐思想根基。
units.en: 3. Fortifying the cultural-ethical foundations for upholding integrity and resisting corruption

units.zh: 加强新时代廉洁文化建设，丰富内容和载体，教育引导党员、干部自重自省、慎独慎微，自觉拒腐防变。
units.en: We will promote a culture of integrity in the new era by creating richer content and communicating it through diverse platforms. It is essential to provide education and guidance for Party members and officials to help them maintain self-respect, conduct self-examination, and observe the strictest discipline even when unsupervised and when handling minor matters to ensure that they consciously resist corruption and prevent moral decline.

units.zh: 发展积极健康的党内政治文化，运用党的创新理论蕴含的理想信念、价值理念、道德观念、纪法意识涵养党员、干部清廉操守。
units.en: To cultivate a healthy, positive political culture within the Party, we will promote the ideals, convictions, values, moral principles, sense of discipline, and legal awareness embedded in the Party’s new theories to nurture political integrity among Party members and officials.

units.zh: 把廉洁文化融入社会主义核心价值观建设，把廉洁教育融入国民教育体系，营造廉荣贪耻的社会氛围。
units.en: The culture of integrity will be advanced as an integral part of our drive to promote the core socialist values, and integrity education will be incorporated into the national education system to foster a social atmosphere honoring integrity and denouncing corruption.

units.zh: 创新廉洁宣传教育机制，线上线下联动，分层分类确定内容和方式，增强针对性有效性。发挥勤廉典型示范引领和违纪违法案例警示震慑作用。
units.en: New mechanisms will be developed to raise the awareness of integrity both online and offline, with specific content provided and methods employed at different levels and in different categories to make our communication and education more targeted and effective. We will leverage the role of diligence and integrity models in inspiring and guiding Party members as well as the role of cases of discipline and law violation in warning and deterring.

units.zh: 督促领导干部带头构建亲清政商关系，加强家庭家教家风建设，严格教育管理亲属和身边工作人员。
units.en: We will urge leading officials to take the lead in cultivating a cordial and clean relationship between government and business; fostering close bonds, good education, and fine traditions in family; and rigorously supervising their family members and staff.

units.zh: （四）增强一体推进不敢腐不能腐不想腐综合效能。
units.en: 4. Better preventing corruption through a holistic approach 深入研究把握社会主义市场经济条件下反腐败规律，健全反腐败法律法规，坚持不敢腐不能腐不想腐同时发力、同向发力、综合发力，着力铲除腐败滋生土壤和条件。We will conduct in-depth research to grasp the patterns of anti-corruption efforts in the context of the socialist market economy, strengthen anti-corruption laws and regulations, and take simultaneous, coordinated, and comprehensive steps to ensure that officials do not have the audacity, opportunity, or desire to commit corruption, thus eradicating the breeding grounds and conditions for corruption.

units.zh: 健全党委统一领导下纪检监察机关同有关部门协作配合机制，以全链条协作促进一体化治理。
units.en: We will improve the mechanisms for coordination and cooperation between discipline inspection and supervision organs and relevant departments under the unified leadership of Party committees, advancing integrated governance through coordination across the entire chain.

units.zh: 抓实以案促改促治，对重大案件中发现的行业性系统性腐败问题进行专项治理，通过查处案件健全制度机制，消除权力运行漏洞、监管盲区、制度空白，形成监督、办案、整改、治理闭环。
units.en: To promote rectification and improve governance through typical cases, we will take targeted measures to address instances of systemic and sector-specific corruption discovered in major cases. This entails improving relevant institutions and mechanisms after the investigation and handling of cases as well as eliminating loopholes in the exercise of power, regulatory blind spots, and institutional gaps. In doing so, we will establish a closed-loop system for oversight, case handling, rectification, and governance.

units.zh: 把握腐败新动向新特点，深化数字纪检监察体系建设，推进公权力大数据监督平台建设，提高反腐败穿透力。
units.en: Keeping attuned to the new developments and features of corruption, we will promote the building of a digital system for discipline inspection and supervision and a big data platform for overseeing the exercise of power in the public sector. All this will give us sharper eyes in combating corruption.

units.zh: 八、坚持制度治党、依规治党
units.en: VIII. Running the Party through Institutions and Regulations

units.zh: 加强党内法规制度建设是全面从严治党的长远之策、根本之策。必须坚持把党章作为全党的根本行为规范，深化党的建设制度改革，推动依法治国和依规治党有机统一，为持之以恒推进全面从严治党提供有力制度保障。
units.en: Strengthening Party regulations and institutions represents a long-term, fundamental strategy for ensuring full and rigorous Party self-governance. We must uphold the Party Constitution as the fundamental code of conduct for all Party members, deepen institutional reforms related to Party building, and ensure the unity of law-based governance of the country and regulation-based self-governance of the Party, thus providing strong institutional support for persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance.

units.zh: （一）完善党内法规制度体系。
units.en: 1. Improving the framework of Party regulations and institutions

units.zh: 科学编制党内法规制定工作规划计划。统筹党内法规立改废释，注重系统集成，加强配套衔接。
units.en: It is necessary to make well-conceived plans for formulating Party rules and regulations. Meanwhile, we will take coordinated steps to enact, revise, abolish, and interpret these rules and regulations, promote systematic integration, and ensure that all efforts complement and align with each other.

units.zh: 根据持之以恒推进全面从严治党实际需要制定完善党内法规制度，及时补齐制度短板。建章立制要针对突出问题，确保便利管用。完善党内法规解释机制。健全党内法规同国家法律法规衔接协调机制。
units.en: Party regulations and institutions should be formulated and improved in line with the actual needs of persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance, and institutional shortcomings identified should be addressed in a timely manner. In instituting rules and regulations, we must ensure that they are responsive to prominent problems, practicable, and effective. We will also improve the mechanism for interpreting Party rules and regulations and the mechanisms for aligning and coordinating them with state laws and regulations.

units.zh: （二）增强制度执行力。
units.en: 2. Enhancing the implementation of institutions

units.zh: 强化制度刚性约束，坚持制度面前人人平等、遵守制度没有特殊、执行制度没有例外。
units.en: We will enhance the binding force of institutions and ensure that all are equal before institutions, that no one enjoys special privileges when it comes to compliance, and that no exceptions are made in enforcement.

units.zh: 推动党员、干部自觉学习党章、遵守党章、贯彻党章、维护党章。加大党内法规公开力度。加强党内法规制度学习培训。
units.en: We will encourage Party members and officials to consciously study, abide by, act in line with, and uphold the Party Constitution. We will promote transparency and enhance training in Party rules and regulations.

units.zh: 把制度的执行和监督贯穿党组织和党员、干部履职全过程，贯穿区域治理、部门治理、行业治理、基层治理、单位治理各方面，确保制度时时生威、处处有效。坚决纠正有令不行、有禁不止，防止制度执行做选择、打折扣、搞变通，避免制度空转。
units.en: We will ensure institutional compliance and oversight throughout the entire process of the work of Party organizations as well as Party members and officials and in every aspect of governance across all regions, departments, sectors, local communities, and organizations. This is an essential measure to guarantee the authority and effectiveness of institutions across the board at all times. We must resolutely rectify instances of ignoring orders and prohibitions and guard against selective, curtailed, and distorted implementation to prevent our institutions from running null and void.

units.zh: （三）大力破除潜规则。
units.en: 3. Eliminating hidden rules

units.zh: 坚持立明规矩，推进党务政务公开。教育引导党员、干部讲原则、遵法纪、守正道，在权力行使、政策执行、项目争取、干部选用、评优评先等方面自觉反对和抵制潜规则。坚决纠治“搭天线拜码头”、“原则不如关系”、“章子不如条子”、不给好处不办事、暗箱操作等乱象，坚决抵制商品交换原则和人身依附关系侵蚀党内生活。
units.en: It is essential that we establish clear rules and promote transparency in Party and government affairs. We will educate and guide Party members and officials in upholding principles, observing the law and discipline, and following the right path. Everyone must consciously oppose and resist unspoken practices in exercising power, implementing policies, competing for projects, selecting and appointing officials, and assessing performance for exemplary work. We must take firm action to curb malpractices such as cultivating connections or currying favor with higher-ups, placing connections above principles, acting at the behest of informal notes instead of statutory rules, putting a price on every official duty, and making backroom deals. We must resolutely resist the rules of commercial dealings and the relationships of dependency eroding intraparty conduct.

units.zh: 健全举报机制，严肃查处结交或充当政治掮客、政治骗子行为。建立类案分析回溯、整改通报制度，完善政治生态动态监测、研判、治理机制。
units.en: We will improve the reporting mechanisms to ensure rigorous investigation and punishment of those colluding with or acting as political brokers and political swindlers. We will also establish systems to analyze and review similar cases along with those for implementing remedial measures and issuing relevant notifications. We will improve the mechanisms for ongoing monitoring, assessment, and improvement of the political ecosystem.

units.zh: 持之以恒推进全面从严治党，必须进一步完善党和国家监督体系。做实党委（党组）全面监督，加强对各类监督主体的领导。修订党内监督条例。
units.en: Persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance entails further improvement to Party and state oversight systems. We will ensure that Party committees (leading Party members groups) exercise general oversight and strengthen their leadership over various oversight bodies. The Party’s regulations on internal oversight will be revised.

units.zh: 完善纪检监察工作双重领导体制，做实监督检查和查办腐败案件以上级纪委监委领导为主，注重力量协同和优化，加强纪律监督、监察监督、派驻监督、巡视监督统筹衔接。
units.en: The dual leadership system for discipline inspection and supervision will be improved to ensure that the discipline inspection and supervision commissions at the next level up lead the efforts in conducting oversight and inspection and investigating and handling corruption cases. At the same time, collaboration between relevant organizations will be enhanced for better performance, so that disciplinary oversight, supervisory oversight, and oversight conducted through dispatched teams and inspection tours will be better coordinated and aligned.

units.zh: 用好县乡村监督资源和力量，健全基层监督体系，完善提级监督、交叉监督等机制，畅通群众监督渠道，促进基层监督和基层治理有机贯通。
units.en: The oversight resources and organizations at village, township, and county levels will be fully leveraged to improve the primary-level oversight system, and the mechanisms for higher-level oversight and cross-jurisdiction oversight will be refined. We will also ensure that the channels for public oversight are kept open and that oversight and governance are well aligned at the primary level.

units.zh: 推动党内监督同人大监督、民主监督、行政监督、司法监督、审计监督、财会监督、统计监督、群众监督、舆论监督深度融合、高效联动，形成监督合力。
units.en: Intraparty oversight will be further integrated and work efficiently with other forms of oversight to create synergy, including oversight by people’s congresses, democratic oversight, administrative oversight, judicial oversight, audit-based oversight, accounting oversight, statistics-based oversight, public oversight, and oversight through public opinion.

units.zh: 全面贯彻党的巡视工作方针，落实巡视工作条例，用好常规巡视、专项巡视、机动巡视、提级巡视等方式，创新巡视方法，加大巡视“回头看”力度，加强巡视整改和成果运用，深化巡视巡察上下联动，提升对村巡察质效，发挥巡视综合监督利剑作用。
units.en: The Party’s policy on discipline inspection will be fully implemented, the regulations on discipline inspection will be thoroughly enforced, routine, special, random, and higher-level inspections will be effectively conducted, and new methods will be introduced. Follow-up review will be strengthened to ensure that rectifications are made accordingly and relevant results are put to practical use. Inspections at different levels will be coordinated, and village-level inspections will be conducted in a more effective way. All this will see that inspections serve as a powerful tool of comprehensive oversight.

units.zh: 持之以恒推进全面从严治党，是全党的共同政治责任。必须扭住管党治党责任制“牛鼻子”，压紧压实党委（党组）主体责任、纪委监督责任、党委（党组）书记第一责任人责任、领导班子其他成员“一岗双责”和党员、干部具体责任，健全各负其责、统一协调的责任体系。
units.en: Persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance is the common political responsibility of all Party members. Attaching crucial importance to the responsibility system for Party self-supervision and self-governance, we must ensure that Party committees (leading Party members groups) fulfill the principal responsibility, commissions for discipline inspection shoulder the responsibility for oversight, secretaries of Party committees (leading Party members groups) are the first in the line of responsibility, and other members of leadership teams fulfill the responsibility for Party self-governance alongside their administrative duties, while rank-and-file Party members and officials assume their specific responsibilities in this regard. In doing so, we will put in place a robust, unified system where all sides perform their respective responsibilities in close collaboration.

units.zh: 各级党委（党组）要主动抓、用心管，扣紧责任链条，层层传导压力。县级以上党委（党组）至少每年听取一次领导班子成员履行管党治党责任情况汇报，加强督促指导。
units.en: Party committees (leading Party members groups) at all levels should take the initiative and make earnest efforts to advance Party self-supervision and self-governance, seeing that the pressure is felt at each link along the chains of responsibility. To strengthen oversight and guidance, those at or above the county level should hear, at least once every year, their leading members’ reports on fulfilling Party self-supervision and self-governance responsibilities.

units.zh: 各级纪委（派驻纪检监察组）要履行好监督责任，下级纪委（派驻纪检监察组）至少每半年向上级纪委（派出机关）报告一次党委（党组）领导班子成员特别是“一把手”履行职责、行使权力情况和自身履行监督责任情况。
units.en: Commissions for discipline inspection (dispatched discipline inspection and supervision teams) at every level should effectively fulfill their responsibilities for oversight. They should, at least once every six months, submit reports to the next-higher-level commissions (authorities dispatching such teams), expounding on the performance of the leading members of Party committees (leading Party members groups), especially those in top posts, in fulfilling duties and exercising power, as well as their own performance in assuming oversight responsibilities.

units.zh: 党委各部门要履职尽责、齐抓共管。领导干部特别是高级干部要严于律己、严负其责、严管所辖，在履行管党治党责任上作示范。推进各层级各领域党建工作要实事求是、务求实效，力戒形式主义。优化责任落实考评机制，对管党治党不力、出现严重问题的严肃追责问责。
units.en: All departments of Party committees should fulfill their duties and work in unison. Leading officials, especially high-ranking ones, should practice strict self-discipline, earnestly fulfill their responsibilities, and conduct rigorous management within their jurisdictions, setting an example in advancing Party self-supervision and self-governance. We should ensure that Party building efforts across all levels and sectors are grounded in reality, aimed at delivering tangible results, and free of pointless formalities. Furthermore, relevant performance assessment mechanisms will be improved, so that those who have failed to effectively carry out Party self-supervision and self-governance responsibilities and caused serious problems in this regard are strictly held to account.

units.zh: 历史昭示未来，奋斗成就伟业。中国共产党在波澜壮阔的伟大征程中，铸就了矢志追求真理、始终把准前进方向，深深植根人民、始终拥有坚实根基，勇担历史使命、始终掌握战略主动，顺应发展潮流、始终走在时代前列，敢于善于斗争、始终保持必胜信心，注重强健自身、始终充满生机活力等优秀特质。
units.en: History sheds light on the future, and hard work paves the way to monumental achievements. On its magnificent journey, the Communist Party of China has forged the following fine qualities: dedication to the pursuit of truth—ensuring that the Party always advances in the right direction; deep roots among the people—ensuring that the Party always stands on a solid foundation; determination to shoulder its historic mission—ensuring that the Party always holds the strategic initiative; readiness to adapt to the trends of development—ensuring that the Party always remains at the forefront of the times; courage and ability to carry on its fight—ensuring that the Party always maintains firm confidence in victory; and commitment to self-strengthening—ensuring that the Party always retains its vitality.

units.zh: 一百多年来，中华大地发生的沧桑巨变，充分证明党不负历史、不负人民，不愧为中国工人阶级的先锋队，不愧为中国人民和中华民族的先锋队。
units.en: The tremendous changes that have taken place in the Chinese land over more than one hundred years have proven that our Party has fulfilled its responsibility to history and lived up to the expectations of the people. It deserves to be called the vanguard of the Chinese working class and the vanguard of the Chinese people and the Chinese nation.

units.zh: 伟大、光荣、正确的中国共产党，历经风雨而初心不改，目标笃定并勇毅前行，将牢记“三个务必”，永葆赶考的清醒坚定，勇于进行具有许多新的历史特点的伟大斗争，坚决战胜前进道路上的一切艰难险阻，不断创造更加美好的未来！
units.en: Great, glorious, and correct, the Communist Party of China has remained true to its founding mission despite countless challenges, pressing ahead toward its goals with determination and fortitude. On the journey ahead, we will bear firmly in mind that it is imperative that we never forget our original aspiration and founding mission, that we remain modest, prudent, and hard-working, and that we have the courage and ability to carry on our fight. We will remain clear-minded and determined to meet any tests, courageously carry out a great struggle with many new features of the times, and resolutely overcome any difficulties and obstacles on the road ahead to create a brighter future.

units.zh: 全党要更加紧密地团结在以习近平同志为核心的党中央周围，全面贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想，励精图治、奋发图强，持之以恒推进全面从严治党，不断开创新时代管党治党、兴党强党新局面，团结带领全国各族人民为全面建成社会主义现代化强国、以中国式现代化全面推进中华民族伟大复兴而不懈奋斗！
units.en: Let all of us in the Party rally more closely around the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core and fully implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era. Let us forge ahead with dedication and enterprise, persevere with full and rigorous Party self-governance, and continue to break new ground in supervising, governing, developing, and strengthening the Party in the new era. Let us unite and lead the Chinese people of all ethnic groups in a tireless effort to build China into a great modern socialist country in all respects and advance national rejuvenation on all fronts through Chinese modernization.

files.name: 20261029习近平 关于《中共中央关于持之以恒推进全面从严治党若干重大问题的决定》的说明 中英对照

units.zh: 关于《中共中央关于持之以恒推进全面从严治党若干重大问题的决定》的说明
units.en: Explanation of the Resolution of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Certain Major Issues concerning Persevering with Full and Rigorous Party Self-Governance

units.zh: 习近平
units.en: Xi Jinping

units.zh: 同志们：
units.en: Comrades,

units.zh: 受中央政治局委托，我就《中共中央关于持之以恒推进全面从严治党若干重大问题的决定》（以下简称《决定》）起草的有关情况向全会作说明。
units.en: On behalf of the Political Bureau of the Party Central Committee, I will now brief you on the drafting of the Resolution of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Certain Major Issues concerning Persevering with Full and Rigorous Party Self-Governance.

units.zh: 一、关于确定全会议题的考虑
units.en: I. Considerations on the Topic of the Session

units.zh: 党的建设事关党的前途命运、党和国家事业兴衰成败。今年是我们党成立105周年。中央政治局决定，党的二十届五中全会重点研究持之以恒推进全面从严治党问题。这是党中央把握党和国家事业发展历史方位、着眼中国式现代化全局，审时度势、通盘考虑作出的重大决策。
units.en: Party building is crucial to the future of the Party and the success of the cause of the Party and the country. As this year marks the 105th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China (CPC), the Political Bureau decided that the 20th CPC Central Committee would focus on the issue of persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance at its fifth plenary session. This major decision made by the Central Committee is based on its assessment and thorough consideration of the situation and in light of the historical stage that the cause of the Party and the country has entered and the advancement of Chinese modernization as a whole.

units.zh: 第一，这是保持党的先进性和纯洁性、巩固党的长期执政地位的必然要求。
units.en: First, it is essential for maintaining the Party’s advanced nature and integrity and consolidating its long-term governing position.

units.zh: 如何跳出治乱兴衰历史周期率，是我们党长期执政必须回答好的根本问题。就此，当年毛泽东同志在延安窑洞里给出了“让人民来监督政府”的第一个答案，党的十八大以来我们在全面从严治党实践中找到“自我革命”的第二个答案。党的自我革命有严格的界定，就是刀刃向内，全面从严治党，保持党的先进性和纯洁性，实现党的自我净化、自我完善、自我革新、自我提高。100多年来，我们党在领导人民为实现中华民族伟大复兴不懈奋斗的历史进程中，一直高度重视管党治党，勇于坚持真理、修正错误，在依靠自身力量和人民支持解决自身问题中不断强大，百年大党充满活力、风华正茂。
units.en: For our Party to maintain its long-term governance, it is imperative to find answers to the fundamental question of how to escape the historical cycle of rise and fall. Comrade Mao Zedong offered the first answer to this question back in his years in the cave dwellings of Yan’an: the people’s oversight over government. Since the Party’s 18th National Congress, we have found the second answer in exercising full and rigorous self-governance: the Party’s self-reform. The Party’s self-reform has been defined clearly. It entails exercising full and rigorous self-governance with unflinching courage to ensure the Party maintains its advanced nature and integrity and can purify, improve, renew, and excel itself. For more than a century, our Party has led the people in working tirelessly for the rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. During the course, the Party has always attached great importance to its self-supervision and self-governance, had the courage to uphold truth and correct errors, and grown ever stronger by relying on its own efforts and the support of the people to resolve its own problems. Thanks to these efforts, our century-old Party remains in its prime, brimming with vigor and vitality.

units.zh: 同时，要清醒看到，全面从严治党是长期的战略性任务。这些年，党的队伍发生结构性变化，改革开放后出生的党员、干部比例越来越大，对教育管理提出新的要求。党的队伍主流是好的，但弱化党的先进性、损害党的纯洁性、影响党长期执政的问题和隐患还不少，特别是思想不纯、组织不纯、作风不纯问题尚未根本解决，一些新问题又不断产生。面对这些问题和挑战，只有通过持之以恒推进全面从严治党，不断清除侵蚀党的健康肌体的病毒，才能确保党永远不变质不变色不变味，确保红色江山代代相传。
units.en: At the same time, we must be keenly aware that full and rigorous Party self-governance is a long-term strategic task. Over the years, our Party membership is undergoing structural changes, with a steady increase in the proportion of members and officials born after the launch of reform and opening up in 1978. This has raised new requirements for education and management. The vast majority of Party members are exemplary, yet there remain a number of problems and hidden dangers that threaten to undermine the Party’s advanced nature, weaken its integrity, and jeopardize its long-term governance. In particular, the problems of defects in thinking, organization, and conduct have yet to be solved root and branch, while some new problems continue to emerge. Facing these problems and challenges, we must persevere with full and rigorous Party self-governance to remove the viruses that would erode the Party’s health, ensuring that the Party will never change its nature, its conviction, or its character, and that the socialist cause can be advanced from generation to generation.

units.zh: 第二，这是巩固和发展全党高度团结统一、党心军心民心高度凝聚良好政治局面的必然要求。
units.en: Second, it is essential for consolidating and developing the sound political situation where great solidarity and unity are maintained across the whole Party and great cohesion is secured within the Party and the military and among the people.

units.zh: 党的十八大之后，党中央直面一度出现党的领导弱化虚化淡化、管党治党不严不实不力、党内一些问题触目惊心的严峻现实，坚定不移全面从严治党，持续解决突出问题，从根本上扭转了管党治党宽松软状况，刹住了一些长期没有刹住的歪风，纠治了一些多年未除的顽瘴痼疾，消除了党、国家、军队内部存在的严重隐患，党在革命性锻造中更加坚强有力。党的全面领导和党中央集中统一领导显著加强，马克思主义中国化时代化实现新的飞跃，新时代党的组织路线贯彻有力，中央八项规定铁律生威，党的纪律建设扎实推进，反腐败斗争力度前所未有、成效有目共睹，党内法规制度体系更为完善，党的各级组织落实管党治党责任见行见效。新时代全面从严治党积累了丰富经验，开辟了百年大党自我革命新境界，党的团结统一更加巩固，党心军心民心高度凝聚。
units.en: Since the Party’s 18th National Congress, the Central Committee has confronted the grave situation marked by weak, hollow, and watered-down Party leadership, lax, superficial, and ineffective self-supervision and self-governance, as well as some egregious problems within the Party. Staying firmly committed to full and rigorous Party self-governance, the Central Committee has made continuous efforts to tackle these prominent issues. As a result, the problem of lax and weak self-supervision and self-governance has been addressed at its root, unhealthy tendencies that had long gone unchecked have been curbed, deep-seated problems that had plagued the Party for years have been remedied, and serious dangers hidden within the Party, the state, and the military have been removed. The Party has thus grown stronger through revolutionary tempering. Thanks to these efforts, we have significantly strengthened the Party’s overall leadership and the centralized, unified leadership of the Central Committee; achieved a new breakthrough in adapting Marxism to the Chinese context and the needs of our times; and effectively implemented the Party’s organizational line for the new era. The central Party leadership’s eight-point decision on improving work conduct has begun to show its teeth as ironclad discipline, and steady progress has been made in strengthening Party discipline. We have combated corruption with unprecedented intensity and produced universally recognized results. The framework of Party regulations and institutions has been further improved, and Party organizations at all levels have taken concrete and effective measures to fulfill their responsibilities for self-supervision and self-governance. We have gained rich experience in full and rigorous Party self-governance in the new era and broken new ground in the self-reform of our century-old Party. As a result, we have reinforced the solidarity and unity of the Party and secured great cohesion within the Party and the military and among the people.

units.zh: 这一良好政治局面来之不易，全党必须倍加珍惜，不断加以巩固和发展。这就要求我们坚持和运用新时代全面从严治党宝贵经验，以更高标准、更实举措持之以恒推进全面从严治党，不断增强党的政治领导力、思想引领力、群众组织力、社会号召力，确保党永远得到人民衷心拥护、始终成为中国特色社会主义事业的坚强领导核心。
units.en: As such a sound political situation has not been easily won, the whole Party must cherish it and continue to consolidate and develop it. This requires us, building on our valuable experience gained in the new era, to adopt higher standards and more concrete measures in persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance and constantly strengthen the Party’s capacity for providing political leadership, giving theoretical guidance, organizing the people, and inspiring society. By doing so, we will see that the Party always enjoys the wholehearted support of the people and remains the strong leadership core in the cause of socialism with Chinese characteristics.

units.zh: 第三，这是实现党的历史使命、推动党和国家事业行稳致远的必然要求。
units.en: Third, it is essential for fulfilling the Party’s historic mission and ensuring steady and sustained progress in the cause of the Party and the country.

units.zh: 以中国式现代化全面推进强国建设、民族复兴伟业，是前无古人的开创性事业。经过党的十八大以来全党全国各族人民的顽强奋斗，党和国家事业取得历史性成就、发生历史性变革，实现中华民族伟大复兴进入不可逆转的历史进程。同时，世界之变、时代之变、历史之变正以前所未有的方式展开，前进道路上面临多种风险和挑战。从国际看，世界百年未有之大变局加速演进，新一轮科技革命和产业变革加速突破，国际力量对比深刻调整，世界进入新的动荡变革期，外部环境不确定难预料因素增多。从国内看，历经40多年改革开放，我国经济社会生活发生巨大变迁，发展不平衡不充分问题仍然突出，进一步全面深化改革、推动高质量发展、加强社会建设和治理、统筹发展和安全、激发和增强社会活力等遇到不少新课题。
units.en: Building a great country and advancing national rejuvenation on all fronts through Chinese modernization is a pioneering endeavor that no one has attempted before. Thanks to the tenacious efforts of the whole Party and the people of all ethnic groups since the Party’s 18th National Congress, we have brought about historic achievements and transformations in the cause of the Party and the country, setting the rejuvenation of the Chinese nation on an irreversible historical course. At the same time, however, with the world, the times, and the course of history changing in ways like never before, we will be confronted with multiple risks and challenges on our journey ahead. Internationally, momentous changes of a magnitude not seen in a century are unfolding across the world at a faster pace. Breakthroughs are accelerating in the new round of technological revolution and industrial transformation, while a profound shift is taking place in the international balance of power. As the world enters a new period of turbulence and transformation, uncertainties and unforeseeable factors are increasing in our country’s external environment. Domestically, more than 40 years of reform and opening up have brought about tremendous changes in China’s economy and society. However, development imbalances and inadequacies remain prominent, and many new challenges have emerged in further deepening reform comprehensively, promoting high-quality development, strengthening social development and governance, ensuring both development and security, and stimulating and boosting the vitality of our society.

units.zh: 办好中国的事情，关键在党，关键在全面从严治党。面对错综复杂的国际国内形势和艰巨繁重的改革发展稳定任务，推动中国式现代化行稳致远，必须大力弘扬伟大建党精神、始终牢记“三个务必”、不断发扬党的优秀特质，持之以恒推进全面从严治党，把我们党建设得更好、更强，为全面建成社会主义现代化强国、以中国式现代化全面推进中华民族伟大复兴提供坚强保障。
units.en: China’s success hinges on our Party, especially on the Party’s efforts to exercise full and rigorous self-governance. In the face of complicated international and domestic landscapes and the challenging tasks of advancing reform, promoting development, and ensuring stability, it is essential, in our efforts to ensure steady and sustained progress in Chinese modernization, to carry forward the great founding spirit and fine qualities of the Party, and always bear in mind that all of us in the Party must never forget our original aspiration and founding mission, that we must always stay modest, prudent, and hard-working, and that we must have the courage and ability to carry on our fight. We must also persevere with full and rigorous Party self-governance, and work to make our Party better and stronger, so as to provide strong guarantees for building China into a great modern socialist country in all respects and advancing the rejuvenation of the Chinese nation on all fronts through Chinese modernization.

units.zh: 二、关于《决定》稿的起草过程
units.en: II. The Drafting Process

units.zh: 今年1月，党中央成立党的二十届五中全会文件起草组，由我担任组长，王沪宁、蔡奇、李希同志担任副组长，党和国家有关领导同志及有关中央部门和地方负责同志参加，在中央政治局常委会领导下开展工作。2月6日，文件起草组召开第一次全体会议，正式启动文件起草工作。
units.en: In January this year, the Central Committee established a document drafting group for the fifth plenary session of the 20th Central Committee under the leadership of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau. I was chief of this group, while my colleagues Wang Huning, Cai Qi, and Li Xi served as its deputy chiefs. The group also included other Party and state leaders as well as heads of relevant central departments and localities. On February 6, the group convened its first general meeting, starting the drafting work officially.

units.zh: 文件起草中，着重把握了以下几点。
units.en: Throughout the drafting process, we have highlighted the following points.

units.zh: 第一，全面贯彻新时代党建思想。
units.en: First, fully implement the Thought on Party Building for a new era

units.zh: 新时代党建思想是新时代中国特色社会主义思想的党建篇，是党和人民实践经验和集体智慧的结晶。《决定》稿起草坚持以新时代党建思想为指导，在文件框架安排、总结成就和经验、分析形势和任务、明确指导思想和原则、提出政策举措上全面落实这一思想的要求，遵循马克思主义执政党建设规律，充分运用新时代全面从严治党宝贵经验，着力推动管党治党、兴党强党在守正中创新、在继承中发展。
units.en: The Thought on Party Building for a new era represents the Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era in the sphere of Party building. It stands as a crystallization of the practical experience and collective wisdom of the Party and the people. In drafting the document, we have followed the guidance of the Thought on Party Building for a new era and fully applied the requirements of this Thought in defining the framework of the document, reviewing the achievements and experience, analyzing the circumstances and tasks, clarifying the guiding philosophy and principles, and putting forth policy measures. We have also followed the laws underlying the development of a Marxist governing party and made the most of the valuable experience in exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance in the new era, aiming to seek development while carrying forward fine traditions and break new ground while upholding fundamental principles in the efforts to supervise, govern, develop, and strengthen the Party.

units.zh: 第二，服务使命任务。
units.en: Second, serve the Party’s missions and tasks

units.zh: 服从服务于党和国家事业发展，历来是党的建设的重要原则。《决定》稿起草坚持不忘初心、牢记使命，着眼于实现新时代新征程党的使命任务，注重把握管党治党、兴党强党和强国建设、民族复兴的内在联系，谋划提出各项政策举措都紧扣党和国家事业发展需要，确保持之以恒推进全面从严治党各方面部署都围绕中心、服务大局。
units.en: Complying with and serving the cause of the Party and the country has always been a major principle guiding Party building. In drafting the document, we have stayed true to the Party’s original aspiration and founding mission, while bearing in mind the Party’s missions and tasks on the new journey in the new era. Taking into account the inherent connection between efforts to supervise, govern, develop, and strengthen the Party on the one hand, and the goal of building a great country and advancing national rejuvenation on the other, we have formulated policy measures in line with the development of the cause of the Party and the country, ensuring that all of our arrangements for persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance focus on the central task and serve the overall interests.

units.zh: 第三，坚持严的基调。
units.en: Third, stay committed to rigorous governance

units.zh: 全面从严治党关键在严，持之以恒推进全面从严治党必须一以贯之、一严到底。《决定》稿起草牢牢把握党的建设各项工作标准要严，对各级党组织和党员、干部的教育管理监督要严，对不良作风和腐败现象整治措施要严，落实管党治党责任要严的要求，进一步深化和完善全面从严治党各项政策举措，鲜明释放越往后越严的强烈信号。同时，坚持严管厚爱结合、激励约束并重，做到既严格到位、约束到位，又激发全党积极性主动性创造性。
units.en: Being rigorous is the key to exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance. To persevere with the efforts in this regard, we must remain committed to rigorous governance through to the end. In drafting the resolution, we have firmly adhered to the principle of being rigorous in the following aspects: the implementation of standards in all initiatives of Party building; education, management, and oversight of Party organizations at all levels, Party members, and officials; the enforcement of the measures to address misconduct and corruption; and the fulfillment of responsibilities for Party self-supervision and self-governance. By further refining the policies and measures for full and rigorous Party self-governance, we have sent a strong signal of our commitment to being even more rigorous in the years ahead. At the same time, we should be strict with and also care for Party members and officials, and place equal emphasis on providing incentives and imposing constraints. In this way, we will ensure strict constraints on them while stimulating greater motivation, initiative, and creativity within the whole Party.

units.zh: 第四，突出问题导向。
units.en: Fourth, adopt a problem-oriented approach

units.zh: 全面从严治党是针对党内突出问题而展开的，持之以恒推进全面从严治党必须在巩固已有成果基础上不断研究新情况、解决新问题。《决定》稿抓住关键要害、聚焦突出问题谋篇布局。谋划思路举措坚持有什么问题就解决什么问题、什么问题突出就重点解决什么问题，找准问题症结，深入研究论证，提出有针对性的对策。
units.en: Our efforts in exercising full and rigorous self-governance aim at addressing prominent problems within the Party. To advance this work, we must continue to study new developments and solve new problems on the basis of consolidating the achievements already made. Therefore, the draft resolution has been laid out by highlighting pivotal issues and prominent problems. In devising plans and measures, we have adopted an approach that addresses whatever problems that come up, and focused on the most pressing ones. We have strived to pinpoint the crux of these problems and put forward targeted solutions based on in-depth analysis and deliberation.

units.zh: 第五，强化系统观念。
units.en: Fifth, enhance systems thinking

units.zh: 持之以恒推进全面从严治党是一项系统工程，必须把党的政治建设、思想建设、组织建设、作风建设、纪律建设和制度建设、反腐败斗争等作为一个有机整体来谋划和推进，着力健全全面从严治党体系。
units.en: Persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance is a systematic endeavor. We must take a holistic approach in planning and advancing the efforts to strengthen the Party politically, theoretically, and organizationally, as well as in terms of conduct, discipline, and institutions, and to combat corruption, with a focus on improving the system of exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance.

units.zh: 《决定》稿起草全面落实新时代党的建设总要求，坚持以党的政治建设为统领，注重党的各方面建设协同发力、各项政策措施衔接配套，注重以上率下、点面结合、标本兼治，注重形成上下贯通、条块结合、齐抓共管的工作格局，切实增强管党治党整体效能。
units.en: The draft resolution fully applies the overall requirements for Party building in the new era. Taking strengthening the Party politically as the overarching principle, it stresses coordinated efforts on all fronts of Party building and integration of all policies and measures. It also highlights the importance of leveraging the exemplary role of leading officials, focusing on both overall work and efforts in specific areas, addressing both symptoms and root causes, and establishing a working mechanism featuring cross-level alignment, concerted efforts from all departments and localities, and joint efforts of all sides. Thus, the overall effectiveness of Party self-supervision and self-governance will be improved.

units.zh: 文件起草中，党中央充分发扬民主，深入调查研究，广泛征求意见。1月31日，党中央发出通知，就党的二十届五中全会议题征求各地区各部门意见。同时，委托16家单位就23个重点课题开展研究。5月6日，我在上海主持召开座谈会，听取部分省区市主要负责同志意见。8月3日，《决定》稿下发党内一定范围征求意见，包括征求党内部分老同志意见，还专门听取了各民主党派中央、全国工商联负责人和无党派人士代表意见。
units.en: During the drafting process, the Central Committee has promoted full democratic engagement, conducted thorough surveys and studies, and sought extensive input. On January 31, it issued a notice on soliciting opinions from all localities and departments on the topic of the fifth plenary session of the 20th Central Committee. Meanwhile, 16 organizations were entrusted to carry out research on 23 major issues. On May 6, I presided over a symposium in Shanghai to hear the opinions of the principal leaders of a number of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the central government. On August 3, a draft resolution was issued to certain Party members for feedback, including retired senior Party officials, and dedicated meetings were held to solicit views from the central committees of other political parties in China, leaders of the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce, and prominent figures without party affiliation.

units.zh: 各方面一致认为，党中央决定党的二十届五中全会重点研究持之以恒推进全面从严治党问题，充分体现了我们党对加强自身建设的高度清醒和坚强意志。《决定》稿就持之以恒推进全面从严治党作出战略部署，必将成为推进新时代党的建设新的伟大工程的纲领性文件，对于进一步开创新时代管党治党、兴党强党新局面，团结带领全国各族人民以中国式现代化全面推进强国建设、民族复兴伟业，具有重大现实意义和长远指导意义。
units.en: All those consulted unanimously agree that the Central Committee’s decision to focus on the topic of persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance at the fifth plenary session of the 20th Central Committee fully reflects our Party’s keen awareness and strong will to strengthen itself. Outlining a strategic plan for persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance, the resolution will undoubtedly serve as a programmatic document for advancing the great new project of Party building in the new era. It is of great immediate importance and far-reaching guiding significance for our endeavors to break new ground in supervising, governing, developing, and strengthening the Party in the new era and to lead the Chinese people of all ethnic groups in a concerted effort to build a great country and advance national rejuvenation on all fronts through Chinese modernization.

units.zh: 与此同时，各方面提出许多好的意见和建议，文件起草组逐条研究，能吸收的尽量吸收。
units.en: With regard to its formulation, various sides have contributed many valuable comments and suggestions. The drafting group studied them one by one and incorporated as many of them as possible into the document.

units.zh: 《决定》稿起草期间，中央政治局常委会召开3次会议、中央政治局召开2次会议进行审议、修改，形成提交这次全会审议的《决定》稿。
units.en: During the drafting process, the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau met three times and the Political Bureau convened on two occasions to review and revise draft versions of the document. These efforts culminated in the final draft that we have submitted to this plenary session for deliberation.

units.zh: 三、关于《决定》稿的基本框架和主要内容
units.en: III. General Framework and Main Content

units.zh: 《决定》稿除了开头语和结束语，分三大板块。
units.en: In addition to the opening paragraph and a conclusion, the draft resolution consists of three sections.

units.zh: 第一板块为第一部分，是总论。阐述持之以恒推进全面从严治党的重要性紧迫性和总体要求，共5个方面内容。一是回顾100多年来我们党一以贯之加强党的建设、团结带领人民不断从胜利走向胜利的光辉历程。二是总结党的十八大以来全面从严治党取得的伟大成就，阐述形成新时代党建思想的重大意义。三是分析全面从严治党面临的新形势新任务新挑战。四是提出持之以恒推进全面从严治党的指导思想。五是阐明持之以恒推进全面从严治党遵循的7条原则。
units.en: The first section, Part I, gives an overview. It elaborates on the importance, urgency, and overall requirements of persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance from five aspects. First, it reviews our Party’s glorious journey over more than 100 years, along which it has consistently strengthened itself and united and led the people in winning one victory after another. Second, it summarizes the great achievements the Party has made in exercising full and rigorous self-governance since its 18th National Congress and explicates the profound significance of the Thought on Party Building for a new era. Third, it analyzes the new circumstances, tasks, and challenges our Party faces in exercising full and rigorous self-governance. Fourth, it puts forward the guiding philosophy for persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance. Fifth, it sets forth seven guiding principles that we must follow in advancing the efforts in this regard.

units.zh: 第二板块是分论，包括第二部分至第八部分。部署持之以恒推进全面从严治党的战略任务和重大举措。
units.en: The second section is the discussion section, which runs from the second through eighth parts. It makes arrangements for strategic tasks and major measures for persevering with full and rigorous Party self-governance.

units.zh: 其中，第二部分“增强共产党人的党性”，强调这是全面从严治党的根本性任务，从强化对党忠诚教育、坚持用党的创新理论凝心铸魂、用党的优良传统和中华优秀传统文化涵养党性、在实践中锤炼党性、加强党性鉴别等5个方面作出部署。
units.en: The second part focuses on strengthening the Party spirit of communists, which represents a fundamental task in our efforts to ensure full and rigorous Party self-governance. The main points include: strengthening education on loyalty to the Party; building cohesion and inner strength with the Party’s new theories; nurturing the Party spirit with the Party’s good traditions and fine traditional Chinese culture; tempering the Party spirit in practice; enhancing Party spirit appraisal.

units.zh: 第三部分“严格贯彻执行民主集中制”，强调这是全面从严治党的内在要求，从坚持和加强党中央集中统一领导、提高党内民主质量、严格执行领导班子决策议事规则、规范“一把手”履职用权等4个方面作出部署。
units.en: The third part makes it clear that strictly practicing democratic centralism is an inherent requirement for exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance. The main points include: upholding and strengthening the Party Central Committee’s centralized, unified leadership; improving the efficacy of intraparty democracy; strictly implementing deliberation rules and decision-making procedures for leadership teams; regulating leadership team heads’ performance of duties and exercise of power.

units.zh: 第四部分“锻造堪当民族复兴重任的高素质干部队伍”，强调全面从严治党关键在从严治吏，从坚持正确用人导向、精准科学选人用人、推动干部树立和践行正确政绩观、增强干部干事创业本领、提高培养选拔优秀年轻干部质量、加强干部管理监督等6个方面作出部署。
units.en: Under the heading of cultivating high-caliber officials capable of shouldering the mission of national rejuvenation, the fourth part emphasizes that strict management of officials is the key to full and rigorous governance over the Party. The main points include: following sound guidelines in appointing officials; taking targeted, well-designed measures to select and appoint officials; inspiring officials to foster and act on the correct view of performance; enhancing officials’ competence in fulfilling their duties and breaking new ground; improving the training and selection of outstanding young officials; strengthening management and oversight of officials.

units.zh: 第五部分“建设上下贯通、执行有力的严密组织体系”，强调党的各级组织是全面从严治党的主体，从发挥中央和国家机关党组织表率作用、强化地方党委功能、统筹推进各领域基层党组织建设、突出抓好新兴领域党的建设、加强党员队伍建设、完善党的各级组织贯通机制等6个方面作出部署。
units.en: The fifth part discusses building a well-knit organizational system characterized by cross-level alignment and effective implementation. Stressing that Party organizations at all levels play the principal role in exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance, it covers the following points: giving play to the exemplary role of Party organizations of central Party and state organs; bolstering the functions of local Party committees; taking coordinated steps to improve primary-level Party organizations across all sectors; promoting Party building in emerging sectors; building a strong contingent of Party members; refining mechanisms to ensure alignment across different levels of Party organizations.

units.zh: 第六部分“驰而不息正风肃纪”，强调这是全面从严治党的有力举措，从走好新时代党的群众路线、锲而不舍落实中央八项规定精神、推进作风建设常态化长效化、强化从严执纪、综合发挥纪律教育约束和保障激励作用等5个方面作出部署。
units.en: The sixth part stresses that improving conduct and tightening discipline on an ongoing basis are effective measures to advance full and rigorous Party self-governance. The main points include: following the Party’s mass line in the new era; steadfastly implementing the guiding principles from the central Party leadership’s eight-point decision on improving work conduct; devoting consistent and sustained efforts to improving conduct; making discipline enforcement more rigorous; making full use of discipline as a guide, restraint, guarantee, and incentive.

units.zh: 第七部分“坚定不移一体推进不敢腐不能腐不想腐”，强调这是全面从严治党的重要方略和反腐败斗争的基本方针，从保持惩治腐败高压态势、加强对权力运行的制约和监督、夯实崇廉拒腐思想根基、增强一体推进不敢腐不能腐不想腐综合效能等4个方面作出部署。
units.en: The seventh part defines taking firm and integrated action against corruption as both an important policy for full and rigorous Party self-governance and a fundamental principle for our fight against corruption. The main points include: maintaining a tough stance against corruption; strengthening checks on and oversight over the exercise of power; fortifying the cultural-ethical foundations for upholding integrity and resisting corruption; better preventing corruption through a holistic approach. Revolving around running the Party through institutions and regulations, the eighth part highlights strengthening Party regulations and institutions as a long-term, fundamental strategy for ensuring full and rigorous Party self-governance. The main points include: improving the framework of Party regulations and institutions; enhancing the implementation of institutions; eliminating hidden rules.

units.zh: 第三板块包括完善党和国家监督体系、落实全面从严治党政治责任。就这两方面分别作出部署。
units.en: The third section discusses improving Party and state oversight systems and fulfilling the political responsibility for full and rigorous Party self-governance. Specific arrangements are made therein.

units.zh: 同志们，
units.en: Comrades,

units.zh: 审议通过《决定》是这次全会的主要任务。大家要认真思考、深入讨论，提出建设性意见和建议，共同把这次全会开好、把《决定》稿修改好。
units.en: The key task of this plenary session is to review and adopt the resolution. I hope that all of you will give this draft your careful consideration, carry out in-depth discussions, and come up with constructive ideas and suggestions, so that we can work together to make this plenary session a success and make well-conceived revisions to the draft resolution.

files.name: 20261014李强在第140届中国进出口商品交易会开幕式上的主旨演讲 中英对照

units.zh: 在第140届中国进出口商品交易会开幕式上的主旨演讲 （2026年10月14日，广州） 中华人民共和国国务院总理 李强
units.en: Keynote Speech by H.E. Li Qiang Premier of the State Council of the People’s Republic of China At the Opening Ceremony of the 140th Session of China Import and Export Fair Guangzhou, October 14, 2026

units.zh: 尊敬的各位来宾， 女士们，先生们，朋友们：
units.en: Distinguished Guests, Ladies and Gentlemen, Friends,

units.zh: 很高兴同大家相聚在美丽的花城广州，共同出席第140届中国进出口商品交易会。我谨代表中国政府，对各位的到来表示热烈欢迎！对大家长期以来为促进中外经贸合作和发展所作出的积极贡献表示衷心感谢！
units.en: It is a great pleasure to join you in the beautiful Flower City Guangzhou for the 140th Session of China Import and Export Fair (Canton Fair). On behalf of the Chinese government, I would like to extend a warm welcome to you all, and express heartfelt appreciation for your long-standing, positive contribution to the economic and trade cooperation and development between China and other countries.

units.zh: 今年是广交会创办70周年。习近平主席专门发来贺信，充分肯定广交会取得的成绩，重申了中国扩大高水平开放的坚定决心。过去70年，广交会一步步发展壮大，展览面积从首届的9600平方米扩大到现在的155万平方米，采购商从最初的1200人增加到今年的30多万人，已经成为中国举办的历史最长、规模最大、成交最多的国际贸易盛会，同时也为国际社会了解中国提供了重要窗口。透过广交会这扇“窗”，世人看到了中国经济社会蕴藏的巨大活力，见证了中国亿万民众一路奋发进取的壮阔历程，更感受到中国和世界与日俱增的深厚联结。
units.en: This year marks the 70th anniversary of the Canton Fair. President Xi Jinping has sent a congratulatory letter to the Fair, acknowledging its past achievements and reaffirming China’s commitment to expanding high-standard opening up. Over the past 70 years, the Canton Fair has grown from strength to strength. Its exhibition area has expanded from 9,600 square meters in the first year to 1.55 million square meters today. The number of buyers has increased from 1,200 in the beginning to more than 300,000 this year. Among all the international trade exhibitions hosted by China, the Canton Fair has the longest history, the largest participation and the highest transaction volume. It is also an important window for the international community to observe China. Through this window, the world has witnessed the surging vitality of China’s economy and society, the enterprising journey undertaken by hundreds of millions of Chinese people, and the deepening connection between China and the world.

units.zh: 一是日益开放的中国为世界带来新机遇。70年来，广交会因开放而生、因开放而兴，国际“朋友圈”越来越大，采购商遍布220多个国家和地区，累计成交额达到1.6万亿美元。这背后，是中国以开放促发展的战略选择，也是各国经济优势互补、相互赋能的现实需要。中国已是160多个国家和地区的主要贸易伙伴，也是近80个国家和地区的第一大出口目的地，对外投资存量达到3.4万亿美元，既发展了自己，也造福了世界。
units.en: First, a China that keeps opening itself creates new opportunities for the world. Over the past 70 years, the Canton Fair has established itself and thrived on openness. Its circle of friends has grown bigger, with buyers coming from over 220 countries and regions, and the total value of business deals reaching US$1.6 trillion. What underlies this success is China’s strategic choice of boosting development through openness, and the practical need for countries around the world to leverage their economic strengths for mutual empowerment. China is now a key trading partner of over 160 countries and regions, and the top export destination for nearly 80 countries and regions. China’s stock of overseas investment has reached US$3.4 trillion. While developing itself, China has also brought benefits to the world.

units.zh: 二是持续创新的中国为世界提供新动能。70年来，广交会的展品不断焕新升级，从上世纪六七十年代的农副土特产品，到八九十年代的轻工机电产品，再到现在的具身智能、智慧医疗等，可以说日新月异。这背后，是中国坚持创新发展的快速进步，也是世界科技革命和产业变革的生动缩影。近年来，中国人工智能、绿色能源、生物医药等领域的新技术新产品新业态持续涌现，为世界经济增添新动力、打开新空间。
units.en: Second, a China that keeps innovating itself provides new impetus for the world. Over the past 70 years, exhibits at the Canton Fair have been continuously transformed and upgraded. From agricultural and subsidiary products and local specialties in the 1960s and 70s, to industrial and electromechanical products in the 1980s and 90s, and to embodied artificial intelligence (AI) and smart medical services today, each session of the Canton Fair presents an updated selection of exhibits. What underlies this transformation is China’s rapid progress in innovation-driven development, and the world’s scientific and technological revolution and industrial transformation. In recent years, new technologies, products and business forms in such areas as AI, green energy and biomedicine have continued to emerge in China, and generated new dynamism and space for the world economy.

units.zh: 三是重信守诺的中国为世界注入确定性。70年来，无论国际局势如何变化，广交会从未间断，对“重合同、守信用”的办会原则奉行不渝。这背后，是中国“言必信、行必果”的价值追求，也是国际社会对中国的认可信任。中国长期保持政策稳定性连续性，坚定履行降低关税水平、加强发展援助、应对气候变化等各方面承诺，在动荡变革的世界中展现出大国的责任担当。
units.en: Third, a China that always keeps its promise brings certainty to the world. Over the past 70 years, no matter how the international situation evolved, the Canton Fair has never been interrupted, and its commitment to the principle of honoring contracts and maintaining credibility remains steadfast. What underlies such commitment is the Chinese philosophy of matching words with actions, and the world’s recognition of and trust in China. China has all along kept its policies stable and consistent, firmly delivered on its commitment of lowering tariffs, increasing development assistance and addressing climate change, and undertaken the responsibilities of a major country in this turbulent and changing world.

units.zh: 纵观这70年，广交会之所以能够经受住国际风云变幻的考验，不断焕发新的生机活力，正是因为始终顺应经济全球化的大势、始终响应国际社会携手发展的期盼。这其中蕴含着一些朴素而深刻的启示，值得我们深入思考。这里我想分享三点体会，同大家交流。
units.en: Looking back on the past 70 years, the Canton Fair has stood the test of international vicissitudes and brimmed with new vigor and vitality. This is because it has all along followed the trend of economic globalization and answered the call of the international community for joint development. The journey of the Canton Fair offers some simple yet profound takeaways worthy of deep reflection. Here, I would like to share with you three main observations.

units.zh: 第一，市场联通不是国与国博弈工具，而是创造增量的有效举措。这些年，全球各类人为市场壁垒明显增多，有的甚至把经贸问题政治化、工具化、武器化，然而将这些外衣层层剥下，就会发现，保护主义总是深藏其中。理论和实践已经充分证明，市场从来就不是一成不变的，而更像一张四通八达的网络，只有连接更多新的网络，才能更好地形成规模经济、更高效地匹配供给需求，才能创造更多价值、开辟更大空间。保护主义看似能守住一国市场，却也切断了市场延伸拓展的可能，更会在新的全球市场网络中失去位置，最终是得不偿失。
units.en: First, market connectivity is not a tool for zero-sum games between countries, but an effective measure to foster new space for growth. The past few years have seen a notable rise in manmade market barriers of various sorts around the globe. Some have even chosen to politicize, instrumentalize, and weaponize economic and trade issues. However, no matter their forms, protectionism is always at the core. It has been fully proven by both theories and practices that the market is not static—it is more like a network that reaches out in all directions. Only when connected to more such networks, can a market achieve economy of scale, match supply with demand more efficiently, and create more value and space. Protectionism may seem effective for a country to sustain its market, but it also makes it impossible for the country to broaden its market. Worse still, it may even lose its place in the new global network of markets. At the end of the day, protectionism will only produce more losses than gains.

units.zh: 长期以来，中国致力于推动国内市场与国际市场不断融合、共同成长。我们的进口规模已经连续17年位居世界第二，去年超过18万亿元，今年前三季度又增长22.3%。中国开放了这么多年，市场不仅没有缩小，反而伴随引入各国的汽车、家电等新产品新产业，发掘培育了更多新的市场需求。同时，中国出口的优质产品特别是一些创新产品，也在持续推动全球市场拓展新的增量空间。中国愿同各国一道，继续构建开放型世界经济，加强彼此联通对接，把全球市场越做越大，让各方得到更多收益。
units.en: Throughout the years, China has been committed to integrating its domestic market with the international markets for joint growth. China has been the second largest importer in the world for 17 consecutive years, exceeding RMB 18 trillion yuan last year, and growing by another 22.3 percent in the first three quarters this year. Decades have passed since China opened itself to the world, yet its market has not contracted. Instead, the introduction of new products and industries from other countries, such as automobiles and home appliances, has unlocked and cultivated new market demands. Meanwhile, the export of quality Chinese products, especially innovative products, is opening up new space for the global marketplace. China is ready to work with all countries to build an open world economy and strengthen market connectivity so as to make the global market bigger and deliver greater benefits to all.

units.zh: 国际贸易不是账面数字，而是增进福祉的自主选择。近段时期，国际上对贸易平衡问题的讨论不少。经济规律表明，贸易平衡是短期的、相对的，不平衡是普遍的、动态的，这是各国比较优势、经济结构、产业分工等差异决定的。我们要看到，贸易的本质是互惠互利，不能简单认为顺差就是“占便宜”、逆差就是“吃亏了”。贸易平衡是在贸易各方各取所需、良性互动中自然趋近的，而不是靠筑墙设垒甚至打压遏制。如果一边搞出口管制，一边指望贸易平衡，这是不现实的，反而会推高成本、扰乱产供链，进一步加剧不平衡。我们需要的，是扩大开放、共同做大“蛋糕”的“向上平衡”，而不是封闭市场、必将导致萎缩的“向下平衡”。
units.en: Second, international trade is not just statistics in the books, but a voluntary choice aimed to improve people’s well-being. Recently, there have been quite some discussions about the issue of trade balance globally. The laws of economics tell us that a balanced position in trade is temporary and relative, while an imbalanced position is more common and non-static. This is determined by countries’ differences in comparative strengths, economic structures, distribution of labor, and other variables. We need to see that trade is mutually beneficial in nature. One cannot simply view surplus as “taking advantage” and deficit as “being ripped off.” A balanced trade would naturally arrive when the parties can satisfy their respective demands through positive interactions. It is not achieved by building walls, setting up barriers, or even suppressing and containing others. It is simply unrealistic to impose export control on others while looking for balanced trade at the same time. Such a practice will only push up costs, disrupt industrial and supply chains, and further aggravate the imbalance. What we need is “upward balance” achieved by opening up wider and making the economic pie bigger, not “downward balance” resulting from market closure and the inevitable market contraction that follows.

units.zh: 现在一些人谈及中国贸易，往往只看到进出口数字，而没有关注到背后的真实效应。中国既是“超级卖家”，也是“超级买家”。作为“超级卖家”，我们给各方带来的更多是“惠邻效应”。无数勤劳的中国劳动者用汗水智慧铸就的高性价比商品，大幅提升了全球消费者的实际购买力，提高了各国民众生活质量，增强了相关国家的产业发展能力。作为“超级买家”，我们给各方带来的更多是“富邻效应”。很多国家的农产品、工业品、消费品源源不断销往中国，转化为当地企业利润、居民工资和政府税收。中国从不刻意追求顺差，更何况现在很多时候是“顺差在中国，利益在各方”，大量在华外资企业产品出口全球、获得丰厚收益。我们愿意购买更多外国产品特别是高附加值产品，去年至今已累计举办约70场“共享大市场·出口中国”活动，下个月还将在上海举办第九届中国国际进口博览会。希望更多国家同我们相向而行、放开限制，积极推动贸易优化平衡发展。
units.en: Some current discussions about China’s trade focus on import and export statistics, but overlook the real effects behind them. China is both a “super seller” and a “super buyer.” As a “super seller,” China brings benefits to its trading partners. Quality, affordable goods made by diligent Chinese workers with their labor and wisdom have significantly increased the actual purchasing power of global consumers, improved their quality of life, and helped countries strengthen their capacity for industrial development. As a “super buyer,” China helps to boost the prosperity of other countries. China is a major buyer of agricultural, industrial, and consumer goods from many countries, which translate into profits for local businesses, income for the people, and revenues for the governments. China never seeks surplus intentionally, not to mention the fact that most of the times, the benefits are shared by all parties, despite the surplus being recorded in China. A large number of foreign-invested enterprises in China export their products across the world and secure big returns. We would like to buy more products from across the world, especially high value-added products. Since last year, we have hosted around 70 events themed “Big Market for All: Export to China.” Next month, we will host the ninth China International Import Expo in Shanghai. China hopes that more countries will work together in the same direction, lift restrictions, and pursue better, balanced development of trade.

units.zh: 互利共赢不是单向妥协，而是相互赋能的彼此成就。通往全球繁荣发展之路，零和博弈不可取，互利共赢才是正途。要实现真正的共赢，不能依靠简单的对价交换，更不能依靠强压下的妥协让步，而需要平等相待、双向奔赴、共同成长。当前国际产供链各环节彼此嵌套、紧密衔接，只要各国精诚协作、取长补短，就能实现更高水平、更可持续的共赢。在这其中，发达国家应当更加积极行动，给予发展中国家更多资金技术支持、经贸政策优惠，帮助他们提高产业水平、增强发展内生动力。
units.en: Third, win-win cooperation does not mean one-sided concession but mutual empowerment and success. On the path toward global prosperity and development, win-win cooperation is the only right choice. A zero-sum approach hurts everybody. For true win-win cooperation to happen, we cannot rely on a simple quid pro quo, still less compromise or concessions under pressure. What we need is to treat each other as equals, meet each other halfway, and make progress together. With all the links of global industrial and supply chains interlocked and closely connected, it is possible to realize more sustainable win-win cooperation at a higher level if countries work together in good faith and draw on each other’s strengths. In this process, developed countries should take more proactive actions, provide developing countries with more capital and technological support and preferential economic and trade policies to help boost their industries and strengthen the internal drivers of growth.

units.zh: 中国作为最大的发展中国家，始终致力于推动共同发展，在自身发展的同时，一直尽最大努力帮助和支持其他发展中国家。这些年，中国推动高质量共建“一带一路”，越来越多发展中国家，依托中国的产品、技术和资金，完善本国工业体系、提升高端出口能力，产业升级持续加快，在全球价值链中的位置不断攀升。中国在海外投资设立的企业已超5万家，近九成布局在全球南方国家，其中不少国家的制造业快速崛起，出口创汇大幅增长。中国将永远是发展中国家可信赖、可倚重的好朋友，愿在现代化的道路上帮助他们铺路架桥，与之携手相伴、坚定同行。
units.en: China, as the largest developing country, is committed to advancing common development. While developing itself, China has done its utmost to help and support other developing countries. Over the years, China has been advancing high-quality Belt and Road cooperation. More and more fellow developing countries, supported by China’s products, technology and capital, have improved their domestic industrial systems, raised high-end export capacity, kept accelerating industrial upgrade, and as a result, continued to move up the global value chain. There are over 50,000 overseas companies set up with Chinese investments, 90 percent of which are in Global South countries. Many of these countries have seen their manufacturing rapidly growing and foreign exchange earnings from exports rising significantly. China will always be a good friend that other developing countries can trust and rely on. China stands ready to help pave the way for other developing countries as they pursue modernization. We will join hands and move forward together with fellow developing countries.

units.zh: 多年来，中国一直是全球开放合作的积极践行者，坚持以自身所能为世界所需作出重要贡献。今年面对国际形势变乱交织，中国经济顶住压力稳健前行，展现出强大韧性和活力，我们有信心有能力完成全年经济社会发展目标任务。中国将持续推动高质量发展，扩大高水平开放，以积极务实行动，为世界经济增添更多动力。
units.en: Over the years, China has been actively carrying out global open cooperation and made important contribution to meeting the world’s needs with its utmost efforts. This year, confronted with global changes and turbulence, the Chinese economy has withstood pressure and forged ahead steadily, demonstrating robust resilience and vitality. We are confident and capable of accomplishing the goals and tasks for economic and social development this year. China will continue to advance high-quality development, expand high-standard opening up, and take more practical actions to inject more momentum into the world economy.

units.zh: 一是分享更多市场机遇。中国超大规模市场需求正在加快释放，去年社会消费品零售总额首次突破50万亿元，未来5年预计再增长约10万亿元。我们将坚定实施扩大内需战略，促进消费升级，同时进一步降低市场准入门槛，加强对企业的服务保障。欢迎更多外国企业来华投资兴业。
units.en: First, we will share more market opportunities. The demand of China’s supersized market is unleashing at a faster pace. Last year, total retail sales of consumer goods exceeded RMB 50 trillion yuan for the first time, and are expected to increase by about another RMB 10 trillion yuan in the next five years. We will firmly implement the strategy of expanding domestic demand and advance consumption upgrade, further lower the threshold of market access, and provide better services and safeguards for enterprises. We welcome more foreign companies to do business in China.

units.zh: 二是拓展更多互利合作。中国将坚持与世界同进步，深化与各国发展战略对接，支持有实力的中国企业有序赴海外投资，加强技术交流，拓展新兴领域合作，开展更多本土化经营，助力当地产业提质增效和经济发展。
units.en: Second, we will expand more mutually beneficial cooperation. China is committed to pursuing progress together with the world and deepening alignment of development strategies with other countries. We support capable Chinese companies in investing overseas in an orderly manner, strengthening technological exchanges, expanding cooperation in emerging sectors, and conducting more localized operations, to help upgrade local industries and boost local economy.

units.zh: 三是坚定维护国际经贸秩序。中国将始终站在历史正确的一边，坚定维护多边主义和自由贸易，支持世贸组织改革发展，与各方一道探索制定面向未来的国际经贸规则，不断改革完善全球经济治理，推进普惠包容的经济全球化。
units.en: Third, we will firmly uphold international economic and trade order. China will always stand on the right side of history, firmly uphold multilateralism and free trade, and support WTO reform and development. We will work with all parties to explore and make future-oriented international economic and trade rules, reform and improve global economic governance, and advance a universally beneficial and inclusive economic globalization.

units.zh: 70年春华秋实。相信广交会一定会常办常新、越办越好。祝愿大家在这里结识更多新朋友、达成更多新合作、收获更多新成果。让我们一道努力，共同开创更加美好的未来！ 谢谢大家！（完）
units.en: Seven decades of hard work have yielded fruitful results. I believe the Canton Fair will make new and even better progress going forward. I hope that you will make more friends here, carry out more cooperation, and reap more fruits. Let us work together to usher in a better future. Thank you.

files.name: 20260928韩正在第81届联大一般性辩论上的讲话 中英对照

units.zh: 韩正在第81届联大一般性辩论上的讲话
units.en: Statement by H.E. Han Zheng Vice President of the People’s Republic of China At the General Debate of the 81st Session of The United Nations General Assembly

units.zh: 顺应发展潮流 勇担历史使命
units.en: Riding the Waves of Development and Shouldering Our Historic Responsibilities
New York, September 26, 2026

units.zh: 中华人民共和国副主席 韩正 主席先生，各位同事：
units.en: Mr. President, Colleagues,

units.zh: 当前，国际形势变乱交织，地缘冲突延宕不止、发展鸿沟持续扩大、全球性挑战层出不穷。5年前，习近平主席在第76届联合国大会上提出全球发展倡议，之后又相继提出全球安全倡议、全球文明倡议、全球治理倡议，为构建人类命运共同体提供了战略指引。在各国前途命运紧密相连的今天，越来越多的国家愿携起手来，担当历史使命，应对困难挑战，增进人类共同福祉。为此，我愿提4点建议。
units.en: The world is witnessing intertwined changes and turbulence, protracted geopolitical conflicts, widening development gaps and a growing number of global challenges. Five years ago, at the 76th Session of the U.N. General Assembly, President Xi Jinping put forward the Global Development Initiative. Since then, he has proposed the Global Security Initiative, the Global Civilization Initiative and the Global Governance Initiative. These initiatives provide strategic guidance for the building of a community with a shared future for humanity. At a time when countries of the world find their future so closely linked, more and more of them want to join hands to shoulder the historic mission of addressing difficulties and challenges, and advancing the well-being of all humanity. With this in mind, I propose that we take the following four steps.

units.zh: 第一，维护战后国际秩序，以共同安全构筑持久和平。世界要和平、不要战争。二战后形成的以联合国为核心的国际体系和以国际法为基础的国际秩序，必须加以维护。要践行共同、综合、合作、可持续的安全观，摒弃冷战思维、阵营对抗，坚持通过对话协商化解分歧和争端，反对违反联合国宪章、绕开联合国安理会授权的单边军事行动。大国对国际和平和安全负有特殊责任，尤其要带头守规矩、讲法治、行正道。
units.en: First, we should safeguard the postwar international order and foster lasting peace based on common security. The world wants peace, not war. The international system centered on the U.N. and the international order underpinned by international law that emerged after World War II must be upheld. We should turn into action the vision of common, comprehensive, cooperative, and sustainable security, and reject the Cold War mindset and bloc confrontation. We should settle differences and disputes through dialogue and consultation, and oppose unilateral military actions that violate the U.N. Charter and circumvent Security Council authorization. Major countries shoulder special responsibilities for safeguarding international peace and security, and they should take the lead in complying with rules, upholding rule of law and doing what’s right.

units.zh: 中方认为，中东海湾国家的主权和安全都应当得到尊重，国际产业链供应链稳定畅通和贸易往来应当得到保障。中方呼吁秉持“巴人治巴”原则推进约旦河西岸治理和加沙战后重建，推动巴勒斯坦问题早日重回“两国方案”正确轨道。在乌克兰问题上，中方始终以习近平主席提出的“四个应该”为根本遵循，将继续以自己的方式为危机政治解决发挥建设性作用。中方敦促有关国家立即停止对古巴武力威胁，立即全面取消对古巴封锁制裁。
units.en: China holds that the sovereignty and security of countries in the Middle East including the Gulf should be respected, international industrial and supply chains should be kept stable and unimpeded, and global trade should be safeguarded. China calls for advancing the governance of the West Bank and the post-conflict reconstruction of Gaza in accordance with the principle of the Palestinians governing Palestine. It also calls for bringing the Palestinian question back onto the right track of the two-state solution at an early date. On Ukraine, President Xi Jinping has put forward four points on what must be done, which are the fundamental guidance for China in playing a continued, constructive role in its own way for achieving a political settlement of the crisis. China urges the relevant country to immediately stop using threat of force against Cuba and immediately and completely lift the blockade and sanctions against Cuba.

units.zh: 第二，直面全球发展困境，以开放合作促进共同繁荣。要始终将发展置于国际议程中心位置，共建团结、平等、均衡、普惠的全球发展伙伴关系。要聚焦减贫、粮食安全、能源转型等重点领域，进一步加大资源投入和对全球南方国家的支持。发达国家应切实兑现发展筹资和气候融资承诺。国际社会还应当为制定2030年后全球发展议程凝聚共识和力量。面对新一轮科技革命和产业变革特别是人工智能技术的蓬勃发展，要秉持以人为本、向上向善理念，努力缩小数字鸿沟，共促普惠发展。
units.en: Second, we should address the global development predicament and promote prosperity for all through openness and cooperation. We should keep development at the center of the international agenda, and jointly forge a global development partnership based on unity and equality and that is balanced and inclusive. It is important to give priority to key areas including poverty reduction, food security and energy transition, step up resource input, and increase support for countries in the Global South. Developed countries should honor their commitment to development financing and climate financing. The international community should also build consensus and pool strengths to formulate the post-2030 global development agenda. Facing a new scientific and technological revolution and industrial transformation, especially the dynamic development of artificial intelligence, we should take a people-centered approach and develop AI for the positive and for good, narrow the digital divide, and promote development that is universally beneficial.

units.zh: 历史和现实都证明，各国发展离不开开放合作的国际环境，保护主义没有赢家，搞“筑墙设垒”、“脱钩断链”扰乱全球产业链供应链稳定畅通，损害各方利益。要坚定维护以世界贸易组织为核心、以规则为基础的多边贸易体制，坚持建设开放型世界经济，共同培育壮大增长新动能，推动普惠包容的经济全球化。
units.en: Both history and reality prove that countries can hardly achieve development without an open and cooperative international environment. Protectionism produces no winners; building walls, erecting barriers, decoupling and cutting off supply chains disrupt global industrial and supply chains and harm the interests of all parties. We must firmly safeguard the WTO-centered, rules-based multilateral trading system, build an open world economy, jointly foster and strengthen new growth drivers, and see that economic globalization is inclusive and delivers benefits to all.

units.zh: 第三，促进文明交流互鉴，以沟通对话重建团结互信。世界因多样而精彩。不同文明相处，居高临下不可取，唯我独尊不可行，相互尊重、和衷共济、和合共生才是正确之路。要立足联合国平台加强国际人文交流，以庆祝“文明对话国际日”为契机，促进各国人民相知相亲，推动多元文明共同进步。要摒弃意识形态偏见，尊重各国人民自主选择的发展道路和社会制度，深化治国理政经验交流，共同探索破解时代难题。
units.en: Third, we should advance exchanges and mutual learning among civilizations and rebuild unity and mutual trust through communication and dialogue. Diversity has created splendor in the world. Condescension and a self-centered mindset have no place in the interactions among different cultures. Promoting mutual respect, solidarity and harmonious coexistence is the right approach to take. We need to use the U.N. platform to boost international people-to-people exchanges, and take the celebration of the International Day for Dialogue Among Civilizations as an occasion to promote mutual understanding and amity among all peoples and the common development of diverse civilizations. We should reject ideological prejudice, and respect the development paths and social systems decided on independently by the people of all countries. We should deepen the sharing of governance practices and jointly explore ways to tackle challenges facing our times.

units.zh: 第四，高举多边主义旗帜，以实际行动捍卫公平正义。多边主义是人类历经劫难后的共同选择，公平正义是各国人民的共同追求。中方主张，国家不分大小，都是国际社会平等一员；世界上的事，要由大家商量着办，共同维护国际法治和公平正义。各国应当团结起来、行动起来，维护联合国、壮大联合国。中方支持联合国改革完善，推进“联合国80周年改革倡议”，不只简单做预算与授权的减法，更要做好机构效能的加法，有效应对气候变化、公共卫生安全等全球性挑战，完善网络、外空、极地等领域治理规则，真正扩大全球南方代表性和发言权。
units.en: Fourth, we should stay committed to multilateralism and take steps to safeguard fairness and justice. Multilateralism is the choice made by humanity after going through scourges, and fairness and justice are the joint pursuit of the people of all countries. China holds that all countries, big or small, are equal members of the international community, and that world affairs should be handled by all through consultation, and rule of law, fairness and justice in international affairs should be jointly upheld. Countries should join forces and act together to safeguard the U.N. and make it stronger. China supports the U.N. in reforming and improving itself. It should advance the U.N. 80 Initiative and enhance the performance of its bodies rather than merely cut its budgets and mandates. It should effectively address global challenges including climate change and public health security, improve governance rules in such areas as cyberspace, outer space and polar regions, and truly increase the representation and voice of the Global South.

units.zh: 中方向任职即将届满的古特雷斯秘书长致以崇高敬意。中方支持根据联合国宪章规定，选出一位恪守宪章、能力出众、公道正派、履职担当的新任秘书长。
units.en: China pays high tribute to Secretary General António Guterres who will complete his term soon. China supports the election, in accordance with the U.N. Charter, of a new secretary general who honors the U.N. Charter, has exceptional capability, upholds integrity and fairness, and demonstrates courage and dedication.
