Enhancing the influence and resilience of domestic industries through competition and cooperation between countries is a legitimate demand that should not be subject to artificial political interference which distorts the market’s underlying logic for reasonable flow of global resources and production factors. Overstretching and politicizing concepts such as “diversification” and “de-risking” will only lead to missed development opportunities. All parties should respect the investment decisions and autonomy of market entities in business planning, and build a fair, stable and predictable business environment, so that the nature of the market will be reaffirmed for businesses to act in accordance with economic laws.

units.zh: （三）加强产业政策协调，维护良好合作环境。
units.en: C. Strengthening coordination of industrial policies and maintaining a sound cooperation environment.

units.zh: 主要经济体在全球产供链合作中参与度深、影响力大，产业政策具有外溢性，应加强沟通协调，增进互信，发挥表率作用。
units.en: Major economies are deeply involved in and have a significant impact on global cooperation along industrial and supply chains. Considering the spill-over effects of their industrial policies, they should, therefore, strengthen communication and coordination, enhance mutual trust, and set a good example.

units.zh: 共同推动全球产供链稳定畅通。主要经济体应坚持平等协商、妥善管控分歧，摒弃单边主义、保护主义，反对歧视性、排他性做法，避免封闭设限、逐底竞争，给全球产业合作制造更多障碍和不稳定因素。欧美对华经贸限制措施严重损害双方互信和合作，也严重损害欧美自身利益，对全球经济发展和产业合作带来不利影响。
units.en: Working together to keep global industrial and supply chains stable and unimpeded. Major economies should commit to equal-footed consultation, manage differences properly, reject unilateralism and protectionism, oppose discriminatory and exclusive practices, and avoid self-isolation, restrictive measures and the race to the bottom, which would create more barriers and instabilities to global industrial cooperation. Economic and trade restrictions imposed by Europe and the U.S. on China not only are detrimental to mutual trust and cooperation, but also undermine their own interests, with an adverse impact on global economic development and industrial cooperation.

units.zh: 加强多双边产业政策对话。各方应依托多双边平台，健全产业政策常态化沟通机制，坚持公开透明，阐明政策目标，以建设性对话消弭误解、回应关切。在世贸组织框架下加强补贴透明度交流，通过平等协商妥善处理分歧，按期提交补贴通报并主动回应成员关切，共同营造稳定可预期的制度环境。
units.en: Strengthening multilateral and bilateral dialogue on industrial policies. Based on multilateral and bilateral platforms, all parties should improve mechanisms for regular exchange on industrial policies, uphold openness and transparency, clarify policy objectives, and clear up misunderstandings and respond to concerns through constructive dialogues. All parties should strengthen communication on subsidy transparency under the WTO framework, resolve differences properly through equal-footed consultation, and submit notifications on subsidies on time and proactively respond to members’ concerns, so as to jointly create a stable and predictable institutional environment.

units.zh: （四）扩大市场开放，共创合作机遇。
units.en: D. Expanding market openness and jointly creating cooperation opportunities.

units.zh: 开放带来进步，封闭必然落后。各方应拆除壁垒，扩大开放，不断挖掘市场潜力，为产业合作提供更大的空间。
units.en: Openness brings progress, while isolation leads to backwardness. All parties should break down barriers, open up further, and continuously tap into market potential to create broader space for industrial cooperation.

units.zh: 削减贸易往来壁垒。贸易规模越大，出现分歧摩擦越难避免。把眼光只放在“筑墙”上，只会加大矛盾，无助于问题解决。各方应坚持开放合作，促进国内外要素跨境流动便利化，促进市场充分竞争，激发企业活力，不断丰富新供给、创造新需求。封闭的结果，只能是市场没有源头活水，创新发展受到更大阻滞。
units.en: Reducing trade barriers. The larger the scale of trade, the harder it is to avoid differences and frictions. Focusing on “building walls” will only intensify contradictions and do no good to resolving issues. All parties should, in the spirit of openness and cooperation, facilitate cross-border flow of domestic and international factors of production, promote full competition in the market, boost business vitality, and continuously enrich new supply and create new demand. Self-isolation will only deprive the market of growth engines, which will further hold back innovative development.

units.zh: 减少投资合作障碍。投资合作是做大蛋糕、拉紧纽带、增进互利的重要途径，既满足当地需求，也带动东道国发展。各方应放宽投资领域准入限制，简化程序、消除壁垒，为外国投资者提供公平、透明、可预期的环境，更好保护投资者的正当合法权益。反对嘴上欢迎、行动上挑三拣四，更不能以外资审查条例、外国补贴条例为武器，对企业进行歧视性调查，施加强制性要求。
units.en: Reducing barriers to investment cooperation. As an important channel to make the pie bigger, tighten bonds and enhance mutual benefits, investment cooperation not only meets local needs but also boosts development of the host country. All parties should ease access restrictions in investment sector, streamline procedures and remove barriers to provide a fair, transparent and predictable environment for foreign investors, and better protect the legitimate and lawful rights and interests of investors. We oppose saying welcome as a lip service while cherrypicking in practice, as well as conducting discriminatory investigations into and imposing mandatory requirements on companies by using foreign investment screening regulation and foreign subsidies regulation as weapons.

units.zh: （五）坚持多边主义，构建更加公正合理的国际经济秩序。
units.en: E. Upholding multilateralism and building a more just and equitable international economic order.

units.zh: 多边主义是人类社会汲取两次世界大战惨痛教训得来的宝贵财富，需要国际社会倍加珍惜。
units.en: Multilateralism, a valuable lesson humanity has learned from the two painful world wars, should be all the more cherished by the international community.

units.zh: 坚守世贸组织基本原则和规则。以公平、透明、非歧视、开放为基本原则的世贸规则体系，是多年以来维护全球经济贸易稳定发展的基石，多边贸易理念深入人心，谁也不想再回到弱肉强食的丛林时代。各方应与时俱进推进世贸组织改革，重振世贸组织权威性、推动世贸组织规则更新、重建世贸组织成员信任，坚持最惠国待遇原则，共同努力把全球贸易稳定在多边框架下，稳定在各方共同接受的规则下，最大程度保障不同经济体在国际经贸往来中的正当权益。
units.en: Upholding fundamental principles and rules of the WTO. The WTO rules system underpinned by principles such as fairness, transparency, non-discrimination and openness has served as a cornerstone for the stable development of global economy and trade for years. The idea of multilateral trade is well entrenched, and no one wants to go back to the jungle era where the strong bully the weak. All parties should advance WTO reform in a manner that keeps pace with the times, restore the WTO’s authority, promote the upgrading of WTO rules, rebuild trust among WTO members, adhere to the most-favored-nation (MFN) principle, and work together to anchor global trade within the multilateral framework and in the rules that are acceptable to all, to protect the legitimate rights and interests of different economies in global trade and economic exchanges to the greatest extent possible.

units.zh: 促进全球治理体系更加公正合理。各方在经贸往来中应坚持平等互利，尊重对方发展阶段和国情实际，共同抵制以大欺小、以强凌弱，特别是不能以损害第三国利益为代价，来换取与强权媾和。各方应坚持真正的公平竞争，努力让自己跑得更快，而不是绊倒别人；不能说一套、做一套，也不能只允许自己干、不让别人干。更好发挥G20、金砖国家、APEC等多边和区域合作机制作用，共同守护公平正义，完善全球经济治理体系。
units.en: Making the global governance system more just and equitable. All parties should stay committed to equality and mutual benefit in trade and economic exchanges, respect the development stages and national conditions of each other, and jointly reject the big and strong bullying the small and weak and in particular making peace with major powers at the expense of third countries’ interests. All parties should uphold genuine fair competition and make efforts to run faster in stead of tripping others, avoid inconsistency between words and actions, and refrain from prohibiting others from doing what they allow themselves to do. Multilateral and regional cooperation mechanisms such as G20, BRICS, and APEC should be better leveraged to jointly defend fairness and justice and improve the system for global economic governance.

units.zh: 结束语
units.en: Conclusion

units.zh: 产能问题是世界经济发展过程中伴随产业迭代、市场波动、分工演变出现的正常现象。各国应坚持以市场眼光和全球视野，从经济规律出发，客观、辩证看待所谓的产能“争议”，多探讨合作而非制造对立，共同致力于打通全球供需堵点，优化全球资源配置，推动全球产业健康可持续发展。
units.en: The issue of capacity is a natural outgrowth of industrial iteration, market volatility and evolving division of labor amid global economic development. All countries should view the so-called capacity “controversy” objectively and dialectically on the basis of economic laws with a market-oriented and global perspective, focus more on exploring cooperation rather than creating confrontation, work together to remove bottlenecks in global supply and demand, optimize global resource allocation, and promote the sound and sustainable development of global industries.

units.zh: 各国经济，相通则共进，相闭则各退。中国的发展离不开世界，世界的繁荣也需要中国。中国愿同各方一道，维护全球自由贸易体制，维护全球产业链供应链稳定畅通，维护开放合作的国际环境，推动全球经济向着更可持续、更为普惠的方向发展，促进世界共同繁荣，让发展成果惠及各国人民。
units.en: Economies make progress through exchange and inter-connectivity and fall behind because of seclusion and closeness. China cannot develop in isolation from the rest of the world, nor can the world as a whole maintain prosperity without China. China stands ready to work with all parties to safeguard the global free trade system, the stability and smooth functioning of global industrial and supply chains, and an open and cooperative global environment, so as to make the global economy more sustainable and universally beneficial, promote common prosperity for the world, and ensure that development outcomes benefit all peoples.

files.name: 20261119习近平在亚太经合组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议上的讲话 中英对照

units.zh: 建设亚太共同体，续写“亚太奇迹”新篇章 ——在亚太经合组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议上的讲话 （2026年11月19日，深圳） 中华人民共和国主席 习近平
units.en: Building an Asia-Pacific Community and Writing a New Chapter of the Asia-Pacific Miracle Remarks by H.E. Xi Jinping President of the People’s Republic of China At the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting Shenzhen, November 19, 2026

units.zh: 各位同事：
units.en: Dear Colleagues,

units.zh: 很高兴同大家相聚在美丽的深圳，共谋亚太合作大计。
units.en: I am delighted to welcome you to the beautiful city of Shenzhen to discuss the future of Asia-Pacific cooperation.

units.zh: 30多年前，亚太经合组织应运而生，开启了建设亚太共同体的壮阔历程。30多年来，亚太地区面貌日新月异，创造了经济快速发展的“亚太奇迹”。
units.en: The launch of APEC more than 30 years ago started a remarkable journey toward building an Asia-Pacific community. Over three decades and more, our region has witnessed progress with each passing day, and created the Asia-Pacific miracle of rapid economic growth.

units.zh: 当前，世界百年变局加速演进，科技创新和产业创新方兴未艾。面对新的机遇和挑战，亚太合作必须适应新形势、迈出新步伐、开创新局面，推动建设和衷共济、开放融通、开拓创新、包容发展的亚太共同体。
units.en: Today, momentous changes not seen in a century are accelerating across the globe. Innovation is burgeoning across sciences, technologies and industries. In the face of new opportunities and challenges, we must adapt to the new realities, take new strides, and open up new prospects for Asia-Pacific cooperation. Together, we must strive to build an Asia-Pacific community characterized by solidarity and mutual assistance, openness and integration, enterprise and innovation, as well as inclusive development.

units.zh: ——建设亚太共同体，要坚持和衷共济。浩瀚的太平洋承载千帆、滋养万物，造就了亚太地区兼收并蓄、和合共生的磅礴气象。亚太大家庭的成员同在一条船上，要经受住太平洋的风浪，就应当勠力同心、守望相助，拉紧共同利益纽带，携手应对困难和挑战，持续培育共同体意识。
units.en: —Building an Asia-Pacific community requires solidarity and mutual assistance. The vast Pacific Ocean, which carries thousands of ships and nurtures all life, has shaped the all-embracing character of the Asia-Pacific region—one defined by inclusiveness and harmonious coexistence. Members of APEC are like passengers riding the same ship. To navigate the waves of the Pacific, we must unite as one and look out for each other. We must expand our shared interests, meet the difficulties and challenges together, and steadily build a shared sense of community.

units.zh: ——建设亚太共同体，要坚持开放融通。开放合作是亚太发展振兴的必由之路。要秉持开放的区域主义，稳步推进经济一体化进程，构建开放而不排他、融合而不分割的合作格局。倡导自由开放的贸易和投资，打通要素流动堵点，畅通经济循环经脉，为亚太经济增长开拓更广阔空间。
units.en: —Building an Asia-Pacific community requires openness and integration. Open cooperation is a sure path to the development and revitalization of the Asia-Pacific. We should uphold open regionalism, steadily advance economic integration and develop a cooperation pattern that is open and integrated, rather than exclusive or fragmented. We should champion free and open trade and investment, remove impediments to the flow of factors, ensure the smooth circulation of economic lifeblood, and open up more space for economic growth in the Asia-Pacific.

units.zh: ——建设亚太共同体，要坚持开拓创新。创新是引领发展的第一动力。要鼓励科技交流合作，促进创新成果转化，营造开放、公平、公正、非歧视的合作环境。发扬进取精神，放大亚太经合组织孵化器作用，推动机制理念创新和结构性改革，不断释放亚太经济的活力和潜力。
units.en: —Building an Asia-Pacific community requires enterprise and innovation. Innovation is the primary driving force of development. It is vital to encourage scientific and technological exchanges and cooperation, facilitate the commercialization of innovation outcomes, and foster an open, fair, just and nondiscriminatory environment for cooperation. We need to carry forward our enterprising spirit, enhance APEC’s role as an incubator to encourage innovation in institutions and ideas as well as structural reform, and further unleash the economic dynamism and potential of our region.

units.zh: ——建设亚太共同体，要坚持包容发展。亚太经济体多样性突出，发展诉求各异。要因势利导推进合作，让发展成果普惠共享，增加民众获得感，照顾各方舒适度，为实现亚太共同体目标积累有利条件。
units.en: —Building an Asia-Pacific community requires inclusive development. Each with different development needs, Asia-Pacific economies are known for our diversity. We should advance cooperation where conditions allow, make sure development benefits everyone, deliver for the people, accommodate the comfort level of all parties, and foster favorable conditions for turning the vision of an Asia-Pacific community into reality.

units.zh: 各位同事！
units.en: Dear Colleagues,

units.zh: 中国是亚太经济合作的倡导者、推动者、先行者。中方愿同各方一道，集思广益、汇聚合力，携手搭建亚太共同体的“四梁八柱”。
units.en: China is an advocate, promoter and forerunner of Asia-Pacific economic cooperation. We would like to work with all parties to pool wisdom and synergy in building the four key pillars of an Asia-Pacific community.

units.zh: 强化经贸支柱。亚太自由贸易区是亚太经合组织成员的共同愿景，要稳步向前推进，打造更高水平的开放格局。要推动区域经贸协定对接，提升贸易投资便利化、数字化水平，减少贸易投资壁垒。围绕亚太自贸区加强政策对话，开展经验交流和技术合作，提高各方参与高水平经贸安排的能力。
units.en: First, we should strengthen the pillar of economy and trade. The Free Trade Area of the Asia-Pacific (FTAAP) is a shared vision of APEC members. It is important to make steady progress in realizing this vision and setting a higher standard for openness. Efforts should be made to align various regional economic and trade agreements, boost trade and investment facilitation and digitalization, and reduce barriers to trade and investment. It is also important to enhance policy dialogue on the FTAAP, and carry out experience sharing and technical cooperation, to help the parties build capacity for participating in high-standard economic and trade arrangements.

units.zh: 第二，升级联通支柱。互联互通是区域经济一体化的纽带。2014年，我们共同制定亚太经合组织互联互通蓝图。今天，区域互联互通迎来新的机遇。要巩固“硬联通”，完善基础设施网络，推动智慧海关、智慧交通建设。增强“软联通”，促进政策和监管协调，深化跨境支付合作，维护产业链供应链稳定畅通。密切“心联通”，便利商旅和人员往来，促进人文交流和民众相知相亲。
units.en: Second, we should upgrade the pillar of connectivity. Connectivity is a nexus of regional economic integration. In 2014, we jointly developed the APEC Connectivity Blueprint. Today, there are new opportunities for regional connectivity. We should strengthen physical connectivity by improving the infrastructure network, and developing smart customs and smart transportation. We should deepen institutional connectivity by harmonizing policies and regulations, deepening cooperation on cross-border payment, and keeping industrial and supply chains stable and unimpeded. We should also enhance people-to-people connectivity by facilitating travel for business, tourism and other purposes, and promoting cultural exchanges for better mutual understanding and closer ties among our peoples.

units.zh: 第三，打造创新支柱。数字经济和人工智能是创新增长的引擎。要加强数字基础设施建设，完善区域数据治理和协同合作，实现高效、便捷、安全的跨境数据流动。打造开放创新生态，促进人工智能广泛应用，推动产业转型升级、向新发展。
units.en: Third, we should foster the pillar of innovation. The digital economy and artificial intelligence (AI) are the engines of innovation-driven growth. We should strengthen digital infrastructure development, improve data governance and collaboration in the region, and achieve efficient, convenient and secure cross-border data flow. We should build an open ecosystem for innovation, encourage the broad application of AI, and promote the innovation-driven transformation and upgrading of industries.

units.zh: 第四，夯实发展支柱。面对层出不穷的全球性挑战，要加强能力建设，推动区域能源和粮食安全合作，深化跨境腐败治理。推动资源、环境、人口协调发展，加大自然资源合理利用和保护，拓展绿色低碳合作，实现经济可持续增长。支持改善民生和投资于人，实施健康老龄化行动，促进就业和职业技能开发，支持妇女经济赋权和青年人才交流，释放亚太人才活力。
units.en: Fourth, we should enhance the pillar of development. To respond to constantly emerging global challenges, we should strengthen capacity building, promote regional cooperation on energy and food security, and deepen anti-corruption governance across borders. We should coordinate the development of resources, the environment and population, scale up the rational utilization and protection of natural resources, and expand green and low-carbon cooperation to achieve sustainable economic growth. We should support livelihood improvements and invest in the people, launch healthy aging programs, facilitate employment and the development of vocational skills, and support women’s economic empowerment and young talent exchanges to tap into the full potential of talent across the Asia-Pacific.

units.zh: 亚太是中国安身立命之所。中方将始终如一支持亚太合作。我宣布，中方将提供2000万美元，资助开展亚太经合组织务实合作。中方将在深圳设立亚太共同体研究中心，开展政策研究和交流，提供智力支撑。中方将立足亚太合作，在数字技术、数据跨境流动、清洁能源、中小企业发展等领域设立合作机构，助力亚太创新、绿色增长。
units.en: China is rooted in the Asia-Pacific and will continue to support Asia-Pacific cooperation. I hereby announce that China will provide US$20 million to support APEC’s practical cooperation. We will establish a Center for Asia-Pacific Community Studies in Shenzhen to conduct policy research and exchanges and provide intellectual support. In line with the needs of Asia-Pacific cooperation, we will set up cooperation institutions in such areas as digital technology, cross-border data flow, clean energy, and the development of SMEs, to contribute to innovation-driven and green growth in the Asia-Pacific.

units.zh: 各位同事！
units.en: Dear Colleagues,

units.zh: 深圳又名“鹏城”。期待在我们共同努力下，亚太合作像大鹏一样展翅高飞、鹏程万里。
units.en: Shenzhen is known as the City of the Roc (named after a legendary bird of great size and strength). I hope that with our joint efforts, Asia-Pacific cooperation will spread its wings like the roc, and fly high and far to a bright future.

units.zh: 谢谢大家。
units.en: Thank you.

files.name: 20261119 中俄美元首和平宣言 中英对照

units.zh: 中俄美元首和平宣言
units.en: China-Russia-U.S. Heads of State Declaration toward Peace

units.zh: 中国国家主席习近平、俄罗斯总统普京、美国总统特朗普于2026年11月19日在深圳举行会晤。俄美领导人感谢中方主办此次历史性会晤。三国元首就当前国际形势深入交换了意见，致力于维护战略稳定和国际安全。
units.en: Xi Jinping, President of the People's Republic of China, Vladimir Putin, President of the Russian Federation, and Donald J. Trump, President of the United States of America, met in Shenzhen on November 19, 2026. The Russian and U.S. heads of state expressed appreciation to China for hosting this historic trilateral Summit. The three heads of state had an in-depth exchange of views on the current international situation and committed to maintaining strategic stability and international security.

units.zh: 中国、俄罗斯、美国作为联合国安理会常任理事国，致力于推动联合国改革，使之更有效应对全球性挑战，并履行其维护国际和平与安全的基本使命。
units.en: 1. As permanent members of the United Nations Security Council, China, Russia, and the United States committed to reform the U.N. so that the U.N. can respond more effectively to global challenges and conform to its fundamental mission of international peace and security.

units.zh: 三国计划增加精炼石油产品的生产和供应，以造福世界各国。三国重申能源稳定流动的重要性。
units.en: 2. The three countries plan to increase the production and supply of refined petroleum products for the benefit of all nations. They reaffirmed the importance of stable energy flows.

units.zh: 三国元首认可国家同意原则和尊重国家官员享有豁免至关重要，一致认为国际刑事法院以及其他类似机构不得滥用管辖权。
units.en: 3. The three heads of state recognized that the principle of state consent and respect for immunities of State officials are of paramount importance, and concurred that the International Criminal Court and other similar bodies must not abuse their jurisdiction.

units.zh: 三国元首重申核战争打不赢也打不得。三国将就减少核风险、防止核扩散进行对话。
units.en: 4. The three heads of state reaffirmed that a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought. The three countries will conduct a dialogue on reducing nuclear risks and preventing the proliferation of nuclear weapons.

files.name: 20261119 亚太经合组织互联互通蓝图 中英对照

units.zh: 亚太经合组织互联互通蓝图
units.en: APEC Connectivity Blueprint

units.zh: 我们强调，互联互通促进本地区商品、服务、资金和人员流动，有助于密切经济联系、推动长期经济增长；我们以《2040年亚太经合组织布特拉加亚愿景》为指引，朝着建设开放、活力、强韧、和平的亚太共同体迈进，实现亚太人民和子孙后代的共同繁荣。
units.en: We underscore that connectivity facilitates the flow of goods, services, capital, and people across the region. It helps to foster closer economic ties and enable long-term economic growth, towards building an open, dynamic, resilient and peaceful Asia-Pacific community, for the prosperity of all our people and future generations, guided by the APEC Putrajaya Vision 2040.

units.zh: 我们肯定《亚太经合组织互联互通蓝图（2015－2025）》十年来为推进互联互通合作发挥的作用。新兴趋势和不断演变的需求正在重塑本地区互联互通格局。我们鼓励各经济体继续努力，朝着实现无缝、全面联通和融合亚太的远景目标迈进。
units.en: We recognize the role of the APEC Connectivity Blueprint (2015-2025) in support of cooperation to advance connectivity over the past decade. As emerging trends and evolving demands reshape the region’s connectivity landscape, we encourage economies to continue efforts towards aspirational goal of achieving a seamlessly and comprehensively connected and integrated Asia-Pacific region.

units.zh: 支柱一：硬联通
units.en: Pillar 1: Physical

units.zh: 目标：鼓励各经济体通过创新和应用现代技术建设、维护并升级高质量基础设施，提升硬联通水平。
units.en: Objective: enhance physical connectivity by encouraging economies to develop, maintain and upgrade quality infrastructure, including through innovation and adoption of modern technologies.

units.zh: 加强陆上、海上、航空互联互通，通过交通联接提升区域互联互通水平。
units.en: Strengthen land, maritime, and air connectivity with transport links to enhance regional connectivity.

units.zh: 推动交通运输领域创新与数字化转型，探索安全可靠的自动驾驶、无人技术等新兴出行解决方案，开展自愿知识交流，分享相关经验和良好实践，以提升对新兴技术的适应能力。
units.en: Advance innovation and digital transformation in the transport sector, and explore safe and secure autonomous and unmanned technologies and emerging mobility solutions, including through voluntary knowledge exchange, and sharing of relevant experiences and best practices to strengthen readiness for emerging technologies.

units.zh: 推动海运、航空和多式联运安全高效运行，便利人员和货物流动。
units.en: Promote safe and efficient operation of maritime, air and intermodal connectivity to facilitate the movement of people and goods.

units.zh: 在可行且互利的前提下，推进能源基础设施互联互通，促进能源运输与贸易，增强关键能源基础设施和供应链的可靠性、安全性和韧性，维护能源安全，推动高质量能源普遍可及，同时促进技术创新。
units.en: Support energy infrastructure interconnectivity where feasible and beneficial, facilitate energy transmission and trade, enhance the reliability, security and resilience of critical energy infrastructure and supply chains, to promote energy security and universal access to high-quality energy, while enabling technological innovation.

units.zh: 鼓励建设可靠、可扩展、可信赖、安全且有韧性的通信基础设施；向农村及偏远地区拓展可接入网络，提升全民数字服务可及性；鼓励合作，为包括低地球轨道卫星在内的下一代互联互通技术和服务营造有利环境；升级数字基础设施，以更高能效和资源利用效率满足不断增长的需求；推动现有基础设施数字化，提高运营效率与服务供给能力。
units.en: Encourage the development of reliable, scalable, trusted, secure and resilient communication infrastructure; extend accessible networks to rural and remote areas, and improve access to digital services for all; encourage cooperation to support an enabling environment for next-generation connectivity technologies and services including low-earth orbit satellites; upgrade digital infrastructure to meet growing demands with higher energy and resource efficiency; promote digitalization of existing infrastructure to enhance operational efficiency and service delivery.

units.zh: 构建全生态协同模式，调动公共部门、私营部门和多边开发银行资源，识别并弥合基础设施融资缺口。
units.en: Identify and address infrastructure financing gaps through developing a whole-of-ecosystem approach that mobilizes resources from the public sector, the private sector, and multilateral development banks (MDBs).

units.zh: 提升基础设施项目的规划和实施水平，纳入韧性措施、减灾事前投资和全周期成本考量。
units.en: Enhance planning and implementing infrastructure projects, incorporating resilience measures, ex-ante investment in disaster risk reduction, and lifecycle cost considerations.

units.zh: 支柱二：软联通
units.en: Pillar 2: Institutional

units.zh: 目标：鼓励各经济体减少制度性壁垒，促进贸易和投资，推动建立更加紧密的区域经济。
units.en: Objective: encourage economies to reduce institutional barriers, in advancement of trade and investment, and contributing to a more connected regional economy.

units.zh: 通过技术与创新、边境机构合作、适当的查验、自动化风险管理以及简化通关手续，推动海关程序现代化。
units.en: Modernize customs procedures through technology and innovation, border agency cooperation, appropriate inspection, automated risk management, and streamlined clearance procedures.

units.zh: 开展结构性改革，激发增长活力，降低不必要监管负担，营造有利且有竞争力的营商环境，继续推进《亚太经合组织强化和提升结构性改革议程（2026－2030）》和《亚太经合组织改善营商环境行动计划（第四期）》。
units.en: Undertake structural reforms to stimulate growth, reduce unnecessary regulatory burdens, foster an enabling and competitive business environment, and continue to advance the Strengthened and Enhanced APEC Agenda for Structural Reform (SEAASR) 2026-2030 and APEC’s Fourth Ease of Doing Business (EoDB) Action Plan.

units.zh: 鼓励在共同关心的领域深化技术标准交流与合作，肯定良好监管实践对提升透明度、可预见性和效率的价值。
units.en: Encourage deepened exchange and cooperation on technical standards in sectors of mutual interest, and recognize the value of implementing good regulatory practices to foster transparency, predictability and efficiency in the regulatory environment.

units.zh: 取消贸易投资领域“边境后”壁垒，简化相关程序，提升效率、营商便利度、生产率和竞争力。
units.en: Address behind-the-border barriers to trade and investment, streamline related procedures to enhance efficiency, ease of doing business, productivity, and competitiveness.

units.zh: 提升供应链互联互通水平，通过破解供应链堵点、增强韧性、提升运行效率、最大限度减少中断、强化价值链，包括依托《亚太经合组织供应链互联互通框架行动计划》等相关机制开展合作。
units.en: Improve supply chain connectivity by addressing chokepoints, enhancing resilience, boosting operational efficiency, minimizing disruptions, and strengthening value chains, including through leveraging relevant APEC works, such as the APEC Supply Chain Connectivity Framework Action Plan (SCFAP).

units.zh: 发挥数字及其他新兴技术作用，促进贸易数字化。
units.en: Promote trade digitalization by harnessing digital and other emerging technologies.

units.zh: 强化数据对经济增长和数字创新的支撑作用，鼓励采取措施促进数据流动，包括通过亚太经合组织跨境隐私规则体系，增进企业和消费者对数字交易的信任，同时确保数据保护、尊重隐私和知识产权。
units.en: Strengthen the enabling role of data for economic growth and digital innovation, encourage efforts to promote  flow of data, including via the APEC Cross-Border Privacy Rules (CBPR) System, while strengthening business and consumer trust in digital transactions, and ensuring respect for data protection, privacy and intellectual property rights.

units.zh: 提升金融互联互通，促进区域资本流动，包括推动资本市场发展、基础设施融资和防范灾害风险融资。
units.en: Enhance financial connectivity to support the flow of capital across the region, including by promoting capital market development, infrastructure financing and disaster risk finance.

units.zh: 支柱三：心联通
units.en: Pillar 3: People-to-people

units.zh: 目标：通过促进商务人员流动，以及教育、旅游、人力资源开发和创新合作，加强惠及所有人的互联互通。
units.en: Objective: facilitate connectivity that benefits all through business mobility, education, tourism, human resource development, and innovation cooperation.

units.zh: 促进商务人员流动，用好亚太经合组织商务旅行卡，鼓励商旅卡计划正式成员经济体接纳和使用亚太经合组织虚拟商务旅行卡。
units.en: Facilitate business mobility, including through APEC Business Travel Card (ABTC) and encourage fully participating economies’ uptake and acceptance of the virtual ABTC.

units.zh: 肯定应对非正常移民流动的重要性。
units.en: Recognize the importance of addressing irregular migration flows.

units.zh: 加强教育、职业培训、技能提升等领域交流，探索科研人员流动，支持终身学习。
units.en: Strengthen education, vocational training, skills development exchanges, explore academic mobility and support lifelong learning.

units.zh: 支持社会各界参与数字经济合作，提升数字素养，让数字转型成果惠及全民，包括开展能力建设，出台提升数字素养与数字能力的政策，为劳动者全职业生涯提供技能提升和再培训机会。
units.en: Support participation in the digital economy, enhance digital literacy and make the benefits of digital transformation accessible to all, including through capacity building, policies that build digital literacy and competencies, and opportunities for upskilling and reskilling throughout working life.

units.zh: 赋能中小微企业，助力其参与价值链，包括营造有利营商环境，提升其创新能力、发展能力与专业水平，取消繁琐和不必要的监管，推动非正规中小微企业向正规和全球经济转型。
units.en: Empower MSMEs and facilitate their participation in value chains, by fostering an enabling business environment, elevating their innovation, capabilities, and expertise, eliminating burdensome and unnecessary regulations, as well as promoting informal MSME’s transition from the informal to the formal and global economies.

units.zh: 调动劳动力市场各方力量，扶持创业，创造更多经济机遇，促进高质量充分和生产性就业，加强终身学习，拓宽技能提升和再培训机会，保护工人权利，在不断变化的劳动世界中继续提升国际劳工标准。
units.en: Engage all segments of the labor market, support entrepreneurship, create more economic opportunities, promote access to high-quality,  full and productive employment, strengthen lifelong learning and access to upskilling and reskilling opportunities, protect the rights of workers and continue our efforts to promote international labor standards in the changing world of work.

units.zh: 通过建设有韧性的就业和教育体系，强化劳动力需求与技能预测研判，塑造现代化人力资源开发，通过提升医疗服务可及性等扩大劳动力市场参与度，帮助劳动者应对人口结构变化。
units.en: Prepare the workforce for demographic changes by building resilient employment and education systems, strengthening work-force demand and skills forecasting, modernizing human resources development, and expanding labour market participation including by expanding access to healthcare.

units.zh: 促进文化交流与旅游便利化，利用数字技术提升旅游业效率、能力与生产力。
units.en: Promote cultural exchanges and tourism facilitation, leverage digital technologies to enhance the efficiency, capacity, and productivity of the tourism sector.

units.zh: 构建有竞争力的创新生态；鼓励根据双方同意的条件，自愿开展知识共享，增强地区创新能力与竞争力。
units.en: Foster a competitive innovation ecosystem; and encourage the voluntary sharing of knowledge on mutually agreed terms to boost the region’s innovation capacity and competitiveness.

units.zh: 实施
units.en: Implementation

units.zh: 鼓励各经济体根据各自情况通过亚太经合组织现有工作机制，进一步推进区域互联互通。也鼓励同相关利益攸关方开展跨机制协作。
units.en: Economies are encouraged to further advance connectivity in the region through existing APEC efforts and mechanisms, where appropriate. Cross-fora collaboration with relevant stakeholders is also encouraged.

units.zh: 2027至2030年，高官将在每年某一次高官会上讨论本蓝图落实情况，旨在更加深入地讨论这一事项。请亚太经合组织秘书处在高官会上通报相关机制及下设机制采取的行动和举措，并鼓励各经济体报告进展。
units.en: Senior Officials will discuss the implementation of this Blueprint during one of the Senior Officials’ Meetings once a year from 2027 to 2030, with a view to further discussing this issue as decided by Senior Officials. The APEC Secretariat is requested to provide updates on the actions and initiatives taken by relevant APEC fora and sub-fora, and economies are encouraged to report their progress during the Senior Officials’ Meetings.

files.name: 20261119 2026年亚太经合组织领导人深圳展望 中英对照

units.zh: 2026年亚太经合组织领导人深圳展望 建设亚太共同体，促进共同繁荣
units.en: 2026 APEC Leaders’ Shenzhen Outlook Building an Asia-Pacific Community to Prosper Together

units.zh: 我们，亚太经合组织领导人，于2026年11月18日至19日在中国深圳举行会议。亚太经合组织成立数十年来，在我们持续努力下，本地区已成为全球增长的重要引擎和区域经济合作的典范。今年以来，我们围绕“建设亚太共同体，促进共同繁荣”主题，聚焦中国设定的2026年亚太经合组织三大优先领域“开放、创新、合作”，以《2040年亚太经合组织布特拉加亚愿景》为指引，持续推进工作，朝着建成开放、活力、强韧、和平的亚太共同体这一共同目标不断迈进。
units.en: We, the Economic Leaders of APEC, gathered in Shenzhen, China, on November 18 to 19, 2026. Decades after APEC’s establishment, our sustained efforts have helped make our region a key engine of global growth and a champion of regional economic cooperation. Under the theme “Building an Asia-Pacific Community to Prosper Together”, we have built on our work throughout the year with China’s APEC 2026 priorities “Openness, Innovation, Cooperation”, and advanced our shared objectives toward realizing an open, dynamic, resilient, and peaceful Asia-Pacific community, guided by the Putrajaya Vision 2040.

units.zh: 当今世界快速变革，新兴机遇与复杂挑战并存。技术突破为促进本地区经济增长、韧性和活力作出贡献。我们致力于携手努力，维护宏观经济稳定，提升生产力和活力，促进经济增长，造福全体人民。
units.en: The world today is changing rapidly, with new opportunities emerging alongside complex challenges. Technological breakthroughs are contributing to the economic growth, resilience, and dynamism of our region. We endeavor to work together to maintain macroeconomic stability, promote productivity and dynamism, and boost economic growth for the benefit of all our people.

units.zh: 亚太经合组织长期以来处在区域经济合作前沿，在当前经济背景下依然发挥着重要作用。我们重申，亚太经合组织是区域经济合作的首要平台，我们将遵循自主自愿、非约束性和协商一致的合作原则，致力于将亚太经合组织打造成一个更加现代、高效、务实的理念孵化器。
units.en: APEC has long been at the forefront of regional economic cooperation, and its enduring role remains relevant in the current economic context. We reaffirm our commitment to APEC as the premier forum for regional economic cooperation, guided by its voluntary, non-binding and consensus-building principles, and to making APEC a more modern, efficient, and effective incubator of ideas.

units.zh: 经贸和投资
units.en: Trade and Investment

units.zh: 我们强调，支持改善贸易和投资环境的努力对本地区具有重要意义。我们重申致力于加强供应链韧性、深化区域经济合作，建设稳健且有韧性的经济，为本地区实现持续的经济增长与繁荣作出贡献。
units.en: We underscore that supporting efforts to improve the trade and investment environment is important to our region. We reaffirm our commitments to strengthening supply chain resilience and deepening regional economic cooperation to build robust and resilient economies, contributing to sustained economic growth and prosperity of our region.

units.zh: 我们将继续以市场驱动的方式，包括通过落实亚太自由贸易区相关议程，推进亚太区域经济一体化。我们认识到，亚太自由贸易区议程在提升各经济体参与高标准、综合性区域自贸安排的能力方面发挥着重要作用。
units.en: We will continue advancing economic integration in the Asia-Pacific region in a manner that is market-driven, including through the work on the Free Trade Area of the Asia-Pacific (FTAAP) agenda. We recognize that the FTAAP agenda plays an important role in building economies’ capacity to participate in high standard and comprehensive regional undertakings.

units.zh: 我们认识到数字化对驱动本地区创新、促进生产力和经济增长的重要作用，及其对促进贸易的积极作用。在此背景下，我们欢迎《亚太经合组织贸易数字化合作框架（2027－2030）》，以此指导各方努力营造有利的政策环境、加强政策交流，并推动将数字技术应用在贸易数字化进程之中。我们将继续促进贸易便利化，包括通过实施无纸化贸易和跨境电子商务等措施。我们也致力于发挥新兴技术对贸易的促进作用。
units.en: We recognize the important role of digitalization as a driver for innovation, productivity, and economic growth across the region, and its benefit to facilitating trade. In this context, we welcome the APEC Trade Digitalization Cooperation Framework (2027-2030) to guide our efforts to foster a supportive policy environment, strengthen policy exchange and promote use of digital technologies for trade digitalization. We will continue to facilitate trade, including through measures to advance paperless trade and cross-border e-commerce. We are also committed to harnessing the benefits of emerging technologies for trade.

units.zh: 我们认识到服务业对促进经济增长和创造就业的贡献，以及数字服务日益扩大的作用，将继续提升亚太经合组织各经济体在服务业领域的竞争力。我们注意到环境及相关挑战带来的影响，鼓励亚太经合组织各经济体思考如何通过能力建设和经验交流，助力实现各自的环境与贸易目标。我们也认可亚太经合组织过去和当前在推动有韧性的商业模式合作方面所做的工作。我们肯定文化创意产业对经济增长的积极贡献，并重申强有力的知识产权保护的重要性。我们致力于加强知识产权保护和执法，并持续努力解决创新者、创作者及其他知识产权持有者所面临的挑战。
units.en: Recognizing the contribution of the services sector to economic growth and job creation, and the expanding role of digitally-delivered services, we will continue to enhance the competitiveness of the APEC economies in the sector. We note the impacts of environmental and related challenges and encourage APEC economies to consider how capacity building and exchanges of experience can help meet their respective environmental and trade objectives. We also recognize APEC’s past and ongoing work to foster cooperation in advancing resilient business models. We acknowledge the positive contribution of the cultural and creative industries (CCIs) to economic growth, and affirm the importance of robust intellectual property protections. We are committed to enhancing the protection and enforcement of intellectual property rights, as well as continued efforts to address challenges faced by innovators, creators, and other right holders.

units.zh: 联通
units.en: Connectivity

units.zh: 我们重申，互联互通一直是经济增长的渠道，促进了商品、服务、资本和人员的流动，交通网络的安全与韧性为其提供了支持。我们赞赏亚太经合组织过去十年为推进区域互联互通所作的努力。在现有进展基础上，我们核可《亚太经合组织互联互通蓝图》，鼓励各经济体继续努力，通过进一步夯实“硬联通”、“软联通”、“心联通”三大支柱，实现无缝、全面联通和融合亚太。我们将继续加强互联互通，为所有人带来实实在在的利益。我们将加强合作，促进高质量基础设施开发和投资。我们也强调投资的重要性，包括通过事前投资来减少灾害风险。
units.en: We affirm that connectivity has served as a conduit for economic growth, facilitating the flow of goods, services, capital, and people, including as supported by safe and resilient transport links. We appreciate the efforts made by APEC to advance regional connectivity over the past decade. Building on this progress, we endorse the APEC Connectivity Blueprint, through which we encourage economies to continue efforts towards achieving a seamlessly and comprehensively connected and integrated Asia-Pacific, by further strengthening the three pillars: physical, institutional, and people-to-people. We will continue to advance connectivity to deliver tangible benefits for all. We will enhance cooperation on quality infrastructure development and investment. We also underscore the importance of investment, including through ex-ante investment in disaster risk reduction.

units.zh: 面对影响我们地区的供应链挑战，我们重申致力于维护供应链韧性，特别是必需品的供应链。我们认识到，保持本区域互联互通、贸易走廊开放，以促进包括能源供应和其他必需品的贸易流动，符合我们的共同利益。我们决心与其他贸易伙伴共同努力，确保贸易持续流动，确保关键基础设施继续支撑全球供应链的运转和完整。我们支持增强供应链韧性、解决瓶颈问题、利用亚太经合组织现有平台促进供应链互联互通和贸易便利化。我们欢迎对《供应链互联互通框架行动计划（第三期）》（2022－2026）的终期审议。我们也认识到，政策透明至关重要，否则可能影响贸易或扰乱供应链。
units.en: In the face of supply chain challenges impacting our region, we reaffirm our commitment to maintaining resilient supply chains, particularly for essential goods. We recognize that it is in our mutual interest that our region remains interconnected and trade corridors remain open to facilitate trade flows, including energy supplies and other essential goods. We affirm our resolve to work together and with other trade partners to ensure trade continues to flow and critical infrastructure continues to support the viability and integrity of supply chains globally. We support efforts to enhance supply chain resilience, address chokepoints, and leverage existing platforms in APEC to advance supply chain connectivity and trade facilitation. We welcome the final review of Phase Three of the Supply Chain Connectivity Framework Action Plan (SCFAP III) (2022-2026). We also recognize the importance of transparency of measures that may affect trade or disrupt supply chains.

units.zh: 我们将继续加强交通领域的合作以推动创新，增强信息通信技术韧性。我们将继续推广良好监管实践，在标准和评定程序方面努力加强合作，并推进结构性改革以改善营商环境。我们也将就贸易数字化、供应链、贸易便利化开展务实经验交流，提升海关数字化水平，完善其他与贸易相关的流程。我们鼓励通过亚太经合组织商务旅行卡促进商务人员流动，欢迎各经济体推动旅游便利化、加强教育和技能培训、促进文化交流。
units.en: We will continue cooperation to advance innovation and foster ICT resilience in the transport sector. We will continue to promote good regulatory practices, strengthen cooperation on standards and conformity assessment procedures, pursue structural reform to improve the business environment. We will also foster practical exchange of experience on trade digitalization, supply chains, trade facilitation, advance digitalization of customs and trade-related procedures. We encourage business mobility through the APEC Business Travel Card, and welcome economies’ efforts to advance tourism facilitation, strengthen education, skills development and cultural exchanges.

units.zh: 创新
units.en: Innovation

units.zh: 我们认识到，技术和创新正在深刻重塑亚太经济体，并驱动地区经济迅速增长。我们将推进技术进步，推动创新驱动增长，着力提高生产力，改善生活质量，拓展繁荣机遇，造福所有人民。为此，我们支持科技与创新合作，培育具有竞争力、韧性且安全的创新生态系统。我们鼓励就良好实践进行自愿交流，为本土创新生态系统发展提供支持。
units.en: We recognize that technology and innovation are profoundly reshaping our economies and rapidly driving economic growth in the Asia-Pacific region. We will leverage technological advancement to pursue innovation-driven and productivity-led growth, improve quality of life, and promote prosperity and opportunity for all our peoples. To this end, we support science, technology, and innovation cooperation to foster a competitive, resilient and secure innovation ecosystem. We encourage the voluntary exchange of good practices to support the growth of local innovation ecosystems.

units.zh: 我们重申致力于发展数字经济，让所有人民共享数字转型红利。我们鼓励各经济体推进数字互联互通，弥合社会各阶层以及城乡区域间的数字鸿沟，加强可及、有韧性的数字基础设施建设，推动数字转型，促进经济增长，提升数字素养与技能，推进数字平台建设。我们鼓励各经济体积极应对相关潜在风险，包括数据泄露、网络诈骗以及蓄意滥用人工智能和其他新兴技术从事恶意活动等，以加强和改善数字环境。我们认识到尊重知识产权对数字和新兴技术发展的重要性。我们认识到数据在推动数字转型中的关键作用。我们将继续加强在跨境数据流动、数字交易安全性以及数据保护和隐私等方面的合作。
units.en: We reaffirm our commitment to growing the digital economy and sharing the benefits of digital transformation with all our peoples. We encourage economies to advance digital connectivity and bridge digital divides across all segments of society and across regions between urban and rural areas, strengthen accessible and resilient digital infrastructure, promote digital transformation for economic growth, enhance digital literacy and skills, and promote the development of digital platforms. We encourage economies to address potential risks such as data breaches, online scams and deliberate misuse of digital and emerging technologies for malicious purposes, to strengthen and enhance the digital environment. We recognize the importance of respecting intellectual property rights in the development of digital and emerging technologies. We recognize the vital role of data in powering digital transformation. We will continue our cooperation on facilitating the flow of data across borders, strengthening business and consumer trust in digital transactions, and ensuring data protection and privacy.

units.zh: 我们强调，数字和新兴技术为整个亚太地区带来了变革性机遇，有助于提升生产力、效率、竞争力和韧性，促进经济增长。我们赞赏亚太经合组织为推进数字和新兴技术相关讨论所作的努力，包括《亚太经合组织人工智能倡议（2026－2030）》，并通过《亚太经合组织关于亚太地区新兴技术促进就业和繁荣的声明》，以继续推进这一重要工作。我们支持以人民为中心的创新，支持采取负责任的方式，促进数字和新兴技术在各经济领域应用，造福全体人民。我们支持推动关键领域的数字和新兴技术转型，利用数字和新兴技术改善公共服务，包括加强医疗卫生体系建设，为企业营造有利的发展环境，推广以市场为导向、以创新为驱动的做法，并为中小微企业提供可及的数字工具以赋能其发展。我们将继续投资数字和新兴技术相关基础设施，推进数据利用，激发创新活力。
units.en: We underscore that digital and emerging technologies present transformative opportunities to boost productivity, efficiency, competitiveness, resilience, and economic growth across the Asia-Pacific. We commend APEC’s efforts to advance discussions on digital and emerging technologies including the APEC AI Initiative (2026-2030), and endorse APEC Statement on Harnessing Digital and Emerging Technologies for Employment and Prosperity in the Asia-Pacific Region to continue this important work. We will support human-centric innovation, responsible approaches, and the adoption of digital and emerging technologies across all sectors of the economy for the benefit of all our peoples. We support driving digital and emerging technologies transformation across key sectors, harnessing digital and emerging technologies to improve public service delivery, including strengthening healthcare systems, fostering an enabling environment for businesses, promoting market-oriented and innovation-driven approaches, and empowering micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) with accessible digital tools. We will continue to invest in infrastructure related to digital and emerging technologies and advance data utilization to fuel innovation.

units.zh: 经济增长
units.en: Economic Growth

units.zh: 我们认识到全民经济赋权是促进生产力和创新、强化经济参与度的重要途径。我们强调，应该帮助劳动者为未来工作做好准备，以把握技术进步带来的益处，并根据《亚太经合组织应对人口结构变化框架合作文件》应对人口结构变化。我们重申致力于提升人力资源开发现代化水平，促进高质量、充分、生产性和体面的就业，促进终身学习、职业培训、技能提升和再培训，保护劳动者权利，在不断变化的工作环境中继续努力提升相关国际劳工标准，以及酌情优化社会保障体系。
units.en: We recognize that the economic empowerment of all is an important way to boost productivity and innovation and strengthen participation in the economy. We emphasize the importance of preparing our workforce for the future of work to capture the benefits of technological advancement and respond to demographic changes in line with the APEC Collaborative Framework for Demographic Changes. We reaffirm our commitment to modernizing human resources development through promoting high-quality, full, productive and decent employment, lifelong learning, vocational training, reskilling and upskilling, protecting the rights of workers and continuing efforts to promote international labour standards in the changing world of work, and optimizing social security systems as appropriate.

units.zh: 我们强调可信且灵活的财政、货币和金融政策框架对于应对冲击、维护宏观经济和金融稳定的重要性。我们也注意到，全球失衡问题持续存在，给增长与稳定带来了风险。我们认识到，全球再平衡符合我们的共同利益，并同意就此加强沟通与合作。我们鼓励应用财政政策支持家庭，促进全民金融可及性、拓展金融机会、提升金融素养，认识到金融知识对财务健康和人民福祉至关重要。
units.en: We emphasize the importance of credible and flexible fiscal, monetary and financial policy frameworks to manage shocks, maintain macroeconomic and financial stability. We note that global imbalances have persisted, creating risks to growth and stability. We recognize that global rebalancing is in our common interest and agree to strengthen communication and cooperation in this regard. We encourage fiscal policies to support households and promote financial access, opportunity and literacy for all, recognizing that financial literacy is important to financial health and well-being.

units.zh: 我们寻求加强跨能源部门和跨技术的综合安全，共同应对能源安全挑战，确保不间断、可依赖、可负担和可持续地获取能源，以支撑经济繁荣。我们鼓励围绕供应链韧性、基础设施互联互通、风险评估加强能源安全协作。我们认识到及时修复发电厂、电网、海底电力电缆和管道等关键能源基础设施的重要性，并鼓励各经济体围绕市场机制、应急准备和响应、战略储备管理进行经验交流。我们认识到，安全且不间断的能源流动至关重要，应在互利的基础上开展涵盖整个供应链的合作，包括生产者与消费者之间的合作，同时促进区域内能源合作。我们将推广安全、可靠、充足、有韧性和可负担的高质量能源，在包括偏远地区和农村在内的所有地区普遍可及。我们鼓励深化自愿合作，推动数字和新兴技术与能源之间相互促进，支持为数字和新兴技术发展提供可靠、有韧性且可负担的能源，同时利用数字和新兴技术完善能源系统，惠及全民。我们认识到，传统能源以及零排放、低排放能源和技术为能源安全以及强劲和可持续的经济增长提供了基础，各经济体将根据自身优先事项选择能源系统组合。
units.en: We seek to strengthen comprehensive security across all energy sectors and technologies and jointly address energy security challenges, ensuring uninterrupted, reliable, and affordable access to energy to enable economic prosperity. We encourage strengthened energy security through cooperation on supply chain resilience, secure cross-border infrastructure interconnection, and risk assessment. We recognize the benefits of timely restoration of critical energy infrastructure such as power plants, electric grids, submarine power cables and pipelines, and encourage sharing of economies’ experiences on market mechanisms, emergency preparedness and response, and strategic reserve management. We recognize the importance of secure and uninterrupted energy flows and cooperation across the whole supply chain including between producers and consumers in a mutually beneficial manner as well as fostering energy cooperation in the region. We will promote universal access to high-quality energy that is secure, reliable, abundant, resilient, and affordable, including for remote and rural areas. We encourage deepening voluntary cooperation on mutual enhancement between digital and emerging technologies and energy by supporting reliable, resilient and affordable energy for digital and emerging technologies development while harnessing digital and emerging technologies to enhance energy systems that deliver benefits for all. We recognize that conventional and zero and low emission energy sources and technologies provide a foundation for energy security, and strong and sustainable economic growth, and that each economy will choose an energy system mix consistent with its domestic priorities.

units.zh: 我们将努力促进开放、公平、透明、高产出、有韧性和创新的农业粮食体系，以惠及全民。我们将加强粮食安全政策伙伴关系，提高农业生产力和效率，通过创新和数字化增强区域粮食体系韧性，促进农业粮食体系转型，促进食品安全，改善全民营养，防止和减少粮食损失与浪费。我们支持基于科学和证据、由技术赋能的农业，包括用好数字和新兴技术等工具，并推进农业生物技术发展。我们重申致力于为农村地区拓展经济机遇。
units.en: We will work towards promoting open, fair, transparent, productive, resilient, and innovative agri-food systems that benefit all. We will strengthen policy partnership on food security, boost agricultural productivity and efficiency, enhance the resilience of regional food systems and supply chains, including through innovation and digitalization, promote the transformation of agri-food systems, advance food safety and nutrition for all, and prevent and reduce food loss and waste. We support science- and evidence-based, technology-enabled agriculture, including utilizing tools such as digital and emerging technologies and the advancement in agricultural biotechnology. We reaffirm our commitment to strengthening economic opportunities in rural areas.

units.zh: 我们认识到，森林为经济增长、生物多样性保护以及亚太地区的社区韧性和繁荣提供多重价值和贡献。我们支持合作打击非法采伐及相关贸易，促进合法采伐的林产品、可持续森林管理，制止并扭转森林丧失与退化。我们还将协作提升海洋和沿海社区的韧性，促进海洋资源的保护和管理，包括通过基于科学和技术的方式，打击非法、不报告和不受管制的捕捞，应对日益严峻的海洋垃圾挑战。
units.en: We recognize the multiple values and contributions that forests provide for economic growth, biodiversity conservation, and the resilience and prosperity of communities across the Asia-Pacific region. We support cooperation on combating illegal logging and associated trade while promoting legally harvested forest products, sustainable forest management, and halting and reversing forest loss and degradation. We will also collaborate to improve the resilience of marine and coastal communities and promote the conservation and management of ocean resources, including by combating illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing and addressing the growing challenge of marine debris, while leveraging science- and technology-based approaches.

units.zh: 我们致力于打造有利的营商环境，支持中小微企业和初创企业抓住机遇，增强竞争力和创新性，实现增长。我们将支持中小微企业更好地获得资本、资产、技能培训和数字工具，支持中小微企业参与区域和全球价值链，并鼓励各经济体继续为中小微企业能力建设提供支持。我们鼓励开发可及、易用且具有成本效益的产品和解决方案，帮助中小微企业提高生产力和效率、扩大市场参与、加速数字化转型，并推动经济主体从非正规经济向正规经济和全球经济转型。
units.en: We are committed to fostering an enabling business environment that supports the growth of MSMEs and startups through opportunities to become more competitive and innovative. We will promote greater access for MSMEs to capital, assets, skills training and digital tools, support MSMEs’ participation in value chains, and encourage economies to continue providing support for MSMEs capacity building. We encourage the development of accessible, easy-to-use and cost-effective products and solutions that help MSMEs boost productivity and efficiency, expand market participation, accelerate digital transformation and facilitate the transition of economic actors from the informal to the formal and global economies.

units.zh: 我们认识到腐败的破坏性影响，它威胁经济增长、侵蚀公众信任、损害贸易和公平竞争，使资源偏离关键领域，为有组织犯罪等非法行为创造条件。我们决心通过有效的反腐倡廉措施促进增长与繁荣，继续共同努力反腐，包括打击跨境腐败，不为腐败分子和通过腐败及非法资产牟利者提供避风港，并就资产追回和返还加强合作。
units.en: We recognize the detrimental impact of corruption as a threat to economic growth, eroding public trust, harming trade and fair competition, diverting resources away from vital areas, and facilitating crimes, including organized crime. We resolve to promote growth and prosperity through effective anti-corruption and integrity measures, and continue our joint efforts to fight against corruption, including cross-border corruption, deny safe haven to corruption offenders including people who benefit from corruption and illicit assets, and strengthen cooperation on asset recovery and return.

units.zh: 作为我们共同努力深化亚太地区各领域合作的一部分，我们注意到2026年举行了妇女与经济、贸易、旅游、数字与人工智能、林业、粮食安全、中小企业、能源、运输、人力资源开发、财政等专业部长会议，以及数字周系列活动等其他高级别活动。我们赞赏亚太经合组织第37届外交和贸易双部长会议的成果，包括批准《奥特奥罗亚行动计划》五年审议，这些成果将作为未来合作的重要基础。
units.en: As part of our collective endeavors to deepen regional cooperation across all fronts, we note the convening of the 2026 sectoral ministerial meetings for Women and the Economy, Trade, Tourism, Digital and AI, Forestry, Food Security, Small and Medium Enterprises, Energy, Transportation, Human Resources Development, Finance, as well as other high-level events including during the Digital Weeks. We commend the outcomes of the 37th APEC Ministerial Meeting as an important basis for future cooperation, including the adoption of the five-year review of the Aotearoa Plan of Action.

units.zh: 工商界和其他利益相关方给亚太经合组织带来创造力、活力和能量，始终是我们的重要伙伴。我们期待与包括亚太经合组织工商咨询理事会和太平洋经济合作理事会在内的广大利益相关方进一步加强交流合作。
units.en: Our business communities and other stakeholders bring creativity, dynamism, and energy to APEC and remain vital partners in our work. We look forward to further strengthening multi-stakeholder engagement, as appropriate, including with the APEC Business Advisory Council (ABAC) and Pacific Economic Cooperation Council (PECC).

units.zh: 我们衷心感谢今年东道主中华人民共和国，感谢广东省深圳市的周到安排以及市民的热情好客。我们欢迎越南（2027年）、墨西哥（2028年）、新加坡（2030年）、日本（2031年）、智利（2032年）、巴布亚新几内亚（2033年）以及秘鲁（2034年）担任未来几年亚太经合组织东道主。
units.en: We extend our sincere gratitude to the People’s Republic of China and the people and city of Shenzhen, Guangdong Province for their warm hospitality and thorough arrangements. We look forward to the upcoming APEC host years of Viet Nam (2027), Mexico (2028), Singapore (2030), Japan (2031), Chile (2032), Papua New Guinea (2033), and Peru (2034).

files.name: 20261118习近平在亚太经合组织工商领导人峰会上的主旨演讲 中英对照

units.zh: 坚定信心，勇毅前行 共创亚太光明未来 ——在亚太经合组织工商领导人峰会上的主旨演讲 （2026年11月18日，深圳） 中华人民共和国主席 习近平
units.en: Forging Ahead with Resolve Toward a Bright Future for the Asia-Pacific Keynote Speech by President Xi Jinping at the APEC CEO Summit Shenzhen, November 18, 2026

units.zh: 各位嘉宾， 女士们，先生们，朋友们：
units.en: Distinguished Guests, Ladies and Gentlemen, Dear Friends,

units.zh: 大家好！欢迎亚太工商界的朋友们！很高兴同大家在深圳见面。
units.en: Good morning! I wish to extend my welcome to you all, leaders of business communities of the Asia-Pacific. I am so delighted to meet you here in Shenzhen.

units.zh: 南海之滨，风劲潮涌。40多年来，深圳在中国改革开放春潮中勇立潮头、奋发进取，实现了从边陲小镇到国际化大都市的历史性跨越，创造了世界发展史上的一个奇迹。深圳的成功，给人们许多启示。
units.en: Shenzhen, on the shores of the South China Sea, embraces the surging winds and waves of the ocean. Over the past 40 years and more, Shenzhen has been a pioneer in China’s pursuit of reform and opening up. It has achieved a historic transformation from a small border town into an international metropolis, creating a miracle in the history of global development. There is so much people can draw from Shenzhen’s success.

units.zh: 当前，国际形势变乱交织，世界经济增长动能不足，单边主义、保护主义甚嚣尘上。与此同时，全球贸易在逆势中保持增长，新兴技术加速突破，深刻影响世界发展格局。世界怎么了？亚太怎么办？开放还是封闭，合作还是分化，变革还是守旧？都是我们必须回答的时代课题。
units.en: Today, we find ourselves in a changing and turbulent world. Global growth lacks momentum, and unilateralism and protectionism are rampant. Still, global trade keeps growing against headwinds, and breakthroughs are being made in emerging technologies at a faster pace, exerting a profound impact on global development. What is going on with the world? What should we do in the Asia-Pacific? To open doors or close doors, work together or against each other, adapt to change or stick to old ways? These are hard questions of our times that we must answer.

units.zh: 凡益之道，与时偕行。亚太经合组织伴随经济全球化浪潮而生，推动亚太地区引领时代风气之先。今年，中国第三次担任亚太经合组织东道主。中方愿同各方一道，坚定信心、勇毅前行，携手建设亚太共同体，促进亚太共同繁荣。
units.en: As an ancient Chinese saying goes, all approaches should adapt to changing times to remain relevant. Born amid the waves of economic globalization, APEC has enabled the Asia-Pacific to steer the course of our times. This year, China is hosting APEC for the third time. We are ready to work with all other parties to forge ahead with resolve, jointly build an Asia-Pacific community, and bring prosperity for all in our region.

units.zh: ——促进亚太共同繁荣，要维护和平稳定大局。稳，才能安；安，才能兴。亚太经济保持稳中向好，成为全球经济增长的重要引擎，得益于长期稳定的地区环境。越是外部形势复杂，我们越要坚定维护战后国际秩序，推进平等有序的世界多极化、普惠包容的经济全球化；越要坚持通过对话协商解决分歧，通过团结协作应对挑战，为亚太地区长治久安筑牢根基。
units.en: —To bring prosperity for all in the Asia-Pacific, we should uphold peace and stability. There can be no prosperity without security, and no security without stability. Thanks to the stable environment in our region over the past decades, the Asia-Pacific has maintained steady economic progress and become an important engine driving global growth. The more complex the external conditions become, the more important it is for us to uphold the postwar international order, and promote an equality-based and orderly multipolar world and economic globalization that is inclusive and brings benefit to all. It is even more important for us to resolve differences through dialogue and consultation, and overcome challenges through solidarity and cooperation. This is the way to cement the foundation for sustaining peace and stability in the Asia-Pacific.

units.zh: ——促进亚太共同繁荣，要搭建开放合作桥梁。历史经验证明，开放带来进步，封闭必然落后。我们要坚定维护以世界贸易组织为核心、以规则为基础的多边贸易体制，支持自由开放的贸易和投资，维护全球产业链供应链稳定畅通。稳步推进亚太自由贸易区进程，搭建全方位互联互通网络，加强贸易数字化、跨境电商、智慧海关等合作，深化产业链供应链国际合作，为亚太经济一体化建设铺路架桥。
units.en: —To bring prosperity for all in the Asia-Pacific, we should build bridges of opening up and cooperation. History tells us that opening doors brings progress while closing doors leaves one behind. We should firmly safeguard the WTO-centered, rules-based multilateral trading system, support free and open trade and investment, and keep global industrial and supply chains stable and unimpeded. We should work steadily toward a Free Trade Area of the Asia-Pacific, build a multidimensional connectivity network, enhance cooperation in areas such as digital transformation of trade, cross-border e-commerce, and smart customs, and deepen international cooperation on industrial and supply chains. All this will pave the way for greater economic integration in the Asia-Pacific.

units.zh: ——促进亚太共同繁荣，要激发创新增长动力。创新是推动社会进步的重要力量。亚太经合组织成员在全球科技创新中锐意进取，独角兽企业、人工智能大模型蓬勃涌现，一大批创新成果赋能千行百业、走进千家万户。我们要积极构建科技创新伙伴关系，深化数字经济、人工智能合作，促进绿色低碳转型，不断将创新优势转化为增长动能，为亚太经济增长提供强劲动力。
units.en: —To bring prosperity for all in the Asia-Pacific, we should boost innovation to drive growth. Innovation is crucial for progress. APEC members have driven global scientific and technological innovation: Unicorn companies and large AI models have emerged in large numbers, and many innovations have empowered hundreds of trades and industries and reached millions of households. We should forge science, technology and innovation partnerships, deepen cooperation in the digital economy and AI, and promote green and low-carbon transition. By doing so, we can turn strengths in innovation into drivers of growth, and provide strong impetus for economic growth in the Asia-Pacific.

units.zh: ——促进亚太共同繁荣，要拓展互利共赢路径。亚太各经济体历史文化和发展阶段不尽相同，推进合作不能搞整齐划一。要既消除贸易和投资壁垒，建设开放型亚太经济，又推动普惠均衡发展，兼顾效率和公平。要坚持以人民为中心的发展理念，面向发展中经济体加强经济技术合作，深化交通运输、公共卫生、能源、粮食安全、反腐败等合作，让发展成果惠及各经济体和不同的阶层及人群。
units.en: —To bring prosperity for all in the Asia-Pacific, we should expand our ways for mutual benefits and win-win outcomes. As the economies in our region differ in history, culture and stage of development, taking a uniform approach will not advance cooperation. We should remove trade and investment barriers to build an open Asia-Pacific economy. At the same time, we should promote development that is balanced and delivers benefits to all to ensure both efficiency and fairness. We should follow a people-centered development philosophy, strengthen economic and technical cooperation geared for developing economies, and deepen cooperation in transportation, public health, energy, food security, anti-corruption and other fields, so that development fruits are shared by all economies and all groups and communities.

units.zh: 亚太地区汇集了世界上最重要的湾区，湾区经济具有鲜明的开放性、协同性、外溢性。我们所在的深圳就位于粤港澳大湾区。中方支持成立世界湾区经济合作联盟，深化各湾区交流互动，探索亚太经济合作新路径。
units.en: The Asia-Pacific region is home to the world’s most important bay areas notable for their open and interconnected economies with positive spillover effects. Shenzhen, where we are now meeting, is part of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. China supports the establishment of a World Association for Bay Areas Economic Cooperation to deepen exchanges and interactions among bay areas from across the world. This will help us explore new ways for stronger economic cooperation in the Asia-Pacific.

units.zh: 各位嘉宾、各位朋友！
units.en: Distinguished Guests, Dear Friends,

units.zh: 今年是中国“十五五”开局之年。当前，中国经济保持向新向优向好发展态势，展现出强大韧性和活力。前三季度，中国经济增速达到4.6%，新质生产力加速发展，新发展格局加快构建，绿色低碳转型蹄疾步稳，“十五五”开局良好。中国“十五五”规划既是自身的发展蓝图，也为亚太乃至全球经济增长提供机遇清单，是中国面向全球工商界发出的合作邀约。
units.en: This year marks the start of China’s 15th Five-Year Plan for economic and social development. China’s economy maintains a strong momentum of high-quality, innovation-driven growth, demonstrating great resilience and vitality. In the first three quarters, the Chinese economy grew by 4.6 percent. New quality productive forces are developing more quickly, the new development pattern is being fostered at a faster pace, and green and low-carbon transition is steadily picking up speed. The 15th Five-Year Plan has gotten off to a good start. A blueprint for China’s development, the 15th Five-Year Plan also provides a list of opportunities for promoting economic growth in the Asia-Pacific and the wider world. Indeed, it is an invitation for cooperation China has sent to business communities from around the world.

units.zh: ——中国将为全球工商界提供超大规模的开放市场。中国是全球第二大消费市场，拥有全球规模最大的中等收入群体，投资和消费潜力巨大。从新能源汽车到智能家居，从银发经济到冰雪旅游，每一个新赛道都为全球企业带来新机遇。中国正在加快建设开放大市场，扩大优质产品和服务进口，将不断催生多样化新需求。几天前，第九届中国国际进口博览会在上海举办，在座很多工商界朋友都前往参加，发现了新的合作机遇。中国还将继续举办“出口中国”等系列活动，搭建各国优质商品进入中国市场的高效通道。
units.en: —China will provide global business communities with a super-sized open market. China is the world’s second largest consumer market. It has the largest middle income group in the world and enormous potential for investment and consumption. From new energy vehicles to smart homes, from the silver economy to ice and snow tourism, every new growth area is creating new opportunities for businesses across the world. As China accelerates the development of a big, open market and increases import of quality products and services, more diverse demands will be unleashed. Recently, the ninth China International Import Expo was held in Shanghai. Many of you present today attended the Expo and found new cooperation opportunities. China will also continue to host “Export to China” series and other events to open efficient channels to help quality products from across the world enter the Chinese market.

units.zh: ——中国将为全球工商界提供前景广阔的发展空间。创新驱动、绿色转型是中国经济的关键词。从机器人“进场打工”，到机器狗“下乡务农”，再到自动驾驶和无人机外卖，中国超大规模创新试验场让前沿技术在真实场景中接受检验、迭代打磨，不断转化为高质量发展活力。中国将加快构建现代化产业体系，推动科技创新和产业创新深度融合，支持传统产业转型升级、新兴产业发展壮大、未来产业前瞻布局，为全球企业技术创新和发展壮大提供强劲动能。
units.en: —China will provide global business communities with a promising land for development. Innovation-driven growth and green transition are the key words in observing China’s economy. From factory and farm robots, to autonomous driving and drone delivery, China is a super-sized innovation testing ground where frontier technologies are tested, improved and upgraded in real-world scenarios, and are then turned into high-quality growth drivers. China will step up efforts to build a modernized industrial system, and deepen integration between technological and industrial innovation. It will support the transformation and upgrading of traditional industries, the expansion of emerging industries, and the forward-looking planning of industries of the future. This will generate strong impetus for technological innovation and growth of businesses around the world.

units.zh: ——中国将为全球工商界提供互促共进的合作环境。2001年，中国首次举办亚太经合组织领导人非正式会议，同年加入世界贸易组织。25年来，中国全面履行“入世”承诺，在实现自身发展的同时同世界各国共享机遇、共促发展。面对单边主义、保护主义冲击，中国始终践行真正的多边主义，坚定维护多边贸易体制，维护世贸组织规则，推动世贸组织改革，不断为世界经济增长和国际经贸合作注入稳定性和确定性。无论国际风云如何变幻，中国同世界各国合作共赢的决心都不会改变。中方坚定不移推动共建“一带一路”高质量发展，欢迎亚太地区企业积极参与，共谋发展机遇、共享发展成果。中方将从降低关税、扩大准入，到探索规则、管理、标准等深水区改革，全面落实制造业准入又准营，稳步扩大服务业领域开放，为全球企业来华投资兴业提供更稳定、更可预期的优质环境。
units.en: —China will provide global business communities with an environment that enables mutually reinforcing cooperation. In 2001, China hosted the APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting for the first time and joined the World Trade Organization in the same year. Over the past 25 years, China has fully honored its WTO accession commitments. While pursuing its own development, China has shared opportunities with other countries and worked for common development. China has stood up to unilateralism and protectionism, and remained committed to true multilateralism, to upholding the multilateral trading system and WTO rules, and to advancing WTO reform; it has steadily brought stability and predictability to world economic growth and international trade and economic cooperation. No matter how the international landscape may evolve, China will not waver in its pursuit of win-win cooperation with all other countries. China stays firmly committed to high-quality Belt and Road cooperation, and welcomes the active participation of businesses from across the Asia-Pacific so that we can create growth opportunities and share the fruits of development together. China will not only cut tariffs and expand market access but also go a step further—we will carry out reform in challenging areas, such as rules, regulation and standards, in order to fully ensure market access and an accommodating operating environment in the manufacturing sector, to steadily expand opening up in the service sector, and to foster a more stable and more predictable first-class environment for companies from around the world to invest and do business in China.

units.zh: 各位嘉宾、各位朋友！
units.en: Distinguished Guests, Dear Friends,

units.zh: 亚太是我们共同发展的天地，也是我们并肩合作的舞台。亚太工商界是全球经济的弄潮儿。希望大家发扬勇于创新、追求卓越的企业家精神，积极拓展商业合作机遇，为推进亚太经济一体化作出更大贡献。欢迎大家继续积极参与中国改革开放和现代化建设，共享中国式现代化机遇。
units.en: The Asia-Pacific is our home; it is here we jointly pursue development and cooperation. Asia-Pacific business communities are pioneers of the global economy. I hope you will carry forward the entrepreneurial spirit, boldly pursue innovation and excellence, explore and expand opportunities for business cooperation, and make greater contributions to economic integration in the Asia-Pacific. You are more than welcome to continue to get actively involved in China’s reform and opening up and modernization drive, and share in the opportunities created by Chinese modernization.

units.zh: 让我们携起手来，以开放纾发展之困，以创新聚增长之势，以合作谋共享之福，建设亚太共同体，共创亚太光明未来！
units.en: Let us join hands to meet challenges facing development through opening up, generate momentum for growth through innovation, and pursue prosperity for all through cooperation. Let us work together to build an Asia-Pacific community and deliver a bright future for our region.

units.zh: 谢谢大家。
units.en: Thank you.

files.name: 20261118习近平在亚太经合组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议欢迎晚宴上的祝酒辞 中英对照

units.zh: 在亚太经合组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议欢迎晚宴上的祝酒辞 （2026年11月18日，深圳） 中华人民共和国主席 习近平
units.en: Toast Remarks by H.E. Xi Jinping President of the People’s Republic of China At the Welcome Dinner of The 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting

units.zh: 各位同事， 各位来宾， 女士们，先生们，朋友们：
units.en: Dear Colleagues, Distinguished Guests, Ladies and Gentlemen, Dear Friends,

units.zh: 大家晚上好！
units.en: Good evening.

units.zh: 今晚，南海之滨灯火璀璨，鹏城深圳秋意盎然。在亚太经合组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议即将召开之际，我谨代表中国政府和中国人民，对各位嘉宾的到来表示热烈欢迎。
units.en: Tonight, the shores of the South China Sea are ablaze with light, and Shenzhen is at its autumn best. On the eve of the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting, I wish to extend, on behalf of the Chinese government and the Chinese people, our warmest welcome to all distinguished guests.

units.zh: 我曾讲过，看千年的中国去西安，看五百年的中国去北京，看一百年的中国去上海。今天，我想对大家说，看五十年的中国就来深圳。
units.en: I have often said that to see over a few thousand years of China, go to Xi’an; to see 500 years of China, go to Beijing; to see 100 years of China, go to Shanghai. Tonight, let me add this: To see 50 years of China, come to Shenzhen.

units.zh: 深圳是一个有大故事的地方。1978年，我第一次到深圳，看到的还是一个小渔村。弹指间40多年过去了，如今这里高楼林立、车水马龙，变化之大可谓沧海桑田。
units.en: Shenzhen is a place with a big story to tell. When I first set foot here in 1978, it was little more than a fishing village. In the blink of an eye, more than four decades have passed. Today, high-rises stretch across the horizon and traffic surges through the streets—a transformation nothing short of miraculous.

units.zh: 开放是深圳与生俱来的基因。从边陲小镇到国际化大都市，从引进外资和技术到积极参与制定国际规则，今天的深圳，贸易联通四海，商旅络绎不绝，成为中国高水平对外开放的窗口。
units.en: Openness is in Shenzhen’s DNA. From a remote border town to an international metropolis, from merely attracting foreign capital and technology to actively helping shape international rules—Shenzhen today has trade links spanning the globe and welcomes an endless stream of businesspeople and travelers. It stands as a window on China’s high-standard opening up.

units.zh: 创新是深圳的活力所在。从出口加工到自主研发，从“世界工厂”到创新之城，今天的深圳，每年国际专利申请量近2万件，先进制造业和现代服务业比翼齐飞，成为中国集群式创新的前沿。
units.en: Innovation is the wellspring of Shenzhen’s vitality. From export processing to independent research and development, from “world factory” to “city of innovation”—Shenzhen today files up to 20,000 international patent applications a year. Advanced manufacturing and modern services flourish side by side, placing the city at the forefront of China’s cluster-based innovation.

units.zh: 合作是深圳的力量之源。“来了就是深圳人。”这座城市以宽广胸怀接纳四面八方的奋斗者，汇聚来自100多个国家和地区的国际化人才，成为中国同各方合作共赢的热土。
units.en: Cooperation is the source of Shenzhen’s strength. As the people of Shenzhen like to say, “Once here, Shenzhener forever.” The city opens its minds and arms to go-getters from around the world and brings together talent from over 100 countries and regions, making it a vibrant hub of win-win cooperation between China and the rest of the world.

units.zh: 深圳的故事是中国改革开放的缩影。一代代建设者在改革开放中破冰突围、接续奋斗，解放和发展生产力，展现了中国式现代化的万千气象。
units.en: The Shenzhen story is a microcosm of China’s reform and opening up. Generation after generation of builders have started from scratch and worked tirelessly to blaze new trails. They have forged ahead in reform and opening up, unleashed and developed the productive forces, and showcased the great dynamism of Chinese modernization.

units.zh: 深圳的故事也是亚太合作的成功范例。亚太经济体突破地理限制和观念差异，积极投入区域合作的大舞台，创造了经济快速发展的“亚太奇迹”。
units.en: The Shenzhen story is also a shining example of Asia-Pacific cooperation. Economies across the region have risen above geographic constraints and differences in thinking, thrown themselves into the wide arena of regional cooperation, and created the Asia-Pacific miracle of rapid economic growth.

units.zh: 女士们、先生们、朋友们！
units.en: Ladies and Gentlemen, Dear Friends,

units.zh: 亚太经合组织成立以来，开放、创新、合作一直是其鲜明标识。从西雅图的初次握手到雁栖湖的历史盛会，从茂物目标的庄严承诺到亚太共同体的宏伟愿景，亚太经合组织始终把握时代脉搏、引领亚太经济一体化进程，助力亚太成为全球经济最具活力的地区和重要增长引擎。
units.en: Since its founding, APEC has always been known for openness, innovation and cooperation. From the first handshake in Seattle to the historic gathering by Beijing’s Yanqi Lake, from the solemn commitment to the Bogor Goals to the broad vision of building an Asia-Pacific community—APEC has remained attuned to the pulse of our times, spearheaded economic integration in the Asia-Pacific, and helped make this region the most dynamic in the global economy and a vital engine of world growth.

units.zh: 于道各努力，千里自同风。为了建设亚太共同体，我们跨越山海走到一起。中方担任今年亚太经合组织东道主以来，在16座城市举办了300多场会议和活动，各成员经济体代表逾万人次踊跃参与，为“中国年”收获更多重要成果作出贡献。在明天的领导人会议上，我们将讨论扩大相互开放的举措，探索创新驱动增长的路径，拓展各领域务实合作的机遇，推动更多成果落地。我期待同大家共商亚太合作大计、共襄亚太发展大业。
units.en: “On separate sails, we give our best; even a thousand miles apart, the same wind connects our quest.” This verse captures perfectly why we have crossed mountains and seas to come together—united by the shared purpose of building an Asia-Pacific community. Since becoming the APEC Chair, China has hosted over 300 meetings and events across 16 cities in the course of the year, with more than 10,000 delegates from member economies taking part and helping to deliver significant outcomes during the APEC China Year. At tomorrow’s Leaders’ Meeting, we will discuss steps to expand mutual openness, explore pathways to innovation-driven growth, extend opportunities for result-oriented cooperation across various fields, and strive to deliver more tangible results on the ground. I look forward to discussing with you the great endeavor of Asia-Pacific cooperation and advancing our shared cause of Asia-Pacific development.

units.zh: 现在，我提议，让我们一起举杯， 为亚太地区的共同繁荣， 为这次领导人非正式会议圆满成功， 为各位嘉宾和家人的健康， 干杯！
units.en: Now, I would like to propose a toast. Let’s raise our glasses: To the shared prosperity of the Asia-Pacific; To the great success of the APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting; and To the health of all distinguished guests and your families. Cheers!

files.name: 20261116 李强在第29次中国—东盟领导人会议上的讲话 中英对照

units.zh: 在第29次中国—东盟领导人会议上的讲话 （2026年11月16日，马尼拉） 中华人民共和国国务院总理 李强
units.en: Remarks by Chinese Premier Li Qiang at the 29th China-ASEAN Summit Manila, November 16, 2026

units.zh: 各位同事：
units.en: Dear Colleagues,

units.zh: 很高兴同大家一道出席今天的会议。
units.en: It is my great pleasure to join you at this meeting.

units.zh: 今年是中国同东盟建立全面战略伙伴关系5周年。过去5年，国际上单边主义、保护主义逆流涌动，地缘冲突此起彼伏。在这样的背景下，中国—东盟合作逆势而上，取得令人振奋的成绩。一是合作成效量质齐升。双方去年贸易额已突破1万亿美元，比2021年增长20.1%，今年前10个月增长29.6%。截至目前，双向投资额累计超过5000亿美元，比5年前增长50%以上。数字经济、绿色经济、人工智能等新的合作快速增长。二是合作机制不断夯实。中国—东盟自贸区3.0版升级议定书已经签署，为建设区域超大市场打下制度基础。我们还制定实施《中国—东盟全面战略伙伴关系行动计划（2026-2030）》，为下个5年携手发展绘就美好蓝图。三是互联互通持续加强。雅万高铁、中老铁路等重大项目从规划变为现实，平陆运河正式通航，“东盟签证”落地实施，区域内人员、资金、技术等要素流动更加高效，经济效益进一步提升。
units.en: This year marks the fifth anniversary of the China-ASEAN Comprehensive Strategic Partnership. Over the past five years, we have witnessed a growing countercurrent of unilateralism and protectionism and recurring geopolitical conflicts on the global stage. Despite such a challenging environment, China-ASEAN cooperation has maintained strong momentum and scored encouraging achievements. First, we have elevated our cooperation in both output and quality. Trade between the two sides exceeded US$1 trillion last year, up by 20.1 percent compared with 2021. In the first 10 months of this year, our trade increased by 29.6 percent. To date, two-way investment has exceeded US$500 billion in cumulative terms, an increase of over 50 percent compared with five years ago. Cooperation in new areas such as digital economy, green economy and artificial intelligence has made rapid advances. Second, we have further consolidated cooperation mechanisms. We signed the China-ASEAN Free Trade Area 3.0 Upgrade Protocol, creating the institutional foundation for building a mega-sized regional market. We also adopted and delivered on the Plan of Action to Implement the ASEAN-China Comprehensive Strategic Partnership (2026-2030), drawing a promising blueprint for common development in the next five years. Third, we have continued to strengthen connectivity. Major projects such as the Jakarta-Bandung high-speed railway and the China-Laos railway were turned from plans into reality, the Pinglu Canal was officially opened, and the “ASEAN Visa” program was implemented. The flow of personnel, capital, technology and other factors has become more efficient across the region, and generated greater economic returns.

units.zh: 5年的历程不同寻常，成绩来之不易，我们从中可以得到一些宝贵经验和有益启示。我感到，很重要的有三点。一是弘扬友好互助的传统。中国和东盟国家有着悠久的友好交往史。这一传统没有因为国际局势动荡而褪色，反而在各方一次次守望相助、共迎挑战的过程中，磨砺得更加成熟坚韧。二是坚守开放共赢的正道。中国和东盟长期是经济全球化和区域一体化的支持者、推动者。尽管国际上各类经贸限制大幅增多，我们坚定维护多边主义、促进自由贸易，不断做大合作蛋糕。三是顺应创新发展的潮流。当前科技发展日新月异，我们敏锐把握时代脉搏，携手提升创新能力，合力开拓经济新蓝海。这些经验启示是我们共同的宝贵财富，应当长期坚持并充分运用，不断书写中国—东盟合作的新篇章。
units.en: The past five years have been truly extraordinary, and the achievements we scored have not come easily. From our shared journey, we can draw some valuable experience and inspirations, particularly the following three points. First, promoting the tradition of friendship and mutual assistance. China and ASEAN countries share a long history of friendly exchanges. Instead of losing its shine in the turbulent world, this fine tradition has grown more mature and resilient as we work together to tackle one challenge after another. Second, upholding the fundamental principles of openness and mutual benefit. China and ASEAN are both long-standing advocates and contributors of economic globalization and regional integration. Although economic and trade restrictions have substantially increased around the world, we remain firmly committed to safeguarding multilateralism and promoting free trade, and endeavor to make the pie of cooperation bigger. Third, embracing the trend of innovation-driven development. Amid rapid advances in science and technology, we have kept abreast of the times, and worked together to strengthen innovation capabilities and open up new vistas for economic growth. These experience and inspirations are a valuable asset for us all. We must carry them forward and harness them to the fullest so as to keep writing new chapters of China-ASEAN cooperation.

units.zh: 各位同事：
units.en: Colleagues,

units.zh: 5年前，习近平主席提出中国东盟应携手建设和平、安宁、繁荣、美丽、友好的共同家园。中国和东盟国家都崇尚“家”文化，我们地理相近、人缘相亲，世世代代积淀的深厚情感，不应也不会受一时一事影响。当今世界纷纷攘攘，中国和东盟更应当团结一致，排除干扰，共建更为紧密的中国—东盟命运共同体，把我们的家园守护好、建设好，为整个地球村的发展繁荣注入更多稳定性确定性。
units.en: Five years ago, President Xi Jinping put forward the vision of China and ASEAN jointly building a peaceful, safe and secure, prosperous, beautiful and amicable home. China and ASEAN countries both value the concept of family. We enjoy geographical proximity and our people feel close to each other. Our profound friendship, which has been nurtured over generations, shall not and will not be swayed by any temporary or isolated issue. As we now live in a volatile world, it is all the more important for China and ASEAN to stand united and remove disruptions. We should jointly build an even closer China-ASEAN community with a shared future, preserve and build our home well, and provide greater stability and certainty for the development and prosperity of the entire global village.

units.zh: 第一，筑牢和平安宁保障。国际形势越是复杂严峻，我们越要增进战略互信，坚持通过对话协商妥处分歧，共同反对外部干涉，维护地区和平稳定。中方期待早日达成“南海行为准则”，为实现南海长治久安提供坚实制度保障。
units.en: First, we should strengthen the safeguards for peace and tranquility. The more complex and severe the international landscape is, the more imperative it is for us to build up strategic trust, properly handle differences through dialogue and negotiation, jointly oppose foreign interference, and uphold regional peace and stability. China looks forward to the early adoption of a Code of Conduct in the South China Sea, so as to provide solid institutional safeguards for lasting peace and stability in the South China Sea.

units.zh: 第二，促进地区发展繁荣。我们应当以中国—东盟自贸区3.0版升级议定书生效为契机，深化产供链合作，加快铁路、公路等基础设施“硬联通”，加强机制、标准、规则等“软联通”。中方欢迎建立中国—东盟能源合作伙伴关系和能源部长会议机制，愿同东盟办好明年人工智能合作年，开展“人工智能+”合作，探讨同《东盟数字经济框架协议》对接，打造区域经济高质量发展的强劲引擎。
units.en: Second, we should promote regional development and prosperity. We should take the entry into force of the China-ASEAN Free Trade Area 3.0 Upgrade Protocol as an opportunity to deepen industrial and supply chain cooperation, accelerate the development of “hard connectivity” of infrastructure including railways and highways, and strengthen “soft connectivity” in areas such as mechanisms, standards and rules. China welcomes the establishment of the China-ASEAN energy cooperation partnership and the mechanism of energy ministerial meeting. China will work with ASEAN to host a successful Year of AI Cooperation in the next year, carry out “AI plus” cooperation, and explore the alignment with the ASEAN’s Digital Economy Framework Agreement, so as to cultivate powerful engines for the high-quality development of the regional economy.

units.zh: 第三，增进广大民众福祉。改善民生是我们共同的重要任务。中方将继续向中国—东盟合作基金注资，愿同东盟加强减贫、防灾减灾、粮食安全等合作，促进本地区可持续发展。中国—东盟数字学院明年将向东盟国家提供100个全额奖学金名额，中国—东盟妇幼健康合作中心愿在未来三年同东盟国家合作培养1000名专业人才，欢迎各方积极参与。中方愿同东盟加强执法合作，共同打击跨国犯罪，保护人民安全。
units.en: Third, we should increase the benefits to the people. Making life better for the people is an important task for all of us. China will continue to replenish the China-ASEAN Cooperation Fund, and stands ready to step up cooperation with ASEAN on poverty reduction, disaster prevention and mitigation and food security to promote sustainable development of the region. The China-ASEAN Digital Academy will provide 100 full scholarships for ASEAN countries next year and the China-ASEAN Women and Children’s Health Cooperation Center is ready to work with ASEAN countries to train 1,000 professionals in the coming three years. We welcome your active participation in these programs. China is willing to strengthen law enforcement cooperation with ASEAN to jointly combat transnational crimes and ensure people’s safety.

units.zh: 家和万事兴，人和百业顺。相信在双方精诚协作下，我们的共同家园必将生机勃勃、欣欣向荣，迎来更加光明的未来。
units.en: When the family is in harmony, everything thrives; when people are in harmony, everything goes well. I believe that with the close collaboration between our two sides, our shared home will stay vibrant and prosperous, and embrace a brighter future.

units.zh: 谢谢大家！
units.en: Thank you.
